sanskrit: putrītriśūlabhṛtamīśamahaṃ praṇamyaṛjusakṣepasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvasthāpanasaṅkulam [g: sadguṇamiti]hitāya mandabuddhīnāṃ smaraṇāya manīṣiṇāmbahutantrāṇyato vīkṣya krameṇaikatra likhyatetadā [mu. a, k: tantrā] gamānusāreṇa liṅgaṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpratamlīyate pralaye yatra tadidaṃ liṅgamucyatehīnādi [kh: hīmādi] siddhayastasmācchivapūjopacārataḥsarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ śuddhaṃ śivatattvaṃ ca mokṣadamato narādibhistattu liṅgarūpamupāsyatemahārājyapradā pūjā dhyānaṃ mokṣapradāyakamtatphalaṃ dviguṇaṃ samyag liṅgaikasthāpanāpanāddhruvamtadeva tṛṇakuḍyādyairdaridrāṇāmaśāṭhyataḥlakṣaṇaṃ liṅgadhāmādau narebhyo vakṣyate'dhunā [kh: sadā]liṅgaṃ ca [gh, ṅ: liṅgārcā; kh: liṅgasya] mukhaliṅgaṃ ca puṃstriyau ca napuṃsakamsūryāṣṭāṣṭāsrake [mū. a: puryaṣṭāṣṭā; g: sūryacchāyā] viṣṇurbrahmā vedāsrake vibhuḥ(vyaktaṃ [kh: ayaṃ cāpacinhāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ nāśti] mūrdhādisaṃyuktaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ dvirūpakambhuktimuktipradaṃ miśramityetadrūpato bhavetśīghraṃ siddhikaraṃ yacca kāmyākāmyāya yadbhavetkārukā mūrtipāścaiva vanayātrādikaṃ yathāpuṇyasthānavibhāgaśca vāstugrahaṇamarcanamśivo liṅgavidhiryāgo dhvajaparyantakaṃ tathāyatīnāmāśrayo yādṛk pratiṣṭhā pañcadhā ca yāsthāpane yaśca saṃbhāra ityādyakhilamucyatekṣudrakāmāya lohotthaṃ ratnajaṃ bahusiddhidamkhādhāreṇa vyavasthāpyaṃ naśvaraṃ dhātudārujam [mū. a, k, ṅ: naśvaratvāttu dārujam]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅgaṃ ca dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ [mū. a, k: proktaṃ] calaṃ caivācalaṃ tathāsthiralakṣmīpradaṃ haimaṃ rājataṃ caiva rājyadamvidveṣakārakaṃ kāṃsyaṃ rītijaṃ śatruvālanamaṣṭalohamayaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṣṭharogakṣayāvahamsikthaṃ kṛtvā mṛdā liptvā taptvodvāsya ca kārukaḥhemāhibhyāṃ kramātāratāmravaṅgāraghoṣakaiḥkāṣṭhaṃ kṣiptvā dṛḍhaṃ tattu śilāghṛṣṭaṃ savālukamtayā lavaṇapūrāmbu [mū. tayālabāla pūrāḍhyaṃ] yuktayā lepayedbudhaḥbālakuñcikayā [mū. -kāla] sāmyaṃ nayettatkramaśaḥ śanaiḥtato'numā [kh: tato'ntarmā] rjayedyatnānmaṇinā [gh: ye drūkṣā] madanāmbubhiḥrasaye [mū.: vāsayet] ttāmrajaṃ śilpī hāṭakena sucārūṇāguru snigdhaṃ mṛdusparśe [ṅ: mṛduṃ pakve] ṣaḍvidhaṃ hemaśobhanamdhātūdbhavaṃ samākhyātaṃ ratnajādi [mū. a, k: ratnajāpi] vadāmyataḥsukhakṛtpuṣparāgotthaṃ vaidūryaṃ śatrudarpahṛtliṅgaṃ mārakataṃ puṣṭyai sphaṭikaṃ sarvakāmadamvaidrumaṃ vaśyakamārthaṃ [g: vadhyakarmārthaṃ] kārketanamamitrahṛtbaladaṃ jīvajātījaṃ ṭaiṭṭibhaṃ śatrumardanamiti prasthānaliṅgāni śuddhimānānyataḥ paramkārukai [kh: kārubhiḥ; mū. a, k: dārubhi] rghaṭitaṃ yacca talliṅgaṃ nirmitaṃ smṛtamtatpūjyaṃ rājabhiryatnādbhuktimuktyarthibhiḥ sadāūrdhvādhovadanaṃ dīrghamadhaḥ sthūlaṃ ca niṣprabhamchidraṃ [g: sthiraṃ] ca sphuṭitaṃ trastaṃ [mū. a, k, kh: bhrastaṃ] śalyānvitaṃ [g, ṅ: śūlānvitaṃ] surojjhitamrāṣṭragotrajanagrāma [ṅ: kulagrāma] dhanamitrasutānapi [mū, a, g: yutānapi]rogaṃ parājayodvegaṃ [ṅ: parākramodvegaṃ] janadveṣaṃ kaliṃ tathātatsyāddoṣairvinirmuktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ prabhānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāratnaṃ mahāmūlyaṃ guṇayuktaṃ yajetsadāsupratāpo [kh: saṃpratāpo] yaśaścāyurbhaveyurnṛpateściramnīlaṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ cāpi śastaṃ ratnamanirmitamśaṅkhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ javārambhādaladyutidhautāsyābho dvijātīnāṃ nṛpārhau [nṛpādau, li. pu. pā] pītaraktakautalliṅgamāyuṣo vṛddhayai sarvarogavināśakamśakrāgni(gnī) casamitroye [gh: śakrāgnicalamitrottha; ṅ: śakrāgnīndrasamitrāye] caturdhā tatkvacinmatamśaradambunibhaṃ svacchaṃ snigdhaṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ hitamsagarbhamūrmisaṃyuktaṃ jyotirmuktaghanaṃ [muktaṃ punaḥ, iti pāṭhāntara] tyajetsthūlaṃ dīrgha kuśaṃ hrasvaṃ madhyādyanteṣu vā kṛśam [mū.: cākṛśam]anyajātivilagnaṃ ca viddhaṃ bhītikaraṃ tyajetsphāṭikaṃ liṅgamiṣṭārthaṃ mṛtyujitkāmadaṃ yajetliṅgaṃ sadāgnihotrābhaṃ pūjya no doṣakṛnnṛṇāmsadā nimnena siddhiḥ syāducce tūccā same samāratnaliṅgaṃ dvidhākhyātaṃ svapīṭhaṃ dhātupīṭhajam [mū, a: sūpīṭhaṃ dhātupīṭhakam]calaliṅgaṃ dvidhākāryaṃ dhāturatnamayaṃ śubhamkṣudraratnotthamapyevaṃ svamānā [g: pramāṇā] dvararatnajamvaiśyānāṃ manmathāntaṃ syācchūdrāṇāṃ dvādaśāvadhiḥ [kh: khagagāvapi; gh: śāṅkagajāvadhi]calaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ devānāṃ trayoviṃśatikāṅgulamacalaṃ khadrūbhasthāyi karādanavasāmakam [mū, a, k, kh: sīsakam]saḍḍhataṃ miśrakaṃ liṅgaṃ nordhvaṃ ca sthiramiṣyateṣaḍḍhastānnādhikaṃ vārkṣaṃ pārthivaṃ śailavatsadāyakṣarakṣo'suravyāla gandharvāpsarasāṃ kvacitpariṇāhocchrayābhyāṃ ca devānāmekaviṃśatiḥpañcāṅgulaṃtu paiṣṭyādyaṃ phalajaṃ svapramāṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthaṇḍile maṇḍale pūjya syāddīkṣāsthāpanādike [kh: -nānhike; gh: -nāntike]prabhumānapradaṃ śāṅkhaṃ [kh: śārṅgaṃ] sainyacchinnāgadantajamaṇimādinṛkulyotthamanyonyabdārdhataḥ [mū: nyaccharddhataḥ] sadāśālipiṣṭodbhavaṃ puṣṭyai ṣāṣṭikaṃ puṣṭivardhanam [mū,: buddhivardhanam]ripubhedakaraṃ maudgaṃ strīdaṃ śyāmākasambhavamsukhakṛnnāvanītaṃ tu gomayaṃ roganāśanamnānāphalodbhavaṃ [kh: lohabhavaṃ] liṅgaṃ nānākāmapradāyakamuccāṭane tu pāṃśavyaṃ maulaṃ [ṅ: mārṣaṃ] śatrukṣayāvahampurakṣobhakaraṃ pauraṃ [mū, a, k, kh, g: ghoraṃ] rāmaṭhaṃ caugryakārakammṛdbimbodbhavamiṣṭārthaṃ lepātsyuḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥtāvatkāla tu [g: tārako'nanta] saṃpūya visṛjya tāni [kh: visarjyaitāni] ke kṣipetniṣkvāthya [mū: niṣkāṭhya; gh: niṣkāsya; ṅ: niṣkāma] paṭamālepya saṃśoṣya [g: saṃsodhya] pārimārjya cadhātubilvarasairlekhyaṃ tridhā liṅgaṃ paṭādikebalasaṃvartanīcchāyā dṛṣṭi [k, g, ṅ: sṛṣṭi] bhāvāśritā sadākaruṇādbhutaśāntāśca navabhāvātmikāḥ kvacitsvecchayā pūjayedetanmṛnmayānyucyate [mū, a: dyucyate; kh: mayo hyucyate] 'dhunāsadyomantreṇa cāpakvaṃ [ṅ: cāpaṅkaṃ] kramānnavakarādikamdvijādijātibhirmṛdbhiravyaktādi ca kāmataḥvāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu dīrghikāyāḥ samāharetpuṣṭyai trilohagarbhaṃ ca dhanakoṣavivṛddhayevāmākhyena citāṃ kṛtvā [ṅ: dhṛtvā] ghoreṇa paridāhya caīśānena gṛhītvā tu tataḥ saṃskṛtya pūjayetsarjahiṅgupuraṃbola [puraḥ - gugguluḥ | puro guggulurākhyāto iti dharaṇi | bolaḥ - gandharasaḥ, bolagandharasaprāṇaḥ; ityamaraḥ] matasītailameva camṛdi kṣiptvā vyavasthāpya māsaṃ tāṃ parimṛdya caśaṇatatvanvitaṃ [k: tatsūtritaṃ] katvā mṛnmayaṃ ghaṭayecchubham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityeteṣāmabhāve tu rasendraṃ vajrasaṃyutamgavyasarjayutaiścaiva lepyaṃ varṇakapuṣṭayesadvārarkṣartuyuktenhi cārulagnasamanvitedivyāntarikṣabhaumāni śubhāśubhaphalāptayeityādi śubhakṛddivyamato'śubhakaraṃ tvidamdigdāhastīvravātaśca candrasūryopamardanam [mū, a, kha: pasarjanam]vāsavṛkṣāgrasaṃsthāyi [ṅ: śramasthāyi] balibhuṅmadhurārutiḥpāṃśvasṛgvarṣaṇaṃ ghoramāntarikṣamaśobhanamdadhyakṣatayavā [mū, a: dadhyuddhṛtadharā] dūrvā dīpo gorocanā dhvajaḥgovṛṣaśca kharo vājī bhasmākṣo bhūpatirdvipaḥśivaḥ śivodakuṃbhasthaḥ kauśiko vāmataḥ śubhaḥmuktakeśaḥ parākṣepaḥ kṣāro'ṅgāraśca dāru cachinnāṅgo'locano rogī kapālī bhūprakampanaḥkṣutkṣāmonmattakau tantuścauṣadhīṣaṇasañcayaḥ [g: pañcamaḥ]pakṣārdhārdhaṃ tu saṃtyajya prasthānaṃ kriyate śubhevedase syādvite [gh: yugāsrau syāddhitaiḥ] yātā tvagnidaṇḍānatikramātiṣṭādau [kh: indrādau] śaṅkaraṃ śastaṃ prāgīśenduvanaṃ [mū, a, k,: śendravanaṃ] vrajetbudhārkendusite jīve vārkṣe prāguttarasthite [gh: sthire]ekāntarāsu [k: ekākarāsu] tārāsu śeṣe cāniṣṭakarmaṇiniṣadho nīlagandhākhyaḥ śaṅgīketurnagādhipāḥnandākhyo malayo vindhya ujjayanto'tha [k: urjayanta] ṛkṣakaḥ [g: ṛṣyakaḥ]yojanāni daśaiteṣāṃ girīṇāṃ nikaṭe vanametatkṣetrotthitā ye tu pāṣāṇāstaravaḥ śubhāḥsācāryaḥ sādhakaḥ śilpijanaiḥ parivataḥ śubhaiḥdhyātvādhaḥ prākṛtaṃ tattvaṃ śivatattvamayīṃ mahīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: diśo virecya cāstreṇa vighnanāśāya daiśikaḥmantrarakṣāvidhi kṛtvā saṃjapa [kh: saṃyajan] nniṣṭadevatāmiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye liṅgadravyanirṇayavanapraveśo nāma prathamovidhiḥsvarūpaṃ kathyate samyagiṣṭāniṣṭa ca karmaṇidhīraḥ śāstrārthakārī ca kartā yaḥ sātviko varaḥnāstikastārkikaḥ krūraḥ kartā yastāmaso'dhamaḥtasmātte guravo'nveṣyā ye tacchāstreṣu bhāṣitāḥ [g: preṣitāḥ]antarvedīpratiṣṭhānaśrāvastyā [mū, a: cāraptyā; g: cārakṣyā; k: cāvantyā] guravo varāḥāṅgā jāṭodbhavāśceti [kh: āryajāto] saptaite madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥvīrajā drāviḍāpauṇḍrāstvaṣṭaiteguravo'dhamāḥ [gh: -tvaṣṭau te-]vāṅgagāndhārapauliṅgā ete saptāntyajā matāḥsaurāṣṭrā devarāṣṭrāśca aṣṭaite [k, kh, g, gh: aṣṭau] ninditā bhṛśamadhamādyāḥ śubhe neṣṭā āryāvarte hi [kh: na] doṣadāḥyo deśo madhyabhāgaḥ syādāryāvartaḥ sa kīrtitaḥgotragocarasaṃyuktāḥ samayādyuktalakṣaṇāḥdīkṣāguṇenasaṃpūrṇāṃ [mū, a, k, ṅ: dīkṣāsthāpanasaṃyuktāṃ] ye jānantyatha saṃhitāmbhāryāvartodbhavāḥ śaivāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥpīṭhadhāmādikuṇḍajñāḥ pratiṣṭhāsthānavedakāḥlobhamohaparityaktāḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥsātvikā nipuṇā dakṣāḥ pañcaśrautārthavedakāḥ [k: -tattvārtha-]dṛḍhavratājanadrohisatyavāgbhūtavatsalāḥ [g: vāgghatavāsanāḥ]dīkṣitāḥ śivaśāstre smiṃścatvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥyojitaḥ śivatattve yaḥ śivarūpamavāptavānśūdrādīnāṃ tathā mantrairyuktānāṃ śreṣṭhatā [mū, a, g, ṅ: hīnānāṃ śreṣṭhato] bhavettathaiva mantrasaṃyogāccāturvarṇaḥ śivī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣāyogāttatheśasya śūdrādiḥ śivatāṃ vrajetyathā kulālacakrastho'vicchinnaṃ bhramate ghaṭaḥmalaṃ viṣamadaṃ yadvaddhanti vai mantratejasāsyātkatakaphalairyogāttadvanmantraistu mānavaḥtathaiva mantrasāmarthyānmalaṃ hatvā śivī bhavettatheśamantrasaṃparkā [mū, a, k, g: saṃyogā] cchivatvaṃ jāyate paśoḥśaivācāryāḥ prayacchanti śivatvaṃ sa carācareācāryo'pi [kh: mantra tantra] tathaivātra śivatvaṃ yāti mantravitsaṃskriyante hi mantraiśca devācāryatapasvinaḥyathāpūjyaveda [gh: -pūjama-] jñastathā śudro'pi daiśikaḥsa śivaḥ svayameva syānnānyarūpaḥ kadācanamantrayogādvibudhyante naṣṭāniṣṭaṃ tathā śiveśaivācāryaḥ [mū, a, k: śaivācāryāḥ] paraṃ sthānaṃ tadvattā [kh: tattvato] nmantranaukayāśeṣe tvekaikahāniḥ syātsahasre ca śatakramāt [mū, a, k: dveśate kramāt]pitāmahaśataṃ yāvadviṣṇormānaṃ vidhīyatevinaśyanti tathopendrā asaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥsādākhyanimiṣeṇeśo layaṃ yāti na saṃśayḥśivātparataraṃ nāsti iti śāstreṣu niścayaḥtasmācchivadito mantraḥ siddhimuktiphalapradaḥmantraiḥ śivādhvare [k: śivapure; kh, g: śivāpure] jātaḥ sa śūdraḥ syātkathaṃ punaḥtathaiva pāpahānaṃ ca prākṛtāstu prajāyate [k: prākṛtaṃ tu na jāyate; kh: na prakṛtyāstu jātaḥ]lakṣyā [mū, a, k, kh: loke] viprādikācārānnārakīṇo na tārakāḥ [kh: kārakāḥ]na bhaveyustadā nūnaṃ dvijā devādidaiśikāḥviṣabhūtagrahādyāśca nigṛhyante hi mantrataḥcarācaraṃ prapadyeta śivatvaṃ tatkṣaṇāddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatsiddhaṃ sadā śaivaṃ gururūpamajanmakam [kh: gururūpamayātmakam]śivāntanāmakāḥ sarve bhasmāṅgā [mū, a, kh, gh, ṅ: bhasmākṣā] brahmacāriṇaḥviśeṣayātu sāmānyā gururapyevameva tuambhojaṃ paṅkajaṃ yadvattadvacchaivā na cetaretathaiva śivaliṅgānāṃ śaivāḥ pāśupatādayaḥliṅgabhedaphalairyukto yātyasau rauravaṃ dhruvamanyathā pāpakārī syādityājñā pārameśvarībrahmacārīgṛhasthatvabhedabhinnaṃ dvidhā sthitamkāmyakāmikriyāṃ vacmi sāmprataṃ saṃprabhedataḥbhuktimuktīcchukaḥ kāmī kuryāddīkṣādimājñayāpratiṣṭhādikriyāśeṣā tatkṛtā saṃpraśasyateśivādhikāravṛttiryaḥ sa sāntānika ucyatepaścātkuryādvivāhaṃ ca gṛhasthaḥ sa vatārpakaḥbhaikṣyāśī saṃyatātmā ca vratī sa parikīrtitaḥpuṣpapātābhidhānaṃ tu maṭhī [mū, g: mathī; k: sacī] mudrābhiriṣyatesadvastramañjanaṃ tailaṃ nayate ramate hi tam [mū, a, k: ramaterhitaḥ; kh: ramatordhvataḥ; gh: rayaterhitam]mākṣāya vratinaṃ caiva varayenmatimānnaraḥlaukiko dravyabhāgī syādvidyābhāk pāralaukikaḥbhrātṛṇaṃ gurvabhāve syādgṛhasthānāṃ svaputrakam [mū, a, k: svaputragam; kh: suputrakaḥ]ayogyāḥ śivakāryeṣu ghaṇṭāsambandhino haret [g: ghaṇṭāmayuktilohavat]ṛṇe dravye ca piṇḍe ca sa evaikaḥ praśasyatecaturgocaramadhye ca śaivo jyeṣṭhāyate [mū, a, k, g: jyeṣṭhoyateḥ] paramśaivācāryastataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sthāpayetsarvadevatāḥ [saha devatā, iti pāṭhāntaram]bhuktimuktipradātā ca nānyo vai viśvakṛdguruḥtadabhāve [gh: vadadāve] tu kartavyāḥ svadevavratacāriṇaḥ [kh: vratadhāriṇaḥ]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrutena śrotriyaścaiva brāhmaṇo brahmacaryataḥmanuṣyajātisāmānye ko vidveṣaḥ śivadvijena tathā brāhmaṇādīnāṃ tasmājjātirnakāraṇam [g: prakāraṇam]upavītaṃ sadā dhāryaṃ śaivācāryairna cetaraiḥsāvitra itthamī parṇā proktā nānā śivāgamedvayoḥ syājjyātirityuktaḥ sāvitrastu svagocaraḥdhvajaiśchatrairyutāḥ sarve śaivācāryā nṛpā ivasyādvṛddhirvijayaḥ [gh: sthāpiterdevaistatkartā ca] śāntirārogyaṃ dharmavardhanamāyuṣā yaśasā lakṣmyā [gh: lakṣmī] putrapautrairvivardhate [gh: pravardhate]tāvadya gasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyatenākāle mriyate kartā parataḥ śivatāṃ vrajetpadaṃ saṃprāpya rudrasya sukhamakṣayamaśnutetāṃstu sarvān prayuñjīta krūrakarmasu sarvadāvikṛtāḥ śavalā [kh: sacarā] raudrāḥ śaṭhāḥ krūrāḥ [mū: sevā] kuvṛttikāḥvākkaṇṭhā baghiraḥ sthūlāḥ kunakhāśca kumūrdhajāḥpurodhāḥ paṇyajīvī [gh: ścānyajīvī] ca vaṇijo dhātuvādinaḥvakranāsāṅgalamboṣṭhā mūrkhāḥ spandanagātrakāḥgranthaviplākā [kh: viprocakā] vṛddhā vyasanī samayacyutaḥetaistu sthāpitā devā dhanāyuḥ putranāśakāḥkatthakāḥ [kh, g, gh: kaṇṭhakā] kauśikā [k, g: kaulikā] stajjāstrikarṇādyāśca varjitāḥsanyāsavratinaścānye sthāpane nādhikāriṇaḥnirmālyabhakṣyaṇārthaṃ tu śāmbenācyutasūnunāśivādīn sthāpayennityaṃ svayambhūḥ sa narādhamaḥsa punarbhūḥ parijñeyo varjanīyaḥ śivāgamekuṇḍaḥ krūrasvabhāvaḥsyānmṛte patyau tu golakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāvrājyānnaśyate [mū, a, kh: duṣyate] pūrvaṃ strīyogādaparaṃ tathātrikarṇotthāstrikarṇāśca trikapānātma [mū, a: trikarṇastu tri] karṇakābhasmāṅkurastu [g: gurustu] katthosthastatsutāḥ kauśikādayaḥrāṣṭrakṣayakarā hyete ye ca paṣāṇḍino narāḥśāstrāvalokanādeva caṇḍeśastasya śāsakaḥsa yāti narakaṃ sadyo yājñikaiḥ saha daiśikaḥteṣāmācaraṇānnityamācārya iti kīrtyatetasmānna mānavīṃ buddhiṃ kārayeddaiśikaṃ pratipañcavaktrāṇi devasya pañcāgamavivṛddhayedīptaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca sāhasramaṃśuma [kh: asumat] tsuprabhaṃ daśavijayaṃ pāramaiśvaryaṃ niśvāsodgītasaṃjñakamnarasiṃhaṃ candrahāsaṃ vīraṃ svāyambhurauravam [kh: rocanam]([cāpacinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ ka pustake nāsti] rudrabhedāḥ samākhyātā daśāṣṭādaśa cordhvagāḥpañcabhūta [mū, a: pañcāmṛta] vibhāgaṃ ca śūnyabheda [kh: -mada] vinirṇayamkambojaṃ kambalaṃ kaṅkaṃ kālakuṇḍaṃ kaṭāhakamgāruḍasya tvime bhedā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥasitāṅgaṃ ruruṃ caiva kapālīśaṃ samuccayambhīmāṅgaṃ ḍāmarārāvaṃ [kh: -rāgaṃ] bhīmaṃ vetālamardakamtriśiraṃ caikapādaṃ tu siddhayogeśvarīmatamviśvarikaṇṭha saṅkocaṃ [mū: vikaṇṭha; kh: jhaṅkāra] tilakodyānabhairavamcatuḥ ṣaṣṭipramāṇāni dakṣiṇāsyādbhavāni cakarapūjāvidhānaṃ tu vīṇātantraṃ taduttaramsiddhanityodayaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ cintāmaṇimahodayamānandarudrabhadrākhyaṃ [kh: bhadrākṣe] kiṅkaraṃ kiṅkarānugamvāmadaṃ vāmadevoktaṃ [mū, a, k: devotthaṃ] caturviṃśatibhedagam [k: bhedajam]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: toyāntikaṃ sthitaṃ śalyaṃ prāsāde doṣadaṃ nṛṇāmkvacidrudrasahasre tu hute doṣo na jāyatehute śalyairna doṣaḥ syājjānvadho [gh: dyātvadho] yāgamaṇḍapebhittinyāse viśeṣeṇa yajedvāstuṃ trikālikamgarta [mū, gh" garbha] pramāṇataḥ samyagliptenādyānvite sameiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye śalyoddhāranirṇaye caturviṃśo vidhiḥācāryaḥ sthapatiścaiva daivajño'pi guṇānvitaḥsthapatirviśvakarmā tu daivajño nandikeśvaraḥpūjayitvā tu tānsarvāṃstoṣayitvā kṣamāpayethiraṇyavastradānena vāgbhirvā tāṃstu toṣayetyajñadravyāṇi saṃhṛtya viśedbhūmiṃ samāhitaḥātmapūjāmarghapātraṃ kṛtvā dravyāṇi śodhayetsiñcayedambhasā bhūmiṃ tathā gandho [kh; gaṅgo] dakena casurūpāṃ pramadārūpāṃ śuddhālaṅkārabhūṣitāmsarvadevamayaṃ vāstupuruṣaṃ tatra pūjayetghaṭikāśaṅkuyogena nakṣatradarśanena vālagnavelāvirodhena sūtraṃ bhūmau prapātayetsuśobhā bhānukī cetāḥ prāṅmukhyo navanāḍikāḥvidrumā vibhavetyetā uttarāsyā navoditāḥkṛtvā yajeddharādīnāṃ nava [mū, a: bhava] tyardhaṃ divaukasāmtoyotpalaiśca parjanyaṃ jayaṃ piṣṭa [gh: yajeddiṣṭaṃ] patākayākṣaudraṃ gṛhakṣatāyātha caṇakānnaṃ yamāya casugrīvāya dvayoryāvī puṣpadantāya darbhakamghṛtāmbu ketave dhānāḥ paṅkaverddhe tu [kh, gh: vetra] paścimekṣayāya] ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dityai lopīmadityai ca pūpā [kh, ṅ: sūpā] nardhe'tha saumyataḥtadadhaḥ koṣṭhake dadyādāpavatsāya vai dadhiagnyadhaḥ koṣṭhake nityaṃ sāvitryai [kh, g: savitre] ca kuśāmbhasāvivasvate'ruṇāṃ dadyāccandanaṃ caturaṅghriṣuindrajayāya tasyādho ghṛtānnaṃ koṇakoṣṭhakevāṭvadhaḥ koṇadeśe tu rudrāya pakṣimāṃsakammahīdharāyamāṣānnaṃ samāṃsaṃ caturaṅghriṣuetānvastrādibhiśceṣṭvā tato rakṣo'ṣṭakaṃ kramātpūtanāṃ palapittābhyāṃ māṃsāsṛgbhyāṃ ca jambhakamrakṣomātṛgaṇeśebhyaḥ piśācādi eva caasantarpyāpyaniṣṭvaitān prāsādādīnnakārayetpurotpanno mahāvīryaḥ sarvabhūtabhayāvahaḥyāvadūrvīsthirā loke tāvadvāstunaraḥ sthitaḥsarveṣu vāstukāryeṣu pūjayedvāstunāyakamvistāro'sya samantācca śatakoṭistu yojanaiḥīśakoṇe śirastasya aṃśo bāhuśca pūrvataḥupabāhūruhastaśca pārśvaścaivāgnideśataḥcaturasrasthistvevaṃ vāstunātho mahītalekuḍyādirohaṇe kāle mūrdhādīni na pīḍayetjalādindro gaṇā [kh, g: galā] darkaḥ sugrīvātsatyago mataḥetadvaṃśa [mū, a: ttvaṃśa] gatā nāḍya upavaṃśagatāsvimāḥbhallāṭādbhāskaraṃ yāvanmahendrādyamadevatāmūrdhni ceśāditī nityamāpodityau ca netrayoḥjayo giristardaśasyau somādyāḥ pañca bāhugāḥsāvitrī savitā tadvadupabāhau karau hṛdi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañjikāḥ]vāstudevatāmūrdhāsyahṛtstanaunābhirmahāmarmāṇi pañca cavaṃśopavaṃśarekhāḥ syuḥ śūlaṣaṭkamathāśaniḥīśāgnipitaro vāyuḥ sadā śūleṣvavasthitāḥbiddhe marmaṇi mṛtyuḥ syātputrāṇāmupamarmaṇiupavaṃśe bhavetpīḍā garbhanāśastriśūlakelāṅgūle ca śirorogaṃ devavedheṣu pīḍanampadātṣoḍaśabhāgena śiromānamihoditamsthūlamānamidaṃ proktaṃ sūkṣmamānamihocyatesomataḥ pūrvato vāpi sūtrasañcālanātkamātjñānato'jñānato vāpi marmavedho yadā bhavetityuktā vāstupūjātra gṛhaprāsādayoḥ sadātvaṣṭuḥ suto jayantākhyo mahendro devanāyakaḥtvagni] rvaiśvānaro mataḥścarācare]syādrākṣasādhipaḥpuṣpadanto gaṇaśreṣṭho varuṇaśca jalādhipaḥpāpo manda iti khyāto vego vāpuśca kīrtitaḥbhallāṭo yakṣarājāsau somaścandro'mṛtātmakaḥdaityamātā ditiścoktā āpaścaiva himācalaḥsavitā cāparo hyarkaḥ sāvitrī brahmapatnikāindrajidrakṣasaḥ [mū: indradāsaḥ] putro mitro bhānustṛtīyakaḥdharādharo hyanantaḥ syādbrahmā caturmukho mataḥrākṣasā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āpādīllokamātrastairyajedbrahmadhruveṇa [gh: sthairjaye-] capraṇavādinamo'ntaistānsvāhāntānbalikarmaṇina kevaleṣṭakāśmādyai kevalaiścalanaṃ yataḥmṛdvāluke [mū: ddaruke] ṣṭakāśmābhi prāktasmātpūrayecca tatyājñikaiḥkapūrṇaśakaṭānkuryātsamorvī [ṅ: samauṣvī] sūtrakāṣṭhakaiḥsamopaliptake śvabhre taddvārāgre ca maṇḍapevidhinā hemavastrādyairgurvādīnsudine yajetśivamiṣṭvā tato havyamiṣṭakuṇḍe [gh: muktakuṇḍe] yathāvidhiḥsadrātnoṣadhayo dhātubrīhipāradasaṃyutānmadhyato nyasya nidhīṃścāṣṭau tataḥ kramāt)padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathāoṃ kārādyānnamo'ntāṃśca madhyaścāntān yathākramāntanuṃ śivamnaveṣṭakā [mū: na ceṣṭakā] śilā vāpi koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramātśarvādyā bhīmaparyantāḥ śilāṣṭakeṣu devatāvṛṣādikānanyatroktāḥ kvacitkumbhāḥ śilāścāpyatha pañca capadmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathāprāsādaṃ sūtrayitvā tu kuṃḍyavistaramadhyataḥcaturasrāḥ śilāḥ kāryāḥ samantātkarasammitāḥaiṣṭakāstvaiṣṭake kāryāḥ śaile śailāḥ śilāḥ śubhāḥviniveśitāḥtūryamaṅgalanirghoṣairnimittaiḥ śobhanaiḥ śubhaiḥanyāḥ krameṇa nyastavyāḥ svadiksthā mantriṇā tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astratoyena prathamaṃ mṛttikādyaiḥ punastu taiḥvidyārūpāstu tā dhyātvā parituṣṭāḥ smitānanāḥsudṛḍhai [g: suvṛtaiḥ] mṛnmayaiḥkumbhairvittāḍhyairhemanirmitaiḥkṛtvaitannāmamantreṇa śilāṃ mantrī [gh: mantraiḥ] prasādhayetatra tvaṃ tiṣṭha saṃhṛṣṭā yāvadācandratārakamasmin rakṣā sadā kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayānityaṃ jayāvahā devi svāmini śrīpradā bhavasarvadā sarvadoṣaghne tiṣṭhatvamīśarūpakesarvaṃ saṃpūrṇamevātra prāsāde kuru sarvadāliṅgavatsadākāryoṃ'smin kumbhavinyāse śivavinyāsavadvidhiḥvasānataḥ (?)gurvādibhyo'śanaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāryopajaṅghikānārdhamānataḥ]aghamā cetareṣāṃ tu śivasya tu yathecchayāśilā kūrmādikāryāya paritaḥ saṃprapūrayetmūrtimūlāṅgabhūte ca dhyātvā vāstuṃ yajetpunaḥtūryamaṅgalaśabdena prāsādaṃ tatra sūtrayetvidhiḥardhena liṅgadairghyeṇa bhittayo vistṛtāḥ kramāttadaṃśatulyavīthyastu syurarkāṃśaistu bhittayaḥtadgarbho'ṣṭābhiraṃśaiḥ syādvikārāṃśaistu bhittayaḥkaniṣṭhādikramādgarbhaḥ kvacidbhittestu vardhanamgarbhavyomasya cārkeṇa pīṭhī madhye yugāṃśataḥdviguṇaṃ tat kvacitproktaṃ prāsāde rasabhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhādyā nirgamā jñeyā nemī tatpādavarjitāyugāṅghrermadhyato garbhaḥ syāttadekena piṇḍikāaṣṭāviṃśatibhirbhittiḥ sā syāt stambhakumārikācatuḥ stāmbhāśca tanmadhye dvādaśa syuḥ kumārikāḥpārśvayo ragratā vāpi kuryādāsārasaṃyutesakoṇastambhasaṃyukto maṇḍapaśca tridhā mataḥdvādalāṃśaistu tān sarvān prāsāde cottamodiketathānyataḥjagatīmaṃśato dhṛtvāveṣṭanāṃśaṃ tu lopayetvidikṣu koṇadhāmāni vasvaṃśairmaṇḍapaiḥ sahasamasūtrāṅkake chede samabhāgādvivartayetcāru surālayastambhabalabhīśikharāṇi cavāstumānamiti khyātaṃ liṅgamānamathocyatemañjarī tu dvibhāgābhyāṃ mañjaryardhena nāsikāpañcāṃśaistatpṛthutvaṃ ca tathordhvastryaṃśakairgalaḥkramādgrīvādikocchrayaḥdhāmārdhātbhramaṇa kāryā tadardhena ca bhittayaḥmaṇḍapārdhapramāṇena purato mukhamaṇḍapaḥcatuṣkikāgrato nityaṃ jagatī dhāmamānataḥtatsamā balabhī diksthāḥ svamānamaṇḍapānvitāḥprāsādaturyabhāgena tryaṃśairvā tatsamucchrayamtaducchrayaṃ haraṃ kṛtvā sādhāṃśe khura [gh: kṣura] paṭṭikā'śaṃguṇaṃ bhavettṛtīyenopapaṭṭī tu tapāṃśā [kh: tathāṅgā] ccaturasrikātaddhyaṃśamaṣṭadhā kṛtvā taiśca padmaṃ vivartayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇikā śaśibhāgena vistārāccādhunocyatetanmadhye tu dvibhāgābhyāṃ praveśo gṛha [g: graha] hetaveevameva tu jaṅghāyāmañjaryā vedikāvadhiḥprāsādaśikharaṃ vāpi brūyāmuparathādikānpīṭhādyabjāntamucchrāye praveśaśca nigadyateardhena paṭṭikāṃ kuryāddvābhyāṃ kaṇṭhapraveśakamardhāṃśena tadūrdhve tu kāryā caivopapaṭṭikātryāṅghripraveśo haṃsa [gh: dvyaṃśa] statpaṭṭyardhapraveśataḥsandhipatrānvitaṃ [kh: ṅkita] padmaṃ vidadhīta suśobhanamśilotthaṃ padapīṭhaṃ syādevaṃ dārviṣṭakāmayetaducchrayaṃ grahaṃ kṛtvā jaṅghā tanmadhyato guṇaiḥvedibandhavaraṇḍā [mū, a: vavaṇḍā] dinnigadāmyanupūrvaśaḥucchraye dhāmaturyāṃśāttasminnidrāṃśakekṛtesārdhatrayeṇa kumbhaḥ syāttadardhe kumbhapaṭṭikābhāgārdhena tu kaṇṭhaḥ syātkalaśaśca guṇāṃśataḥpraveśāccaikataḥ kaṇṭhāścārdhe [mū: sārdhe] nirgamapaṭṭikākumbhapaṭṭī tu pādena kupālyā dyaṃśataḥ sthitātribhiḥ khurādibhiryuktaṃ vedībandhābhidhānakamkṛteṣu triṣu bhāgeṣu pādonāṃśātpraveśikānbhāgena caturasrākhyā paṭṭikā sārdhataḥ sthitākhuṃrakumbhavatī jaṅghā jyeṣṭhānāṃ pādamānataḥyāvaccinnavakāṃ vāpi patravalyāthavā varācaturthāṃśaśca jaṅghordhve vibhajya vasubhāgataḥtatrārdhena praveśākhyaṃ paṭṭikāṃ tu vi [kh: bhuvi] vartayetpādonāṃśena haṃsākhyā [kh; hastākhyā] paṭṭī tatpadato bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatpaṭṭī pādataḥ kāryā pādonāṃśena nirgamābhāgamekaṃ tridhā kṛtvā praveśaścaika bhāgataḥpaṭṭikā tu prakartavyā dvitīyenopanirgamābalitāhvaṃ tribhi [kh: ṅkāstribhi] rbhāgairgrahāṃśaistu kaṭirbhavetkaṇṭhasūtrādviśetkaṭho bhāgāttatpaṭṭikordhvaḥ [mū: kārdhataḥ]bhūmerjaṅghānitambau ca kīrtitau tvaṣṭṭa śāstrataḥtadadhaḥ sārdhapakṣāṃśaṃ vistāreṇa tu kārayetekaikena tu bhāgega viśetkaṇṭhaka [kh, ṅ: kaṃ kaṇṭha] sūtrataḥbhavedanurathaḥ ṣadbhiḥ saptamenodakāntaramkoṇānurathakādīnāṃ vṛttapraveśa ucyatetadvaccaturthabhāgena praveśo'nurathasya caluptvā bhāgān bhuvāṃ svāṃ svāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca yathākramampādonadvyaṃśataḥ kumbhastatpaṭṭī pādato bhavetkumbhopame ca te kārye churikāpakṣayostathāpādena kumbhapaṭṭī tu cārdhena galapaṭṭikākumbhārdhena tathā paṭṭī kaṇṭhastatpaṭṭīkārdhataḥtrikaṇṭhakocchrayaṃ dvābhyāṃ pakṣayostatra vartayetmastaṃ] lavalīphalavadbhavetnirgamākhyā parāṃśena [gh: parārdhena] caturasrāṃśato bhavettanmadhye tilakaṃ kāryamevaṃ tryaṃśairvaraṇḍikārūpaṃ koṇarathasyaivaṃ vakṣye coparathaṃ tvataḥkumbhaikenārdhataḥ paṭṭī kaṇṭhaścārdhāṃśatastathāvṛttapaṭṭī ca niṣkrāntā bhāgabhāgena kalpayetaṃśe gartālakaṃ tajña tatpārśvayorguṇāṃśataḥūrdhvādhastilakākrāntā madhyasthānordhvataḥ sthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturbhāgaiścaturbhāgaiḥ śeṣānyāścandraśālikāevaṃ pañcadaśākhyātāḥ pañcabhūmīnduśālikāḥsārdhena madhyatastatra rathakārdhaṃ samudgatasṣaṣṭibhāgasamucchāyaṃ kuryādardhenduśālikāmkumbhapaṭṭīṃ tathā kaṇṭhamardhena parikalpayettathā kāryā bhāgabhāgena nirmitākhaneśca tilakopetaṃ tadbāhye'rdhenduśālikātanmadhye śikharī dvyaṃśā ucchritātimanoramātatpārśvārdhārathe'pyevaṃ kartavyārdhendaśālikāuparyupari ca trīṇi ekaṃ [mū, a, kh, g, ṅ: evaṃ] bhūsūtratulyataḥmadhyarathasya karmedaṃ vedikādyamathocyatepādātpraveśapaṭṭī syānnirgamā paṭṭikāṅghritaḥpādena caturasrāsyātsā garbhārdhapravistarāhaṃsākhyāntārdhasūtrācca ṣaḍvibhāgastaducchrayaḥkapolādaṃśaniṣkāśādamalāsāravistaraḥardhena galapaṭṭī ca upapaṭṭyaparārdhataḥdvābhyāṃ cāmalasārākhyaṃ parito vṛttamucchritamekena caturasrā syād dvābhyāṃ haṃsakapotikāsabhūtāṃśaistribhiḥ kāryo ghaṭastaddviguṇocchrayaḥtvāttathaiva] ca (?)kvacidbhairavanāṭyeśagauryarko dakṣiṇāditaḥtatkaṭyardhasamucchrāyaṃ pravibhajyāṣṭabhāgataḥtryaṃśakaiścandraśālāṃ dvayaṃśato madhyataḥ puramevaṃ tatpārśvataḥ kāryāścārdhenduśālikādayaḥvāstubhūṣaṇamaśmotthamuktamanyāni ca bruve
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: likhitapustakeṣu nāsti] ṣaḍviṃśo vidhiḥrathakernavasapteṣusaṅkhyairarkamatād bruverandhrādi vasusaptāṃśairmadhyārdharathako grahaiḥrathakāḥ sārdhacatvāraścatvāraśca chalāgamāḥtataścaikaikasantyāgāt ṣaḍaṇḍaṃ nava [g, gh: nnannava] bhūmikāḥvidyādharāmarairyuktaṃ syādevaṃ jyeṣṭhakhadrumaḥupākhyaḥ sāṅgribāṇena munibhi [gh: saptabhiḥ] ścāṇukaṃ bhavetjalāntaraṃ tribhirevaṃ jalārdhaṃ tvekameva [kh: tvevameva] tukāmāṃśaiḥ prathamābhūmirekaikahrāsayogataḥcandraśālādi pratrāḍhyā pūrvavadvedikā bahiḥbhūtāṃśena tu koṇaḥ syādvedenoparathastathāevaṃ śeṣārdhakaṃ kāryaṃ pañcabhūrathakānvitamrūpanāśātkramādanyā vasvantāḥ pañcabhūmayaḥkṛtvaikenatu saṃveśamādyaḥ koṇaratho bhavetpañcamī rathakairdhāma tathānyadbhūta bhāgataḥ [gh: gaśaḥekaikena praveśastu dvābhyāṃ madhyardhago rathaḥvistaro vedyadhoḥ yaḥ syāttathā mañjarikocchritiḥadhamo navabhāgaiḥ syātsthūlāmadhyakṛśāstridhātatulyā kanyase dhāmni śikharaṃ dviguṇaṃ triṣusārdhadviguṇapādonā triguṇā mañjarī tridhāteṣāṃ koṇadvayaṃ bāṇairekaikena jalacyutiḥmadhyaratho (') hi bhāgena kāryo viṃśatibhāgikaḥanyā diggrahabhāgaiḥ syādbhūmikā pūrvavadvarācaturaṣṭāsravṛttāśca tadbhedāścāpare trayaḥhimāṃśukaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karoṭaṃ [mū, a, g: kavāṭaṃ; k: kalphoṭaṃ] muṇḍamālaṃ ca kaṅkoṭaṃ khaḍgarāvaṇam [mū, a: vāraṇam]ghorāṭṭahāsamucchiṣṭaṃ ghurghuraṃ duṣṭatrāsakam [mū, a: duṣkṛtāsanam]yamaghaṇṭaṃ ca bhūtāhvaṃ [mū: bhūtāṅgaṃ; kh: bhūtājyaṃ] viṣabhedamajātajampunarlakṣavibhedana grabhinnaḥ śāstrasaṅgrahaḥṛṣibhyo mānuṣāḥ śiṣyāḥ sarvaśāstrāvatārakāḥiti sāmayikaṃ proktaṃ śambhunāgamapañcakamekatrabhojanaṃ ghore vāme vāmāmṛtaṃ tathāācaret samayān pañca yaḥ sa ācārya ucyatetadavaśyaṃ hi kartavyamanyathā patanaṃ bhavetṣaṭkarmāṇi tu kāryāṇi śivācāryeṇa no paraiḥdīkṣāṃ ca sthāpanaṃ ceti [mū: caiva] ṣaṭkarmāṇi sadā guroḥkrośān pañca parityajya gurvādeśāttadācaretsādhakaḥ sādhayetsiddhirācāryo dīkṣayetpaśūnpratiṣṭhādikriyā tasya na pāṭhādagra [mū, a: pāṭhānnaivāgra; kh: nayāvadagra; g: yāvanta vipra] janmanaḥyuktiḥ saṃsūcyate kācidyā coktā pārameśvarenāśmādau śivatā tatra hyāṃśave dūrataḥ śivaḥcāṇḍālo'sāvabhojyānnaḥ pātakī nātra saṃśayaḥ [kh, gh: nārakī bhavet]anyagotre [mū, a: śrotre; k: tyāśre] kuśā [kh: tre'ṅkuśā] pātānnārakī syād dvijādhamaḥp. 34) liṅgādisthāpakā ye ca te cāṇḍālasamā dvijāḥmantavyo vipravacchūdraḥ śūdrātpāpatarastu saḥvṛttātsiddhā vasiṣṭhādyā vyāsenoktaṃ ca bhāratenarake patati kṣipraṃ kartā svapitṛbhiḥ sahasvabrāhmaṇyaṃ gataṃ teṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ [brahmahatvaṃ, li, pu] ca saṃsthitamte krūrā dhvaṃsakā jñeyā yajamānakṣayāvahāḥdānārcanādyanarhaḥ syādvinaṣṭā brāhmaṇī [mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: naṣṭo brāhmaṇo] yathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etebhyo'ṣṭādaśānye syuruttamādyāstu [gh: dyāṃśca] vacmi tāngauḍā iti ca ṣoḍhaite prāsādāśca sarekhakāḥgāndhāro bhaumajaścāpi prāsādāḥ ṣaṭ smṛtāstvimeavyaktavyaktamiśrāṇāṃ liṅgāṇāṃ syātkramādgṛhammānikam]uttamādikaraiśca syādekaikasya tridhā gatiḥhīnapravyātmakaṃ neṣṭaṃ krūraṃ mānādhike sthitamvṛttaśṛṅgenduśālākhyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ daśadhocyategāndhāraśuddhadhāmāni liṅgametatpramāṇataḥete navati [mū: navani] vandhārāḥ prasādā liṅgamānataḥśrīvatsokapa [mū: strovatso rūpa] nandākhyāstvete vairājajā navavṛṣebhahasatārkṣyāntāḥ kramātsyurnavabhedataḥ [kh: bhavedataḥ]vajrastripiṣṭapaścandrātpadma'rkā [gh: padmārkau] dvalayo hariḥaṣṭādaśa pradhānācca prāsādāstūbhayātmakāḥmālyāvānmalayaścaiva supārśvo merurambhavāḥsadāśrīvatsādvardhamānākhyo mālā śrīvatsasaṃjñakaḥśālāgṛhaṃ viśālaṃ ca brahmamandiramandire [kh: maṇḍale]ardhagṛhaṃ kuṭīrākhyaṃ sthitikṛcca gṛhādhipātcakraṃ svastikasaṃjñācca vijayaḥ sapta [kh, ṅ, gh: sasta] vajrajāḥdundubhī mukulī cakramuṣṇīṣī śaṅkhasaṃjñakaḥṛkṣako bhūṣaṇaścaiva bhūdharaḥ śrījayastathāprāsādā bāṇaśāstroktāstvetadbhedo'tivistaraḥuktāni bhedabhinnāni dhāmnāṃ vai pārameśvareprāsādo brahmaṇo'pyukto natvanyeṣāṃ kadācana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekadvāro yugāsraśca prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥvṛtto maheśvarasyoktaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ na kasyacitprāsādo vartulaḥ proktaḥ īśvarasya na kasyacitcaturdvāraḥ punarayaṃ bhavasya brahmaṇastathāekadvārāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve prasādā lakṣaṇānvitāḥsarvāsāṃ pratimānāṃ tu prāsādāḥ samudāhṛtāḥrudrāṃśaiśca krauḍabhittiṃ grahā/śaiḥ suśiraṃ tathābhāgaikaikaṃ kramāttyaktvā evamānandanādbhavetdvārtriṃśajjinabhūpāṣṭacandrāśaiśca navāṃśakesuśiraścārkabhāgaiśca viṃśadṛkṣaiśca bhittayaḥparito ghaṭanāttatra na kāryā kuḍya pīḍanārandhrāddhi rāmabhāgaiḥ syādrathaṃkāṇāṃ vyavasthitiḥparitaśca caturdikṣu karmādyā rathakā navanitambaskandhayormadhye dviśatābhyāṃ vibhajya cacandraśālānvitāpyevaṃ yāvatṣoḍaśabhūmayaḥpūrvavatsaśalaṃ merorvedāsyaśataśṛṅgiṇaḥtaddvāramānato'nyasya liṅgaṃ navakaraṃ tathāprāggrīvanirgamārdhena dairghyaṃ siṃhasya kīrtitamvistarocchrāyamānena kartavyo mastakocchrayaḥprāggrīvanirgamenaiva nāsāgraṃ tasya nirgatam [mū: nirgamaḥ]grīvādhārā bhavedvedī prāsādārdhapravistarātsvamānavistārāyāmā mastakanyastapucchakāsiṃhāḥ svalakṣaṇepetāḥ kartavyāḥ kesarāvintāḥlambanena samāyuktāścandraśālāsamāsrakāḥmātṛbhirgaṇavidyeśairbhuṣayennavarbhūmikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmātkuryādapāṃ mārge dve dve randhrai mahīkramātrāmāṃśaistatra piṇḍī syādṛtuvedayamāṃśakaiḥniṣkrāntirdiśadiśyaiva navaiva rathakā matāḥkṛtvāṣṭādaśabhirbhūḥ syādanyaikaikaṃ vinā kramātcaturdvāraṃ caturnāsaṃ vicitrakuharairyutamdaśonaśataśṛṅgaṃ ca vidadhyānmandaraṃ sudhīḥguṇaṃ rūpaṃ tadagre ca [kh, ṅ: bhūḥ] tiryagvahniṃ vināśayettadvalluptvā [kh: llabdhvā] ntare madhyārdharathaṃ sthāpayejjalaiḥmādivatśeṣaikaikaparityāgādarkabhūmīsamucchrayamaśītiśṛṅgasayuktaṃ kailāsaṃ ghaṭayedvaramtrikṣayādvāmataḥ koṇastayostambhastanukṣayātitthamevāparārdhaṃ syāccatu [mū: ca catu] rdikṣu samantataḥsakapāṭārgalairvedaghaṭairnāga [mū: ghaṭanāṅga] gavākṣakaiḥtadūrdhvaikaikasaṃhrāsātkartavyā bhūmayo daśakuharāṇi surairmadhye rathake syurvimānakaudvāraikāṣṭa [gh: kāṅghri] samādyeśaḥ (?) saptatibhirviṣāṇakaiḥbhāgaikaikena saṃveśāttryaṃśaiścoparadhau matausāndhāraścaturāsyaśca vedā"ghro bhramaṇānvitaḥvidyādhārākulai ramyairbhadraḥ syāt ṣaṣṭiśṛṅgavānbhadrabhāgairmahābhadraḥ proktaḥ sopānaśobhitaḥupariṣṭādvimānāṃśaḥ [mū, a, ṅ: nātma] kramato merumandarausarvātmā śikharaiḥ kāryaḥ sarvatobhadrako yataḥcaturghaṭasamopetaḥ sopānavalabhīyutaḥ [kh, gh: mukhaḥkūṭānvitenduśālā syāda digdvārāṅghryāsyako rucaḥ

sanskrit: koṇaṃ caiva vibhāgataḥ]ratho dhāmāṅkito bhūśca kuharīmadhyago rathaḥ [gh: rave]bhṛgādayaḥ sahe [kh: sade] tyevaṃ śrīvatsaḥ syāddhareḥ priyaḥsiṃhaskandho'malāsārairyuktaḥ kāryo gṛhādhipaḥnānāsurākulo ramno [mū, a, ṅ: varmyo] nandanaḥ suranandanaḥkramātryugairjalaiḥvalabhīcandraśālāsyā catu [gh: vadyā catu] rnāsāsyasaṃyutābherīnduśālikā dvābhyāṃ meruṇā [gh: mekena] śikharonnatiḥkaṅkaṭāṃśaṃ tu saṅkocya śikharaṃ dakṣabhāgataḥmervādyābhāḥ kvacitkāryāḥ ṣaṭsiṃhāḥ kumbhamastakādviṣaṭkapārśvayoryojyaṃ dvau dvau prāṇārthamagrataḥghrācalasyake [kh, c: valabhya]garbhavṛtto'rthavedāsro aṣṭāṃśo vā surādhipevṛtto vābjena saṃyuktaḥ ṣoḍaśārdha [gh: śordhva] dalena caekadvāraikanāsaśca padmanāmā surālayaḥvṛttaḥ san valayāhvaḥ syātparito valayānvitaḥhoma'marapriyaḥ]nāsāgarbhaśca vedāsrau pañcabhūmyucchrayo vṛṣaḥjaṅgayā ca vimānasya kaṭyā bhadrāhvayasya cakartu [gh: kāntā] ricchā vaśādanyo nyastavyo vā śubhapradaḥpakṣasaṃyutāsasaryaṃ kaṭikaṇṭhāsyaṃ viṣṭiṣṭe [gh: ṣṇviṣṭe] tviṣṭakāmayedikṣu sarve balabhyādyāḥ sopānajagatīyutāḥūrdhve cārdhena haṃsaḥ syādgarbhatulyā tu vedikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gh: kṛtyatha]kakṣapuṭopamāsre tu grīvāmastakabhūṣitaḥnāgarīsadṛśī lāṭī kintu sā dārunirmitāpramāṇānnāgarīṃ kṛtvā [g: dhṛtvā] vārāṭīṃ kīrtitā budhaiḥmekhalāntarapatrāṇi drāviḍī sā nigadyateprāsādapādaniṣkāśāsyapaṭṭavakulīyutā [mū: matā]ityuktā kiñciduddeśātsthūlarūpeṇa śāstrataḥśuddhā [kh: śubhā] eva tu kartavyāḥ prayatnena matāntareprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ nāsādvāramathocyatevidhiḥgarbhānugarbhasūtrārdhā [gh: trādvā] nāsāvistaracoditāḥyugartuvasukāṣṭhāṃśairgarbhasyārdhena mānataḥtoyāntarasamopetā bhāgaiḥ prāsādavattridhācchivukā] nvitāḥsaṃskṛtya sthāpanāyeddevāṃścandragarbhe tu pūrvavataṣṭādaśāṃśa [mū, ṅ: daśāsra] santyāgatparidhau śukanāsikāsarvakāmaprasidhdyarthaṃ pūrvameva tu kārayetkrūrakarmaṇi yāmye ca tathā kuryādvidakṣu tat [g: ca]vyaktāvyaktayorapikuryād dvāraṃ caturdikṣu brāhmavedāsyaliṅgayoḥdigvalabhīnduyāmyāsyātkoṇadhāmācca saṃukhāḥturyarasāhi [mū: rasādi] bhāgena jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamaṃ kramātekadvitrikarādīnāṃ dvāraṃ syālliṅgamānataḥuttamaṃ kanyase dvāraṃ garbhamānādathocyatehīnādīnāṃ bhaved dvāraṃ garbhakaṇṭha [kh, gh: karṇa] vibhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ucchrayo dviguṇo dvārādanyathāvāsaṃ ucyatedvārāṇi daśa siddhāni catvāryagrāṇi [mū, a, g: bhrāṇi] teṣu caucchrayārdhena vistāra ucchrayo vā tridhādhikaḥucchrayārdhena vistīrṇā śākhā viṣamasaṅkhyayāśākhāpṛthutvamaṅnyūnaṃ dalaṃ bāhukayormatammahārcādhāmni keṣāñcidrudraśākhānvitaṃ matamdaṇḍaśākhā rasāṃśena tamākhyāśrama [gh: traya] bhāgikāmarīcī yugmataḥ kāryā mūlākhyā viṣapeṇa tusarvāndha [mū, ṅ: nu] kārikāveśo mūlaśākhāsamo bhavetvibhajya dvārabāhyā ca bhūtā syāddaṇḍaśākhikātsārdhāmbuvistareṇa tudvipraveśātpṛthutveśo stambhaśākhābhavediyamviṣaṣeṇa tu (?)sapādadvyaṃśavistārā marīcīṣupraveśataḥśobhānurūpataḥ kāryāḥ paṭṭikādyāstu śilpibhiḥdaṇḍāndhakārikānāma [gh, ṅ: nāga] śāntākhyā rūpaśākhikāandhakārī tu rūpākhyā cāndhakārī marīcikāsārdhabhūtāṃśasārdhaikayugaikasārdhavāribhiḥbāṇāṃśānmūlaśākhā ca daṇḍāddatupraveśanamvicakṣaṇauḥdhvāntākhyā patraśākhā ca tathāndhakārikā punaḥpatraśākhā kramātkāryā sārdheṣusārdhacandravattanuturyaśaśāṅkākhyabāṇaikajalasaṅkhyayāsapteṣumunirandhrāṇi rudrakaiḥdaṇḍāndhakārikānāgatamastambhāndhakārikā

sanskrit: nāgāndhakārīkāhvaṃ ca stambhāndhakārikā punaḥandhākhyā tu marīcyaṅkā mūlaśākheti kīrtitāvedaikasārdhairvedaistu bhavāmburūpa [kh, gh: tapa] turyakaiḥsārdhāmbunā sthitirjñeyā śākhādvārikayoḥ kramātmūlavat]jāhravīyamune cāpi tatpārśve bhāravāhikāyugmakaiḥśobhayadyatnataḥ śākhāstadhanayaiśca suśobhanaiḥprathamodumbare (?) sthāpyāḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitāḥgrahāśca mātāro vevyo nādyavyāpārasaṃsthitāḥlalāṭaṃ śobhanaṃ cordhvaṃ nāgadantānvitaṃ dṛḍhamdvārocchrayārdhapādena karapādadvayena vātribhirguṇagiritryaṃśairdvi dvibhāge khuradvayam[gh: aṇḍajam]kāryaścaturyamāṃśaiśca dehalī vyāghrapaṭṭikāsarva [mū: sa ca] vedhavināśāya kiñciduttarato nyasettasmāttadvarjanānārthāya gurorjñātvaṃ [kh: rājñā] taducyaterathyā [mū, gh: ratha] viddhe pravāsaḥ syāccatuṣpathena rūkṣatāvṛkṣeṇa vittanāśaśca [gh: stu] stambhena parabhṛtyatākoṇena rājadaṇḍaḥ syād vibhramo dvāraśākhayāśatrorbhayaṃ ca kūpena devabiddheba bandhanambhasmanā paśunāśaḥ syādvardhamānena govyadhāvaktreṇa ca suhṛ [gh: cakrena vasu] dogastvālindaśravaṇena bhīḥkṛtamityarthaḥ)] śvabhreṇātha sutakṣayaḥkaṇḍanyā [kuṇḍalyā] dhananāśaḥ syācchilābiddhe rujā tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uccaprākāradānena tacchedoddharaṇena vāśalyasthā vāthavātyuccā kartāraṃ hanti dehalīliṅgārdhocchayanī kāryā sārcāyāṃ pīṭhikocchrayāadhaśca vistṛte dvāre ruk syāt strīvātha cañcalākṣayaṃ pipīlikāmadhyaṃ kulaghnaṃ śaṅkhakaṇṭhakambhinna śākhe kṣayodvāre digbhrānte sthānavibhramaḥjarjare viparīte vā dhananāśaḥ sadā naresvayamudvāṭite tadvat pīḍitāhitatā [g: dvitatā] nanātdvāra [kh: vāma] biddhaṃ tyajedveśma kulakṣayabhayātsadābedhyabedhakayorvāstvostyaktvā dviguṇamantaramsarveṣāṃ śubhadā yāśca dvārādīnāṃ ca tā bruvetāvekīkṛtya saṃchindyāttrīṣvadryaṣṭābhireva vāviṣādaśceti cādryaṃśe phalaṃ saptasu [gh: sapteṣu] dehināmviṣamāḥ śubhadāstatra samāścāniṣṭakarmasudhūmaḥścā ca kharo dhvāṅkṣaḥ samā ete vidik sthitāḥdhvajaḥstrīputrārthān vṛṣo dadyādaśeṣasukhadaḥ [gh, ṅ: śubhadaḥ] karīvyādhimṛtyupradātoktaḥ sārameyo'rthagotrahṛtkṛśatāraukṣyadāridryaṃ sarvāniṣṭakaraḥ kharaḥśokamohakalivyādhibandhādikṛcca vāyasaḥāyāṃśca yojayejjñātvā syādāyaścottamo yathākṛtvaivaṃ sthāpayed dvāraṃ prāguktavidhipūrvakamitareṣāṃ ca karmādyairnottamānāṃ samaṇḍapaiḥstambhāddhinādayaśca syuḥ sapta [saptā li0 pū0] viṃśatirevahirucakākhyaśca vedāsrastvaṣṭāsro vajrasaṃjñakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāmānyaḥsthambha ityeṣa [kh: tyevaṃ] yojanīyastu kanyaseprāsādamānapādonāt stambhocchrāyaḥ kvacinmataḥmadhye hārāvalībhiḥ syuruparyamalasārakaiḥjaṅghālaṃbanyadhobhāgāducchrayānmaṇḍapo bhavetsāmānyātsarvaśāstreṣu ye proktāstān vadāmyataḥbhadrakaḥśuśīlaśca viśālaśca yajñabhadraḥ śrutīśvaraḥ [gh: dharaḥśrīvatsaśca jayaścaiva jayabhadro'tha buddhibhṛtstambhakramāt kaniṣṭhādyā uktāḥ śāstrānusārataḥtanmadhye cordhvatastadvadekadvitrivimānakāḥtryasravṛttārdhacandrābhavasvasraṣoḍaśāsrakaḥsarvāṇyetāni dadyācca phalāni caturasrakaḥvalabhīchandako yāmye nair-ṛtyāṃ garuḍaḥ smṛtaḥpurāgajastu saumyāyāṃ tathaiśyāṃ sarvabhadrakaḥcaturasrādike bhede kuṇḍavṛtte vivartitaḥsārdhaitāḥ sādhane yojyā liṅgāni nānyathā kvacitmadhyamādyā dvivṛddhyā ca vibhajetkāmabhāgataḥstambhānvitāḥ puraḥ pṛṣṭhe tryaṃśaistryaṃśaiśca garbhakāḥtayorbhittī tathāṃśena tryaṃśairdāraṃ ca madhyataḥsatu lopakulaṃ kuryāccatur [g: dvṛtta] bhittīśca koṇagāḥmattavāraṇasaṃyuktamūrdhvaṃ mūrdhvamucchadanānvitamsapadmakalaśaṃ kuryāccitrākhyaṃ nṛtyamandiramcūrṇairmāṣodbhavaistathāpaścādāstṛṇuyāt sudhīḥyāvaddarpaṇasaṃkāśaṃ śaivālaiśchādayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśrāmyaikāṃ tato [g: mya kārutāṃ] rātriṃ gomayena vilepayetśaṇaphalyāṅghikāṣāyai [g: sādyai] stopalatārasena vāutsvinna [mū: utsvinya] māṣatoyena svinnabilvāmbunāpi vātataścolūkhalādyaistu sthūlacūrṇāni kārayetsthālyāgarbhe tu saṃsthāpya tato drayāṇi niḥkṣipetsikrāta [mū, gh, ṅ: sikatā] gavyadugdhāni sarjatailātasīrajaḥāmrātakāmbubhiḥ piṣṭaṃ sthūlāsyā dugdhi [g: vāru] kāhvayākvāthena meṣaśṛṅgasya atasīcūrṇamiśritamvajralepaḥ samakhyātastathā sarjasamanvitaḥmadhūcchiṣṭena kalkaiśca śāṇajaiḥ sudṛḍhairnavaiḥatasītailasammiśraṃ mardayitvā supācitamsuraveśmagṛhādīnāṃ bhūmibandho nigadyatesthiratoyopamā kāryā bhūmistu sutalā samātatkalkaṃ kārayet piṇḍaṃ viśoṣyaṃ piṇḍamātapetato maṇḍena saṃmardya bhūmibandhaṃ tu kārayetkuryād bhūmiṃ samaṃ ramyaṃ susthitaṃ jalapūritamdravyaṃ kālānurūpeṇa yojayedbhāgasammitamgrīyme nu pañcabhāgāḥ syuḥ śītakāle tathā trayaḥevaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ bandho'tra kathitaḥ kṣiteḥtoyena hatakūrcaṃ tu dāpayettadvicakṣaṇaḥśālmalītindukādīnāṃ bhūmibandhe praśasyatetāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi kartā nandati tatpure [gh: tpuram]pañcamaḥ kāladaṇḍākhyaḥ sānvayāḥ phaladāyakāḥvibhrāntiṃ vibhramaḥ kuryācchāsakaḥ śāsayetsadāete suragṛhe vighnā yāvatte tu na pūjitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadvadvedāḥ kuviprasthāḥ kartuḥ syuraśubhapradāḥete śaivāḥ samākhyātā na tvete brāhmaṇāḥ kvacitsaṃskṛtānāṃ yatasteṣāṃ naśyante pūrvajātayaḥp. 35) pṛthaṅmantrāgamāveṣāṃ [mū, a, k, kh: -ścaiṣāṃ] vratāni kratavaḥ pṛthakmugdhāḥ kurvanti ye viprāḥ śivādisthāpanaṃ kalautathaiva śivayāgeṣu na mantrā vaidikādayaḥna dvāraṃ maṇḍapādiśca sthāpanaṃ na śivādiketasmācchaivena mantreṇa pratiṣṭheta [mū, a: pratiṣṭheyaṃ] śivādikamśivamantraistayoḥ samyak śivatvaṃ nānyamantrataḥnānyadarśanamantrairvā pratiṣṭhā syācchivasya tuna ca śaivīkriyā vede na ca khaḍgadisiddhayaḥagniṣṭomādayo yajñā vedoktā īśvareṇa tusiddhāntasthāpanaṃ dīkṣāṃ noktaṃ vedeṣu śaṃbhunāsvamantrabījajā devā na bavhakṣaraḍambarāt [mū, a, k, g: na ca hṛtkaṇṭhaḍambaraiḥ]naite śivādhvatattvajñāḥ stāvakā janarañjakāḥstutyaiva sthāpanaṃ na syācchivaliṅge calācale [carācare, li. pu. pā.]śaivācāryaistu sā kāryā rudrabrahmārkacakriṇāmyakṣarākṣasayoginyo gaṇā gauryastathāparāḥsvasaṃvedye [kh: sukhaṃ vede] 'pi rāgāndhā dvijā īśvaranindakāḥte'pi tyājyāḥ pratiṣṭhādau dūrādbauddhadvijādayaḥśivādisthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ nānyaistu brāhmaṇādibhiḥp. 37) svakarmābhiratā viprāḥ śaivādyāḥ kāpilāntakāḥsvaṣaṭkarmānvito nityaṃ nānyakarmā dvijo bhavetadhyāpanamiti syuśca ṣaṭkarmāṇi sadā dvijetṛṇādimūlyabhikṣānnavṛttiḥ syābrāhmaṇo varaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgairāvṛtāḥ sarve vighnaghnā balihomakaiḥtasmādādau ca santarpyāḥ śrāddhe nānvīmukhāstathāsthalajaṃ gotrasambhūtaṃ śilābhedasamaṃ dhanamṅ: kākānti] bhedakamvipulaṃ bahuśākhāṅgaṃ [kh: lākhyaṃ] lakṣaṃ komalamadrijamtṛtīyaṃ padmamardhajaṃ [mū: vardhaja] lakṣmaitattilakasya casphāraṃ kuṭilasaṃ [ṅ: lajaṃ] sarpi pronnataṃ vitataṃ sphuṭampañcadhā daśarekhābhiḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sakala [kh, gh: sabala] rūpakamkalinda [gh: kāliṅga] koladaṣṭrārdraṃ kaṇṭakaiḥ paritairyutamkaṇṭakairmeṣaśṛṅgābhaiḥ patraṃ bālābhajaṃ bhavetkaṇṭhakaṃ]śvapucchavacca vṛttāgraṃ mārjāramukha [kh: nakha] bhaṅguramaurvāru [kh, gh: airvāru] tantuvṛttāgraṃ kaṇṭhakaṃ sarpasarpaṇamvistṛtaṃ kuñcitāgraṃ ca śvetaṃ raktāsyaśobhitamgranthipatrāṅkurairyuktaṃ viparyastaiḥsadordhvagamkvacicchinaṃ kvacidbhinnaṃ kvacit patrārdhaveṣṭitampūrvoktavallicitrāḍhyaṃ hṛdyaṃ cāru surekhitammūlemadhya tathāgre ca vṛddhaṃ taruṇaśākhikamśilpibhirguṇitaṃ kṛtvā paścāt patrāṇi saṃlikhetpu0 nāsti] triṃśo vidhiḥyajettadvāstu [mū, gh: dardhastu] devāṃśca vedāsre rudrabhākikedikpadeṣu marīcyādyā madhye tattveṣu vedhasasbrahmasthāne site padme [mū, ṅ: pakṣe] kālāgniṃ pūjayettataḥhāṭakeśaṃ baleśaṃ [ṅ: caleśaṃ] ca punaścātibalaṃ tathāsaptamaṃ ca virūpākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīśaṃ daleṣu ca

sanskrit: karkoṭāntaṃ svamantreṇa pūjayejjaladiggṛhennāgāṣṭakāṃstataḥ [kh: tathā]śaṅkhaṃ vāsukiṃ caiva padmaṃ karkoṭakāntakampañcagavyakamvādhisārdhakām]susnāpya gandhavastrādyaiḥ saṃpūjyānantamantrataḥviṃśa; g, gh: vaṃśa]hū/ hū/ anantāya [kh: anantanāgāya] nāgādhipataye namaḥkhurikenāvadhāryeṣa [mū, a, ṅ: jyeṣṭha] guhyenāmbhasi vā kṣipetkapilāpuccha [kh, g: vāmadevaṃ] lagno'tra santaredyajamānakaḥtataścāṣṭaśataṃ homaṃ bahurūpeṇa homayetcaruṃ saṃśādhayettena śāntiṃ tenaiva kārayettāṃ ca gāṃ gurave dadyāt toṣayecca [gh: khāgnyena] svavittataḥdikṣvarkeṣu marīcyādyān madhyeṣaṭpadakeṣvajam [gh: dhvajaḥ]tanmadhye kālarudreśaṃ pūjya gandhādipūrvavatpañcagavyaṃ kṣipetkūpe gaṅgāmantrāmbunā sahakarāntarasthadārvībhirdhaṭībhirdārucakrakamprasuptaṃ yāgapūrvakamudyāneṣu surāgre vā [kh, ṅ: greṣu] dikṣu kūpaṃ ca pūrvavatkṣepaṇaṃ vapanaṃ yacca savyāsavyena kārayetsvaistārakaiḥ prakuryācca tilairhomaṃ ca madhyagaiḥpūrvāgāre'tha hotavyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣadaivatambāṇamatātsamādāya likhitaṃ ca tadakṣaraiḥ[nāmeti śabdo li0 pu0 nāsti] katriṃśo vidhiḥpavitrārohaṇaṃ [mū: ropaṇaṃ] kāryaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ caran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrārka [kh: rudrāṇaṃ] śaṅkarāṇāṃ ca caṇḍīyamaviḍaujasāmasarveśvara [kh: ṣveva] pitṛṇāṃ ca pavitrārohaṇaṃ matammṛdbhasmavastrapatrādi tathā sūtraṃ ca saptadhāpādma kārpāsajaṃ sūtraṃ dvijakanyādinirmitamdaśāṅgulāntarāgranthiścaikaikāṅgulihānitaḥṣṭāṣṭahānitaḥrocanākuṅkumāktaiśca madacandraistu śaktitaḥtritattve trīṇi kāryāṇi caturthaṃ cāvalaṃbajamsarvārthapūraṇaṃ dadyāt pṛṣṭhapīṭhe caturthakamsthaṇḍile hariśambhostu dale kesarakoṇakesūtraiśca granthayo'nyeṣāṃ tathā daśaika [g: dalaika] hānitaḥvṛṣasya śṛṅgapādāntaṃ pavitraṃ liṅgavanmatamitareṣāṃ tu devānāṃ pavitraṃ syāt trisūtrakam [gh: trakaiḥ]kvacidvitastimātraṃ ca śatārdhārdhārdhasūtrakam [kh, gh: trakaiḥ]dvijārkajinasaṃkhyābhiḥ sthirasthaṇḍilagehināmkaniṣṭhāmūlakakṣāntaṃ skandhanābhyūrdhvamānakampavitrārohaṇaṃ kuryādiṣṭamantraistritattvataḥdadyāt pavitrakaṃ tadvadvahnyādidikṣu cetaraiḥtripañcasūtrakairvāpi hṛdā cāmantrarṇa vibhoḥ [k, kh, ṅ: prabhoḥ]gṛhāṇemāṃ mahādeva samastavidhikāraṇapañcagavyaṃ kamātteṣu tālacandranalohakamhomadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sakuśānyaparāparānanetāmbūlaṃ guhyake dadyāt sājyaṃ caru nare punaḥaiśānyāmāsanaṃ chatraṃ pāduke yogapaṭṭakampātraṃ kṛtvā pavitrāṇi prokṣitāni śivāmbhasā

sanskrit: gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpādyaṃ sākṣataṃ ca pavitrakamśivaṃ nivedayenmūrdhni recakenāmṛtīkṛtamprātaḥ snātaḥ śuciḥ śuddhaḥ pūjāṃ kuryātsvavittataḥpañcabhirmadhuraiḥ snānaṃ jalāntarairvirukṣaṇamaṣṭāṅgo'rghaṃ pradāyātha samālabhya prapūjayetvastraiḥ saṃchāditaṃ veśma ghaṭācāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥkadalīcūtamālābhirjātabījasarocakaiḥ [k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: sarāvakaiḥ]nṛtyagītaiḥ kalairvādyairnayedrātriṃ mahotsavaiḥbhakttyā santoṣayet sarvān vastradānādibhojanaiḥsarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyatekhaṭvāśayanamithyokti [kh, gh, ṅ: thyāvān] strīyātrāmiṣavarjakaḥpūjāṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ natvā pavitraṃ ca visarjayetkṛtvā kṣipetpavitrāṇi śivāgnau vā sadāmbhasisyātprāyaścityadhogāmī kṛto rudro'bda [mū, ṅ: drākta] koṭiśaḥtāmraliṅgārcanādarkaḥ piśāco vaṃśasambhavātsīsajā [mū: sīsakā] dguhyakāḥ sarve lohādrakṣo'surāntakāḥpadmarāgāddhutāśaśca indranīlārcanāddhariḥvaidrumāsyārcanānnāgāḥ śukraḥ kārketanātsadāpaulastyo jīvajātibhyaṣṭai [k, kh: tījārhai] ṭṭibhātsiddhakinnarāḥaśvinau pakvamṛdbhūtādgandharvā dārasambhavātkūrmakauśi (kasi) kasabhūtādvāsukinayināyakaḥliṅgasaṃsthāpanārcanātsomapāḥnānāphalotthaliṅgāni vidhinā sevitāni casaikatādviśvakarmā ca śacīśo lavaṇo [mū: ścalano] dbhavāt

sanskrit: vaṃśāṅkurotthaliṅgācca sagaro nāma pārthivaḥsikthasambhavātaihikasyāśrayātsiddhā likhitā bahuśāstrataḥsiddhidānīśavākyataḥsthāpitaṃ vidhi [kh: śiva] mantraistu dharmakāmārthamokṣadampūjitāḥ sthāpitāśca syuḥ pūjyaṃ sthāpyaṃ ca tattvataḥtatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sthāpya liṅgaṃ labhetphalamliṅgāṅkitaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ bhagāṅkaṃ nāpi paśyatigṛhītvāgamataḥ sarvaṃ likhataṃ śikhabhāṣitamvistarādbhīśca mohaḥ syāttamānmadhyataraṃ kṛtamyadi vrajati vai tārkṣyaḥ kiṃ na yāntīha ṣaṭpadāḥajñānaśītanāśāya kaṇṭhācāryai [kh, g, ṅ: vācyatyu] dīritāḥpalakṣyatepañcavaktropagītamjñānīśānaśivastadaṅghrijanito vairocano daiśikaḥyastatasyāhaṃ namāmi kṣitinihitaśirāḥ pādapadmaṃ gurormeso'yaṃ mattamṛgebhadarpadalano bhūkānena bhrāmyatitadvidyācāryaśaivāya buddhimedhākaro guṇaḥśeṣāścānuṣṭubho madhye guṇasāhasrikaṃ kṛtam] sūktamājñāya tatkariṣyanti paṇḍitāḥśaivebhya etaddātavyamarthataḥ śāstrataḥsadātāvadvairocanasya pravicaratu guroḥ pustarupātra kīrtiḥtāvadvairocanīyā jagati ciramiyaṃ pustarupāstu kīrtiḥnāma dvātriṃśo vidhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādeśī vedavikretā ṣaḍete śūdravaddvijāḥmanurdakṣo vasiṣṭho'triḥ kātyāyano'tha gautamaḥśaṅkhalikhitahārītaśātātapaparāśarāḥna śaivāditipraṣṭhāyāmete niprā niyāmakāḥdevyā mataṃ mayaṃ nandiṃ pratiṣṭhā pārameśvaramśakākhyaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca dvidhā paitāmahaṃ tathāpratiṣṭhātantrāṇyetāni śivoktānyekaviṃśatiḥpadmotthamārkaṇḍeyābhyāṃ rambhā [kh: gaurī] siddhādi rambhataḥ [mū, a, k, g: sauryataḥ]mārtaṇḍāhrayato [kh, g: mārkaṇḍā-] lakṣyaṃ sarvametatsamuccayam [g: sarvatatva-]śivāśramasthitaiḥ śaivaiḥ pratiṣṭhā nānyadarśanaiḥśaivāstanna namasyanti sthāpitaṃ cānyadarśanaiḥśaivasaṃskārahīnastu umābhyāṃ patati dvijaḥkṛtaṃ yadvratabandhādi tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavenna bhavedīpsitaṃ tatra vṛthaivāsau phariśramaḥśivoktaiśca vinā mantraistadetatprāpyate kathammiśrairvāpyatha doṣādya [k, g: doṣāḍhyaṃ] tkumāradyuktaśāstrataḥp. 39) karmacaṇḍaṃ bhavettasya karma caṇḍālakaśca saḥmuktisiddhaṃ [mū, a, kh: yuktisiddhaṃ] hitaṃ loke skandoktaṃ cātra likhyatekriyā sā na bhavetsādhvī mantrasaṃkaradūṣitāagniṣṭomādayo yadvatpratiṣṭhāpīṣyate tathāsvargalokaphalā sādhvī vijñeyā vaidikīkriyāvānaspatyaṃ samāsādya saṃsarantīha yājñikāḥpunaḥ puṇyakriyākṣīṇaḥ sthāvarādiṣu jāyatetasmātte munayaḥ sarva śaivārthe na viśāradāḥtrayāṇāṃ brahmaṇādīnāṃ vedavidyāpracoditā

sanskrit: yajñe carūpuroḍāśapañcagavyādibhiḥ sahap. 40) śūdrādīnāṃ ca yo dadyādvedavidyāprasādhitamtasmācchaivo vidhiḥ prājñaiḥ śaivairmantraiḥprasādhitaḥsarveṣāmapi varṇānāmanu grahakaraḥ paraḥkoṭikharvāvja vṛndaṃ ca mantrāstvīśādvinirgatāḥayutāni ca pañcāśanmantrā vaktrā [g: rudrā] dviniḥsṛtāḥniyutāni ca ṣaṭtriśanmantrā rudrādvinirgatāḥkoṭiśatāni pañcāśanmantrā vāmādviniḥsṛtāḥśataṃ sahasalakṣaṃ ca sadyojātādvinirgatāḥtaistu liṅgādi saṃsthāpyaṃ nānyairvedādicoditaiḥtaiḥ kṛtaṃ pañcadhā śāstraṃ śaivākhyaṃ siddhimuktidamnimatsarā vadantyāśu [kh: drava] siddhāḥ [kh: śivāḥ] śavoktamantrataḥsamyagvidhānattvajñairdīkṣito mucyate paśuḥsarvānugrāhakā mantrāścaturvarga [k, g: caturdaśa] prasādhakāḥprāgyāmyendujalāśāsyairlakṣagranthaiḥ kṛtā śrutiḥsiddhimuktī vinā sarvaṃ śabdamātraparā matāḥīśānoktā śrutiḥ paścāt svargākhyaphalasādhaneavadhūtoktito'jñatvaṃ brahmaviṣṇornamadvaraḥ [kh: rasaṅgatam]viṣṇuḥ pitāmahayutaḥ kimatāparasyap. 42) gonarāśvādikaṃ hatvā yajvanāṃ narako bhavetprāhuḥṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvarasyaīśvaraṃ kāraṇa nyāyādvadanti tarkavādinaḥśatāniṃdaśa mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇo dvisahasrakaḥekonedve sahasre ca mantrāṇāṃ yajuṣastathākāṇva [k, kh, gh: kārṇa] madhyandināsaṃjñā kaṭhī prācyakaṭhī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaijavāpa neketyādyāḥ śākhā yajuṣi saṃsthitāḥgānānyapi ca catvāri veda āraṇyakastathāp. 43) santuḥ śatakāścai brahmaprabhavakāḥ [gh: haṭakāḥ] smṛtāḥśaunakaḥ pippalādaśca muñjakeśādayo'paremantrāṇā yutaṃ sāṣṭaśaṃtaṃ copari ṣaṭśatam [gh: copaniṣacchatama]śivādīnāṃ prayatnena hyanyathā doṣadāyakāḥrāṣṭrarājñobhaveddoṣaḥ [gh: rāṣṭra rājño bhave-] kartu kārayitustathānārakāste[kh: no rakṣiṇaḥ; gh: nārakinaḥ] samākhyātāḥ kartuḥ kulānvakārakāḥsaṃkīrṇavṛttirvijñeyastvabhojyaḥ sarvadā budhaiḥbahurūpasya mantrasya nirdoṣo vai bhavettataḥācāryo gīyate loke na hyasau pāramārthikaḥp. 44) daiśikāstrividhā grāhyoḥprāguktā ye gurukramātśivatulyo'pi sa tyājyodagdhahasto [mū: grāhyo-] guruḥsa hipratiṣṭheyuḥ surānsarvānabhāve daiśikasya tuṛjurlajjānvitaḥ sādhurjitakrodho jitendriyaḥsudṛṣṭiḥ [k, g: atṛṣṇiḥ] kulajo dhīmānnodvegī sūkta [gh: sūtra] tatparaḥprāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ dvāraṃ vidyādyo [vindyādyo, liṃ pu. pā.] hi sa [g: hema] kārukaḥśivadharma [gh: karma] vidhānajñā mūrtipā daiśikādayaḥvinītā nipuṇā dakṣā gurorādeśavartinaḥ [k, kh: rājñānuvartinaḥ]iti lakṣaṇasārasamuccaye karturācāryādiparīkṣā nāma dvitīyo vidhiḥśilā vā jāti [mū, a, k, g: rājābhi] bhedena adhunaiva nirūpyate [kh: nirūpyante'dhunocyate]kāśmīrī prāci yāmye vā khadiro brahmavṛkṣakaḥantargata jalastokaṃ sāgneyī rūpato dharā [kh: parā]saumye toyaṃ ca māhendrī pīlūddālasnuhīyutā [g: dvālastu saṃyutā]atṛṇāmbuśagālāḍhyā vāyavī sā mahī smṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māhendrīvāruṇījātāḥ śastrāścānye ca garhitāḥśamīdrākṣā surāhvaśca navaite vipraśāntidāḥp. 46) kadarā [kadaraḥ=śvetakhadiraḥ, iti vācaspatyam] śokaśākaṃ ca śṛṅgī [g: vṛkṣī] ca nṛpabhūtidāsaralaḥ panaso bīja ityete vaiśyavṛddhidāḥkāñcanāsana [kh: mara] lodhrāśca sāla śūdrasyapuṣṭidāḥsubhūsthāḥ [g: asvasthāḥ] śobhanā hṛdyā, ārogyā yauvanodvahāḥsāramadhyā draḍhīyāṃso nānyakāryeṣu yojitāḥgranthitulyaśirāyuktān bṛddhabālāturāṃstarūnvalmikotthāñśmaśānotthān phalāmbhaḥ sevitāṃstyajetkharitsaṅgamadevotthāṃstāpasāśramajāṃstyajet [mū, a, k: śrayajāṃ-]acireṇaiva kālena cālako na bhavedasaup. 47) devakārye na doṣaḥ syādityuktaṃ pārameśvareśodhayedbhūmibhāgaṃ tu caturdikṣu samantataḥtataḥ śilpipradhānāśca sahāyāḥkusumādibhiḥviparīta tadā mantrī dūratastaṃ vivarjayetgomayena tato bhūmi lepayitvā gurustadādhyātvā devaṃ ca vijñāpya kṛtvācārghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ [k: kṛtvācāyaṃ vicakṣaṇam]astraṃ dhyātvā yajenmantrī [kh: japen-] varmaṇā [mū: carmaṇā] pariveṣṭayetśiva saṃpūjya vahnistha navadyaṃ ḍhaukayeccarumvijñāpya karmaśastrāṇi pūjayettarpayedapi [kh: darpaye]tato vijñāpya deveśa kuryādālaṃbhanaṃ punaḥ [gh: kṛtvācālaṃbhanaṃ purā]p. 48) tāḍanaṃ bhasmanāstreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ śivavāriṇāvastraṃ trisūtraṃ vṛkṣasya śilāyāśca kuśānvitamsaṃhitoktena mantreṇasnānavastrādikaṃ bhavetdadyād baliṃ ca māṣānnairāmiṣāsavasaṃyutaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arghaṃ datvā ca vṛkṣasya [mū, a: rudrasya] mantra saṃśrāvyakaṃ vadetsaṅkramānyaditaḥ sthānādguṇavadyanmanoharamyo yasmin [mū, a, k, g: yatra] vihito mantraḥ śāstre syādbalikarmaṇisthāne'smin yāni bhūtāni piśācā rākṣasāśca yetāṃstu saṃpūjya vidhivatpriyavākyaiḥ pratoṣayetp. 49) śivārthaṃ yadbhavetkāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavetsukhena gacchatānyatra muktvā sthānamidaṃ drumamśivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsvapnamāṇavakaṃ [mū, a, k, kh, g: vijñāpya-] japetsvapnamāṇavakaṃ rātrau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japetvāmāya viśvarūpāya 1 svapnādhipataye namaḥkriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvararudreṇa cānvitaṃ svapne dṛṣṭvā vācyaṃ śubhaṃ sadākapyuṣṭrairbhakṣamāṇaṃ vā taṃ tyajedaśubha [k: jeccāśubha] pradamjuhuyācca tadā snātvāghoraṃ doṣanivṛttayeaindre saumye tatheśāne avyaktādimukhaṃ kramātkṣaudrājyābhyaktaśastreṇa ghorāstreṇābhimantrya caācāryaḥ prathamaṃ hanyācchivāstraṃ saṃjapaṃstataḥvārkṣa [g: karka] mantrāntadikkaṃ (?) [g: didaṃ] vai ghaṭayelliṅgamādarāt [k, g: tadanukramāt]saṃchindyātpatitaṃ [mū, a: saṃcintyāt-] vṛkṣamajātenaiva [k, c: jātenaiva; g: mathatenaiva] bhaktimāngṛhṇīyāddāru liṅgārthaṃ tyajedāpāṇḍaraṃ laghusthāpitaṃ viparītaṃ tu rāṣṭravibhramamādiśetadhaḥ śiro yadā liṅgaṃ tadā gotrakṣayo bhavettato digdevatāśāntiṃ kuryāddoṣavimuktayeanyadikpātadoṣeṇa mucyate śāntimāpnuyātdadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ cāpi tataḥ kāmānavāpnuyāt

sanskrit: patane madhyabhaṅgaḥ syāttadā homo vidhīyatedadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ cāpi śivenāśivahāriṇāśilādāne tathā pūjā dārvādāne yathoditādvijādivarṇabhedena rūpabhedena ca sthitāḥyuvatī sā śilā grāhyā triṣu liṅgeṣu netarāḥvṛddhiṃ dadyācchilā nūnaṃ taruṇī lakṣaṇānvitātrayo'ṅkurā diśastisro gandhāsvādau [mū: gandhasvādau] caturvirdhātāruṇamekamityevaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāni tusnigdhānimnā śilā dhanyā siktā puṇyanadījalaiḥsugandhī niviḍāṅgī ca dramacchāyāsthitā sadādṛḍhā manoramā gurvī madhuradhvanibhūṣitākrameṇābjājyagovarvo [mū, a, gh: gocarvī] mūtragandhāḥ śubhāḥśilāḥśāntiṃ jayaṃ dhanaṃ cāyuścāturvarṇye prayacchatisutejā rūpasaṃpannā dhanadeśendra [kh: śendru] dik sthitānakṣatraṃ ca mṛgaṃ tasyāstaddevaḥ śaśalāñchanaḥasyā ṛkṣaṃ bhavejjyeṣṭhā devatā ca śatakratup. 53) nakṣatraṃ phalgunī cāsyā devaśca [mū: devatā] bhagasaṃjñakaḥnakṣatramaśvinau [mū, a: maśvinī] cāsyā devau caivāśvinau [gh: dvau cāśvinau] matau [mū: smṛtau]śītalā ca sukhasparśā niviḍāṅgī manoramāekavarṇaḥsthiraḥsnigdho gajakaṇṭho [kh: ghaṇṭo] pamasvanaḥpāṣāṇo'ya guru pumān puruṣāṇāṃvibhūtidaḥstriyā strīpratimā kāryā ṣaṇḍhaṃ ṣaṇḍhena nā nṛbhiḥśirāḍhyaṃ karkaśaṃ tva rju [k: varja; kh: vakṣya; g: tvajjā] idamaśma napuṃsakamśeṣāṇāṃ strīśilāḥ proktāḥ pīṭhikādyāśca [g: yāśca] śūlinaḥsarvavarṇātmake śvetāḥśeṣāśca śubhadāḥ [mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: stvaśubhadā] smṛtāḥ

sanskrit: p. 54) raktā pītā ca bhūpasya viśaḥ śyāmakulatthabhāḥindracāpopamārekhāḥ sarvāśrīvasubhūtidāḥlakṣaṇāḍhyālpadoṣā yā grāhyā sā homaśodhitā [kh: śobhitā]indreśānendukāṣṭhāsu tasyā mastakamiṣyatetrividheṣvapi liṅgeṣu śilāyāṃ nāparo vidhiḥdoṣān vṛddhādikān brūmaścāṣṭāśītiprabhedataḥśūṣiraṃ sphoṭakaṃ [kh, gh: sphāṭikaṃ] vyomaṃ gārā [kh: galā] paṭalajālakamlakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmyeṣāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa prabhedataḥniṣṭhurā cātirūkṣā ca vṛddhā kāryavināśinīṭaṅkaghātāsahiṣṇuñca na tāṃ devāya yojayettasmādbimbātmakaṃ cāśma saṃchindyāddāru vai tathāsaptānyāni ca citrāṇi caturdhā lepanaṃ tathākāpilaṃ haritālābhaṃ kāpotamalivarṇakam [kh, gh: mallikādhautavarṇakam]kiṃśukābhaṃ kusumbhābhamatasīpuṣpasannibhamcampakābhaṃ ca nīlābhaṃ miśralohitapītakamraktaṃ [kh: rūkṣaṃ] ca pāṇḍaraṃ caiva garbhadoṣān vadāmyata [kh: myaham]guḍavarṇe śilānyā syāttenāvṛṣṭirbhaveccirammañjiṣṭhābhe bhavedbhekaḥ śasyanāśo jalādbhayampīte godhā nṛpaṃ hanyāṅṭavāṃ pīḍākarī ca sātālābhe karkaṭaḥpittarogadarbhikṣakṛcca saḥjyeṣṭhā kapotakaṇṭhābhe vyādhidāridryabhītidānīlake makṣikā sā ca hanyādbhāryāṃ saputrakām [kh: saputrikām]nṛpakṣī cāṣavarṇe syāttena kartuḥprajākṣayaḥkiṃśuke śakragopaḥ syāttena rājño dhanakṣayaḥatasīpuṣpasaṃkāśe garbhe vidyāt pipīlikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityaṣṭādaśa bimbāni kathitānyatra saṃkhyayābhaveyuḥ kṛmayo garbhe nāśo dehārthayostataḥtena rājā ca mantrī ca kārako mriyate kramātraktacitre ca śṛṅgī syāttayā śokabhayaṃ muhuḥ [gh: śokakaraṃ bahu]kṛṣṇacitre ca gonāśaḥ so'nekavyādhikārakasaptaitāni tu citrāṇi jñeyāni bāhyalakṣaṇaiḥcaturvikārabhedena garbhaṃ vidyātpralepataḥsaurāṣṭrī tālasaṃyuktaṃ [kh: kalasaṃyuktaiḥ] sauvīreṇa [mū, a: saurīreṇa] ca peṣayet [gh: pāvayet]bhṛṅgāhī kṛṣṇamatsyaṃ vā jñātvā tā doṣadāstyajetpiṣṭavaivaṃ samabhāgaṃ tu nārī kṣīreṇa lepayettena karturbhavenmṛtyustasmāttāṃ salile kṣipetahorātroṣite raktaṃ tyājyamūrmānvitaṃ ca yat [kh: kurmānvitaṃ yataḥ]tīkṣṇaṃ rudrajaṭāyuktamavikṣīraiḥ prapeṣya cadvayordvirūpakaṃ garbhe jñātvā prāgdoṣadāṃstyajetkartustatkulahṛnnūnaṃ gurordadyātkṣayāmayamṭaṅkāghātādbhidākārī [kh: tādbhayā; mū: tābhidhā] sandhiḥ kartṛvināśakaḥ [mū, a: karturvināśakṛt]sphoṭaṃ [gh: sphāṭaṃ] sphuṭitakaṃ vidyācchastraghātāntadāyakamvyomākāro bhavedvyoma so'cirātkartṛnāśakaḥtayā kartṛprajānāśaḥ śīghrameva na saṃśayaḥtena kuryānna liṅgāni kṛte ca dvau vinaśyataḥpītaṃ sitaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ nīlaṃ ca miśrakamnavatyardhaṃ mahādoṣā bhedabhinno iti smṛtāḥp. 59) brahmopendravibhāgasthāṃstridhā liṅgeṣvadoṣadān [mū: liṅgeṣu doṣadān]śirā [śirāśabdo'yaṃ tālavyo dantyaścetyūṣmabhede] granthituṣāraiśca vimalaṃ dadu bindubhiḥviḍālāśvoṣṭragomāyukākapādāṅkitāṃstyajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: granthirūponnatagranthirjaṭharāmayadāyakatuṣāraṃ tadvijānīyā putraśokārtidāyakam [kh, gh: kārakam]hemaghoṣāmayaṃ tāmra tadduṣṭaṃ piṅgalāmatejanaṃ hantyāyasākrāntā śilā tāmī ca [gh: tāmrācca] śilpinamkṛṣṇaḥ pīto'ruṇo binduḥ sa śokabhayarogadaḥpīte dhanakṣayaḥ kartuḥ kṛṣṇe bandho dvayordvidhārekhā rekhānubiddhā vā [mū, a, k: ca] pārthivaṃ sā vināśayetsvāmidhnī ca catuśchinnā bahucchinnā kulāntakṛtmakṣikā makṣikākārā tayā kuṣṭhaṃ sudāruṇamtadā nānā gadān kuryāt kartuścaiva na saṃśayaḥtyājyaṃ tadā tridhā liṅgaṃ nṛparāṣṭraprajārthināvāmapārśvāśritaḥ kiṃciddhanyādrāṣṭraṃ sarājakamsarvavarṇā bhṛśaṃ [kh, gh: daśa] nūnaṃ prāṇahṛtkṛṣṇahīrikāunnato lakṣyate yaśca [mū: yatra] viḍālāṅghriḥ sa doṣabhāk [kh: kṛt]śilāyā rūpamālakṣya tyajettāmaśubhapradāmsvalpadoṣān prakṣyāmi yathā śāstreṣu bhāṣitānvalmīkoṣaracityutthā koṣṇā kṣārāmbumadhyagākudiksthā sūryasantaptā kadutthāmethyadūṣitā [k, g: bhūṣitā]duṣṭajīvasvarā yā ca yojitā nānyakarmaṇiyā yopalānulagnā sā snehavicchittikārikāḥ [mū, a: kāraṇam]ūṣarasthārthahṛjjñeyā citisthā duḥkhadāyinīpāṣadāpuṇyadeśasthā vadhakṛdbhilla [kh: liṅga] sevitādāhaṃ hāniṃ ca śokaṃ ca naiḥsvaṃ rogaṃ tathāvahetsurāpakṣivasāgandhā udvegajananī śilāvajradagdhāgnidagdhā ca rājño'nalabhayapradā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyakarmārthamānītonmādāniṣpattikāriṇīp. 62) antyajā sā śilā jñeyā dvijādīnāṃ vigarhitā [gh: tu garhitā]nāna varṇā ca cāṇḍalī sā kartuḥ [kh: māna] kulanāśinīprākṛtānāṃ hitārthāya kāmaṃ muktyarthināṃ nṛṇāmsvalpadoṣā ime khyātā viṃśatirlakṣabhedataḥ([copāntargato'yaṃ, k, kh, g pustakeṣu nāsti] jñaya sadbhūmibhūtasya pāṣāṇasya drumasya catajja tīśena mantreṇa tajjātijananaṃ bhavetlāñcha yatvā yathānyāyaṃ kartayecchodhayedapipiṇḍikāsahitaṃ tacca viṣṇubhāgāntamunnatamekakhaṇḍaiva kartavyā piṇḍikā vai śivasya tupraṇālamaindrasaumye vā jalādhāramadhastathāna tu brahmaśilā prājñairiti śāstreṣu [k, g: tantreṣu] bhāṣitamliṅgachedordhvabhāgasthā tathādho [mū, a, k: tadadho] bhāgagāpi vāucchrāyena tu liṅgānāmekakhaṇḍo vidhīyateanyeṣāmapi liṅgānāṃ krameṇaikāṅgulādhilā [gh: -ṇaiva-]([cāpāntargatoyaṃ pāṭhaḥ k, g pustakayornāsti] svamānānmekhalā tasyāḥ khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇataḥbrahmāṃśādadhikaḥ [gh: brahmāṅgā-] khāto yavai ṣaḍbhiḥ pravistaraḥratnādhārāṇi tanmadhye vṛttāni nava [mū: na ca] kalpayetsvamānavistarārdhena bāhulyena samanvitāvārkṣī brahmaśilā vārkṣe liṅge syātpiṇḍikā tathāarcayedastra [gh: cchatra] puṣpādyairānetuṃ mantravittamaḥtāpasāñchivabhaktāṃśca tarpayitvānayedrathamrathe kṛtvā ca deveśaṃ pūjayitvā tamānayetyadā rathe rathāṅgānāṃ [mū: ratharathāṅgānāṃ] pramādātskhalitaṃ bhavetśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā mucyate sarvaduṣkṛtaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rathaṃ mārgagataṃ kṛtvā śanaiḥ svapuramānayetśobhāṃ dhvajapatākādyaiḥ strībhirmaṅgalagītakaiḥp. 65) prāsādasyottare pārśve karmakuryānnivedayetpañcasaptaikādaśabhiḥ karaiḥ karmakuṭī matāprāsādottaradiggarte kṣiptvā tāṃ pūrayenmṛdātarpayedastrarājaṃ ca mahāpāśupataṃ ca yatevaṃ santarpite hyastre [k, g: jyeṣṭhe] digdoṣairmucyate śilātasya liṅgasya sadvipraḥ kanyā śilpī ca pūjitādhruvaṃ kartavyamityāha bhagavān parameśvaraḥśilāṃ tāṃ varjayedyatnānnaśastā liṅgakarmaṇievaṃ dārumayaṃ cāpi [mū, a, k, kh: vāpi] liṅgādidravyamānayetprāguktareśakāṣṭhāsu śilāṃ nyasya kvacinmateathavā mṛtyujetāraṃ vidyāṅgaiḥ [g: vidyāhvaiḥ] ṣaḍbhiranvitamityanena vidhānena gṛhītvā dāru vāśma [k, kh: raśma] vāliṅgaṃ gurvājñyā kuryāttridhā mānopalakṣitamiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye dāruśilāgrahaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo vidhiḥcaturaṅgulamānena [mū, a, kh, g, gh, ṅ: calamaṅgula-] dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitamkeśāgralikṣāyūkābhyāṃ [mū: yūkānāṃ] kramādaṣṭāṣṭabhiryavaḥp. 67) tiryak samodaraiḥ proktaṃ mānārthaṃ pārameśvarekalāgolakanetrāṅka [gh: netrāhva] mātrābhirdvyaṅgalaṃ smṛtamardhahastaṃ vitastiṃ ca tālaṃ ca dvādaśāṅgulamliṅgadhāmāsanādīnāṃ sarvakarmavidhau matādvāramānāttrisaṃkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥevaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśajjñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥeṣāmaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāni yāni ca nāmāni tāni tāni pṛthagbruve [kh: bhavet]sparśaśabdeśvaro nāsā jihvākṣitvakśrutīśvarāḥvacanagrahaṇotsargānandapragamaneśvarāḥp. 68) prakṛtīśaḥ pumāṃścaiva madhyānāṃ daśa pañca cavidyeśvaraḥ patiḥ sraṣṭā garutmāna sakalo'kalaḥśāntaścājo [mū: tejo] mahātejā dvārmānāduttamaṃ trayamskandaḥ sūkṣmo' [mū: skandhaḥ sūryo] mbikānāthastrayaṃ dvārāttathādhamambhujaṅgī vṛṣabhī siṃhī uttamā nava garbhajāḥvyāpī śūlī viśālī [g: kirātī] cetthadhamā nava garbhajāḥ [gh: garbhikāḥ]sarvajño'tha vṛṣadhvajo niyāmaḥ pāpahā [gh: niryāmaḥ pāśahā] dhruvaḥśambhuḥ sthāṇurharo ḍiṇḍī hartā kartā śivo'vyayaḥbhadro'tha vimalo jyeṣṭho gāṇḍīvaḥ puṣṭivardhanaḥnavaite hastamānena tvadhamāḥ parikīrtitāḥṣaḍādidaśaparyantaṃ calaliṅgaṃ ca madhyamamśreṣṭhaliṅgapramāṇaṃ tajjyeṣṭhādyaṅgulilakṣitamravibhirhematārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣai [mū, a, k: śeṣairanyai] stripañcabhiḥārogyaṃ rājyasaukhyaṃ ca nṛpaśrījayalokakṛtcalaliṅgādbhavetkāryaṃ sādhakānāṃ kvacinmate [kh: tsamā]dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāśca koṇayostu vilopayetpārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaram [mū, a: ddhru vam]p. 70) liṅgaṃ dvārocchrayādardhādbhavetpādonataḥ kramāt [mū, a, k, g, ṅ: samāt]tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta saṃpādayetsamamdvyantare rāmarāmaṃ ca liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā navastrīya?madhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ [k, kh: tridhaiva] trividhātmakamliṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu vāṣṭāntareṣu vā

sanskrit: tadekaṃ sthāpayelliṅgaṃ hastātpādajameva vāgabhādyaśo'rthaputrastrībhūrjayo'rtho ghṛṣāyuṣīsiddhī rājyaṃ karaiḥ kāryā liṅgādantajāttathādhvajādyā yaiḥ svarairbhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haretkṛtīp. 71) dhvajādiṣu dhvajaṃ siṃhaṃ vṛṣākhyaṃ ca gajaṃ śubhamdhvaje rājyaṃ jayaṃ siṃhe vṛṣe lābhaṃ śriyaṃ gajedhvāṅkṣeṇa sarvanāśaḥ syāttasmāttān parivarjayetlakṣmīprado bhavet ṣaḍjo gāndhāro janavṛddhikṛtṛṣabheṇārivṛddhiḥ syānmadhyamaḥ sutanāśakṛt [mū, a, k, g, ṅ: śubhanāśanaḥ]bhūteṣu kṣmācarāścānye toyādyāścāśubhā [gh: toyāḍhyā] bhṛśamsajvaro [k, g: saddhīro] dāhakṛttejo vāyustu kulanāśakṛtśasto'gniścāhavanīyo dvāvagnī cāśubhau mataukarturmṛtyuprado hyagnistṛtīyo nṛpabhītidaḥṣaḍvā tadāyabhāgaṃ tu kṛtvaikaṃ saṃkṣipedvarambhāgeśa cāpyanīśaṃ ca devejyaṃ tulyasaṃjñakamdairghyaṃ māyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāttrirūpakamuktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe [mū: cāyāṃśe] nāgāṃśai [k, kh: bhāgārdhaiḥ] rbhāṃjite kramātādyānādyasurejyāhva [mū: -jyāṅka] tulyānāṃ caturasratādvidhā bhedādbahūnyatra vakṣyante [k, g: lakṣyante] viśvakamataḥtridhā hastājjivākhyaṃ ca yuktaṃ sarvasamena capañca [mū: yaśca] saptatirekatvājjinaibhaktaṃbhavanti hievamaṅgulavṛddhyā ca navaikakaragarbhataḥvistāraṃ saptadhā kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayamekaikāṃśaṃ caturbhāgaṃ koṇahrāsaṃ dvibhāgataḥtadekaikaṃ yugaṃ kṛtvā ekaikāṃśaṃ samāharet

sanskrit: kvacitkaṇaṃpraveśena lāñchayitvāsiśātanamtanmadhye sūtrasambhrānte rudro bhavati vartulaḥkṣipedvā śūnyadoṣaghnaṃ hastādekāṅgulaṃ kramātṣoḍaśāṃśa kṣipedādye [kh, g, gh: nnādye] vedāṃśamamarorcite [kh: samākhyatrisamaiḥ surāḥ]piṅgalāyā mate proktamādyāmarārcitena tup. 74) bhaveyurvardhamānāni vasudviṣaṭ [gh: vasvatviṣaṭ] śatāni caviśvakarmamataṃ [gh: mate] dṛṣṭvā vaktavyaṃ pīṭhavartanam [gh: pīṭhavartane]tacca savasamaṃ liṅgaṃ prāsāde vā gṛhe hitamdvau pādau jānuparyantaṃ caturasrepitāmahaḥāmūrdhaṃ nābhitaścordhvaṃ vṛttabhāge haraḥ svayampañcadhāvyaktaliṅgāni samapīṭhāni tāni capañcaliṅgavyavastheyaṃ śirovartinyathocyate [mū, a: vartanamucyate; k, kh: vartanyathocyateḥ]ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ kāmyarūpātphala vadetp. 75) cirarājyaprada khyātaṃ chatrabhedāścaturvidhāḥmānada [mū: mānāṅga] pakṣa [k, kh, g: padma] lopācca vipulaṃ khyātidaṃ bhavetśrīvāsaṃ putradaṃ kurturdakṣāṇḍaṃ syāccaturvidhampuṣṭidaṃ dvikṣayātpūrṇaṃ mahāhlādakarasadā [kh: tathā]āyudaṃ kumudaṃ jñeyaṃ candaṃ caturvidhaṃ matam [mū: jñeyaṃ candraṃ caturvidham]sarvakāmapradaṃ proktaṃ vināśaṃ dvikṣayācchriyeballabhatvaprada tacca caturdhā trapuṣaṃ bhavetkuryādviprādikāryārthamekaṃ vā kukkuṭāṇḍakam [kh: ṭāṇḍabhaṃ]dīrghāyuṣṭvamatha cendoḥ [mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: mathārdhendoḥ] kṛkavākvaṇḍataḥ prajñāḥjinaviṃśatiśārdūlairādye brahmādiveṣṭanamvikāreṇa smareṇāṃśatṛtīyāṃśayutena cabhāgatṛtīyabhāgena nakhacandrānvitena ca

sanskrit: sasaptadaśabhiścāṃśaiḥ paridhiḥ syātsamāṃśake [mū: samāhvake]sārdhadvitribhujairviṣṇuḥ sāṅghryekatribhujairharaḥyavagarbhe bhavetpuṣṭiḥ pānānnaṃ jaṭharonnatesamakukṣau bhayaṃ hanyāt sthūlamūle tvarogatā [mū: hyarogatā]nimne ca luñcite kuryāddhanadhānyavināśanamchidrānvitaṃ ca sadbhāyā [mū, a, k: tathā bhāryā] lalāṭe nimnaka sutamp. 77) madhye kṛśaṃ ca śokāya dubhikṣadamadhaḥ kṛśamvraṇitāmayavṛddhiśca durbhikṣaṃ cātikoṭaredhanaghnaṃ pṛṣṭhanimnaṃ syādrogaṃ pārśve tathodaresamyak sunirvraṇaṃ dhautaṃ tadā cinhāni lakṣayetmakarādarśacāpobhisrakkamaṇḍalutoraṇāḥśrīvatsanandikāvartarathahārebhabhūṣaṇaiḥmayūravājivāsobhistaruvajrapavitrakāḥliṅgāṅge yatra tatra [gh: yatra yatra] syānnṛparāṣṭravivṛddhidāḥkaraṅkakaṅkagṛdhrāhiśyenakākakharākhubhiḥyajamānaprajārājñāṃ liṅgaṃ bhīśa kadāyakam [mū: strīśoka]ete ca pārthivā varṇā liṅgacinhāni bhūtaye [k: bhūtale]ete ca [gh: tu] vāruṇā varṇā prajāyurdhanalābhadāḥāgneyā agnisantrāsadurbhikṣavyādhivardhanāḥvāyavyā vāyusantrāsakalahādvegakārakāḥsādhane cāstriliṅgaṃ ca digliṅgaṃ caiva vakṣyate [kh: lakṣyate]tryasraṃ cāśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ vedāsraṃ cepsitapradamsaptāsraṃ dveṣakṛtkhyātamaṣṭāsraṃ kīrtivardhanamrudrāsraṃ rogavṛddhyarthaṃ bhayaghnaṃ dvādaśāsrakamtithyasraṃ puṇyakṛlliṅgaṃ vikārāsraṃ sukhapradam

sanskrit: navāvadhikarāntasya śūnyadoṣo na kasyacittridhā mānena caikena [gh: caikyena] ṣoḍaśāsraṃ śatadvayamcaturaṣṭaṣaḍasraṃ tu indrāṅkaṃ [kh: candrāhvaṃ] vajrarūpakambindusaṃpātsaṃyogāttiryaksūtrairvivartayetvasvasrordhvaṃ tu [mū: vasvasrordhe tu] saptāsraṃ śaktyāgneya ca dāhakṛtnāhārdhaṃ navadhā kṛtvā śarairhṛtpṛṣṭhakoṭibhiḥevaṃ cāṣṭāsravṛtaṃ syādyāmyadaṇḍaṃ [mū, a, k, g, ṅ: yāmadaṇḍaṃ] rujapradamaṣṭāsro'rdha [mū: -'rdhaṃ] daśāstraṃ syātkhaḍgābhaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhayam [k, kh: kṣaye]caturaṣṭāsravṛttaṃ syātpāśavadvāruṇaṃ śubhamkṛśaṃ prāgrūpakaṃ dīrghaṃ calamuccāṭakṛddhvajamyākṣaṃ [k: pākṣaṃ; g: mākṣaṃ] gadāgramūrdhānaṃ balavṛddhikaraṃ [gh: dhana-] śivamcatuḥpañcāsrakaṃ [mū: caturasrāsrakaṃ] tryasraṃ śūlaṃ raudraṃ tu muktidamaṣṭāsro' [g: aṣṭāṃśo] rdhaṃ ca vedāsraṃ brāhmaṃ svargāya padmavatcaturaṣṭāsravṛttaṃ syādvaiṣṇavaṃ śaṅkhava [mū, a: śaktivat] cchubhamrudrāttrihānitaḥ śuktirdaṇḍo digbhyastrihānitaḥkukkuṭāṇḍaṃ ca vāyavye bhūtāṃśāddhi yate gadādakṣāṇḍabhaja vaiṣṇośca ittha rekhā maṇerapisphuṭitaṃ garbhavaddaṣṭaṃ sthāpayedābhivārikevyaktaliṅgāni cānyāni nānā rūpāṇi vacmyataḥiti [iti pratiṣṭhātantre, likhitapustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ] lakṣaṇasamuccaye'vyaktaliṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma [liṅgavartanāvidhiḥ, iti likhita pustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ |] caturtho vidhiḥpūrvāṅgulapramāṇena daśapañcāṅgulāṅgulātkvaciddhastapramāṇā sā kvacicca triṃśadaṅgulāp. 82) dvārocchrayaṃ vibhajyādāvaṣṭadhaukaṃ [mū, a, k: vaṣṭadhaikaṃ] vidhāya cavidhātavyā dvibhāgena kanyasī pratimā ca sāmadhyamā syāddvibhāgena [gh: madhyamārcā vibhāgena] kāryaikāṃśena pīṭhikā

sanskrit: kartavyā taddvibhāgena pratimā sottamā matānavāntaṃ tritrikānteṣu kanyasādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥpīṭha [gh: pīṭhaṃ] dvārapravistāraṃ mayaścakresvake matetithimāsanavatyardhaihīnamadhyottamāstridhāpaṅgurūpāśca [gh: paṅgurūpāḥ sa] kūṣmāṇḍāḥ saptadhārcāśca [mū: dhārvāśca]vartayetvibhajya śaktisūtreṇa ṛkṣādibhyaḥ [mū, a, k, kh: ṛkṣyādityaḥ] śubhe dinepīṭhātmāśrayajīvāṃśca prabhādīṃśca prakalpayetkṛtvādhoṃśagataḥ [mū: cādhogataḥ] pīṭhaṃ tribhāge jīvakalpanāsātmāśrayāṃ sadūtīṃ [mū: sabhūtāṃ] ca pratimāṃ vartayettataḥbhāgaikamaṅgula kṛtvā mahārcāṃ vatayedbudhaḥeka bhāge'ṅgulaṃ tasyā [gh: tasyāṃ] stenāṅgaṃ parikalpayetmaye sūtraṃ samaṃ nyasya ṛjvarcāṃ kārayecchubhāmjīvasyāddairghyamānena pratyaṅgānyadhunā vruvemātrābhistithisaṃkhyābhirmukuṭa [mū, a, k, kh: mukuṭe] veṣṭanaṃ bhavettālamānaṃ bhavedvakraṃ grīvā ca caturaṅgulātālaikaikapramāṇaṃ syādūrū tālavinirgamaup. 84) jñeyau gulphau dvinetrau ca pārṣṇīdvyaṅgulake mate [k: kramāt]madhye kalādvayocchrāyovagresārdhārdha [kh: sā cārdha] mātrakaupañcāṅgulau veṣṭanena sārdhāṅgaladviparvaṇītryaṅgulā pariṇāhena kathyante tvadhunāparāḥpādāṅgulyastriparvāṇaḥ parvārdhanakhaśobhitāḥkārāṅghri [mū, a, k, kh: nakhāṅghri] talakaṃ raktaṃ nakhāḥ savonnatāruṇāḥupabāhū daśāṣṭāṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulakau bhujaubhūtāṅgulā bhavenmadhyā ardhahīnā tvanāmikāmadhyamādyāstriparvāṇo dviparvāṅguṣṭhako mataḥ

sanskrit: tarjanyanāmikāparva sapādayavavarjitamdvyaṅgulo'ṅguṣṭhakagranthirāsāṃ parvārdhagā nakhāḥnāsotsedhaḥ savistārodvyaṅgulo dvipuṭaḥ [mū, a: dvikuṭaḥ] śubhaḥdvyardhaṃ yavaṃ puṭe sthūle madhye vaśa [k, kh: viṃśaḥ] stribhiryavaḥadhe'paro'ṅgulakaṃ tu [k, g: ṅ gulakarṇa] dvyaṅgule cibukasthitiḥnāsikāmūlapārśve tu locane dvyaṅgulāyate [g: locanamaṅgulāyate]indīvarābjapatrābhā paṭolaphalavatstriyāḥpañcamāṃśaṃ bhavejjyotiḥ sṛkkaṇīsūtratulyataḥardhāṅgulasamā droṇī sārdhadvyaṅguladīrghatāp. 86) tayora taramātrārdhaṃ striyāṃ yavārdhavistṛte [gh: yathāmbuvistṛte]karṇau netradayāyāmau tadardhādvistarastayoḥkalārdhaṃ (tadukau [mū,a: tuḍhukau; k, g: tuṭukau; kh: tupukau] khalvau ?) pāśau kuryādyathepsitauindrasaṅkhyāṅgulaṃ paścātkarṇayorantaraṃ viduḥlalāṭo'ṣṭāṅgulāyāmastryaṅgulaḥ śaṅkha ucyatesaptāṅgulau kapolau tu sāṅgulau sayavocchrayauhanū kalā tradīrghau vdikalaścibukodgamaḥskandho'ṣṭāṅgulavistārastadāyāmaścatuṣkalāvistāraḥ kūrparastasmādbhūtāṅgulairyavaistathāp. 87) caturaṅgulavistāro maṇibandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥstanayorantaraṃ tālaṃ tayoḥ prāntau dvinetrakaunābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā nimnato'rdhāṅguloditāhṛdviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ nābhideśaścaturdaśapañcādaśāṅgulaṃ [mū, a, k, g: pañcāśadaṅgulaṃ] vakṣo hṛddeśaḥ pañcabhirvinākaṭiḥ saṃveṣṭanenoktā śatācca [k, kh: sa tāvat] dvyadhikāṅgulācaturnetrapravistārau gajakumbhopamau śubhau

sanskrit: mehanastryaṅgulo dairghyātyariṇāhe [mū: pariṇāhāt] ṣaḍaṅgulaḥpāyoścavṛṣaṇasyāntavistāreṇa dvigolakamtadadhaḥ piṇḍikāyāṃ ca jaṅghāyāṃ ghaṇṭikordhvataḥp. 88) evaṃ vistāra eteṣāṃ veṣṭanaṃ triguṇādhikambhujajaṅghāgrake caiva svavistārāttriveṣṭanamnāryaṣṭāṃśā ca tanvaṅgī [mū, a, kh: tattvaṅgī] cakṣuḥ śroṇī stanādhikātanmadhyatastvadhobhāge randhraṃ syāt kuñjaroṣṭhavatvṛttaṃ vedāsrakaṃ cāsyaṃ kuryātpretādirakṣasāmbrahmaviṣṇuharādīnāṃ saṃkṣepāllakṣma cocyatevakṣobāhūrujaṅghānāṃ [gh: jaṅghāyāṃ] karādīnāṃ krameṇa tudve dve caivāṅgule deye vaktrādiṣu yathākramamvāmanaḥ pañcatālaśca bhūtāṃśaiḥ paṅgukubjakaubuddhvā buddhvā tu yatnena sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā vicakṣaṇaḥp. 89) acatanmānataḥ kāryāḥ sarvāvayavabhūṣitāsthānakaiḥ karaṇairyuktā pratimaiṣā phalapradāvakrāṅgī [mū, a, k, kh, ṅ: cakrāṅgī] cipiṭā dīnā kṛśa [kh: bhūṣa] gātrī ca raudrikāsaṅkocakārikā stabdhā hīnavaktrā ca rogadāhīnajaṅghārisaukhyāthaṃ śuṣkā syānnṛpanāśinīudvegajananī sā tu bhrāmaṇī ca sadā bhavetvakrāṅgyarthāṅganāśāya cipiṭā duḥkhadāyinīdhanaghnī ca [mū: tu] kṛśāṅgī syācchasyaghnī tu kṛśodarīsuhṛddhanasutāṃstasmātkāryā sallakṣaṇāḥ sadāp. 90) chāyāgataṃ ca sarvāṅga [gh: sarvāṅka] bhittikaṃ kṣiptakaṃ tathākaraṇāni śataṃ cāṣṭau vyantarā [k, kh: pyantarā] ścātivistarāḥ (?)iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vyaktaliṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo vidhiḥ

sanskrit: kapālābhayahastogrā vāmādyā navaśaktayaḥdvīpicarmāhibhṛcchāntastryakṣo jaṭendubhūṣitaḥaṅgaṣaṭkasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ syātsiddhidāyakaḥ[atra ka. pustakasyā ṭippaṇī-yuva= īśaḥ, yauvanaḥ=puruṣaḥ, vṛddhaḥ=aghora, strī=vāmadevaḥ, bālaḥ=sadyojātaḥ, iti |] yuvayauvanavṛddhastrībālābhaḥ pañcavaktrabhṛtvāmenā [kh: dakṣeṇa; atraiva k. pustakasya ṭippaṇyāṃ akṣamālā iti śabdaśva prakṣiptaḥ] bhayamantrāṅka [gh: mantrāhva] kapālotpalapūra [atrāpi k. pustakasya ṭippaṇyāṃ bījapura iti prakṣiptaḥ] bhṛtdṛgraktāsihutāśābhāḥ sarve tryakṣā jaṭānvitāḥbabhrubhrūśmaśruddā?bhīmamastraṃ pītaṃ svaśastra [k, kh, g: suśastra] bhṛtśakti [pā: śānti] vajrākṣamālāsicakrāṇi dakṣiṇe kvacitekāsyaḥ pañcavaktro vā tryakṣo jaṭendubhṛcchivaḥp. 92) koṇeṣu caika [mū: caiva] rudrādyāḥ sitāsaṅnīlalohitāḥśivāyudhadharāstryakṣāḥ sṛṇyasibhyāṃ vinā kvacitpuṭāñjalikarāḥ sarve vidyeśāścaikavaktrakāḥvarābhayakapālābjajaṭendvajinanāgabhṛtdakṣiṇe śūlanistriśakuṭhārābhayadhārakaḥmuṇḍamālī śavārūḍho dvaitādvaite kramānmataḥsaumyaṃ prahasitāsyaṃ ca candramauliṃ jaṭādharamnāgendramekhalāyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam [kh: maṇḍitam]nṛtyantaṃ mahāhṛṣṭamāyudhākula [mū, a: māyudhojjvala] pāṇinambalanākārakaṃ bāhumekaṃ kṛtvā hṛdi sthitamvāme pratānitabhujaṃ samyak kṛtvā suśobhanam([koṣṭhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ k. pustake nāsti] sarvaśāntikaraṃ kuryādityevaṃ saumyarūpakamskandanandimahākālagaṇeśagaṇasaṃyutamsānandai rūpasampannairvīkṣyamāṇaṃ maheśvaram [kh, gh: vīkṣamāṇairmaheśvara]tadagre ca pranṛtyaṃśca bhṛṅgīkāryaṃ kṛśo bhṛśaḥvikṛtāstīkṣṇanāsāścacaurāgnyādipradāḥ [kh: prapadāḥ] kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: harasyaivaṃ bhavedarcā sthāne sthāne phalapradābhrukuṭībhīṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lelihānaṃ ca draṃṣṭriṇamnāgopavītinaṃ dīptaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitamcaturdaśakaraikāsyaṃ saumyaṃ vyāghrājināmbaramkhaṭvāṅgaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśaṃ cāpābhayakapālakammātṛbhūtānvitaṃ kuryādbhairavaṃ śāntikārakamkuryādaghoraghaṇṭeśaṃ dviraṣṭabhujamaṇḍitamupaviṣṭaṃ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakamp. 95) aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ kuryādvaradābhaya [g: bhavadābhaya] varjitamghṇṭāṃ ḍamarukaṃ caiva kuṭhāraṃ mudgaraṃ [k, g: mudgalaṃ] tathāsarvaśatruharaṃ nityaṃ mātṛbhiḥ parivāritamvyāghrājināṃśuka saumyaṃ nāgayajñopavītinamyāmye saumye ca bibhrāṇa dvābhyāṃ vyākhyānakaṃ tathāgauraṃ sitāmbaraṃ śāntaṃ kamaṇḍalusamanvitamamṛtāgamahastaṃ ca kuryāttatpārśvayoḥ sadāardhacandrāsanāsīnaṃ śvetarājīvamadhyagamp. 96) divyasiṃhāsanāsīnaṃ brahmādyaiḥ parivāritamkapālamālinaṃ śvetaṃ yogāsanaṃ kajasthitamtriśūlaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca [kh, gh: tu] bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe karekuryānmṛtyuñjayaṃ devaṃ mṛtyurogavināśakam [mū, a, g: -śanam]vāmāṅge lalanā kāryā yoṣidābharaṇānvitāīśe śūlaṃ kapālaṃ ca vāme jāpyamathotpalamkuṇḍalālaṅkṛtaḥ saumyo dvibhujo dvipicarmabhṛtmithaḥ saṃvīkṣyamāṇāsyo yāmyahastasthitotpalaḥp. 97) vidheyaḥ śāstravidvadbhirūrdhvaliṅga umeśvaraḥ

sanskrit: haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥsadyaḥ prabhṛtijau dvau dvau tadvatkuḍyabjasaṃyutāḥvṛṣasthā varadāḥ kuṇḍīśūlapaṅkajapāṇayaḥśaṅkhacakrabhṛtaṃ vāme śeṣe śāntigadābhṛtam [gh: karam]śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ pīnāṅgaṃ pṛthuvakṣasamprasannavadanaṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamśaṅkhacakradhare kārye [gh: dharau kāryau] tatsaumyāgneyapārśvataḥp. 98) vāme'bhayapradaṃ śeṣe śaṅkhahastaṃ dvibhāhukamkruddha udyatahastaśca prāsādasthaḥ sadā mataḥsandaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭaḥ kruddho viṣṇuraṣṭabhujo mataḥcakraṃ cāpaṃ ca khetaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ vāmakare tathāekāsyaścaturāsyaśca trimukho vā maye matetattryaṃśavistaraṃ caiva puccho'dhaṃ saptabhāgaśaḥhastau kroḍasamīpasthau pādau jaṭharapārśvataḥardhāṅgulaṃ tu tannetraṃ dvisārdhaikārdhabhāgataḥśeṣaṃ rohitavatkuryānmatsyarūpadhare vibhau [k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: harervidhau]p. 99) taddvyaṃśamadhyato vṛttaṃ kalāhīnaṃ tu pārśvayoḥdviguṇaṃ pādato dairghyādgrīvāṃ mastakasaṃyutāmnāsākṣinakhakarṇādi jñātvā kūrmaṃ vivartayethanū tadvaktrabhāge ca dairghyātsaptāṅgulau mataudaṃṣṭre ca tryaṅgule vaktre sitarṣikalikopameprāṅmānādyavahīnaṃ tu cakragāruṇalocanam [gh: locane]gadācakrābjaśaṅkhāḍhyamālīḍhakaraṇe sthitamevaṃ varāharūpaṃ syādvanamālāvibhūṣitamnarāṅgaṃ [gh: varāṅgaṃ] siṃhavaktraṃ ca vṛttākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīyutam [mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: mukham]

sanskrit: tadvakṣo dārayantaṃ ca sphuraccakragadādharamvanamālānvitaṃ kuryānnarasiṃhaṃ jagatprabhumjaṭilaṃ kuṇḍikāyuktaṃ gauraṃ śyāmāruṇekṣaṇamvāmāṅghryākrāntaviśvaṃ ca tadbhedaṃ tu [mū, a, k: ca] trivikramamśyāmavarṇo bṛhadvakṣo rāmaḥ kṣatrāntakārakaḥjaṭī cāpeṣuhastaśca rāmaḥ kāryo daśāsyahṛtgadālāṅgaladhārī ca rāmaḥ kaṃsāntakārakaḥūrdhvapadmasthito buddho varadābhayakārakaḥgauro vājisthitaḥ khaḍgī kvacitpiṅgalalocanaḥrāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca buddhaḥ kalkī ca te daśaūrdhvādhaḥ karayoḥ śaṅkhapadme dakṣiṇato mate [k, kh: dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ]jvaladagnisamākāraṃ kuryātkeśavarūpakamvāmayośca gadācakre nīlaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vapuḥsavyayoḥ kambupadme ca mādhave rukmasannibheūrdhvādhobjaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca govinde piṅgalātmake [kh: piṅgalāṅgake]vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kuryātsite viṣṇau kvacinmatevāmayośca gadāpadme candrābhe madhusūdanecakramūrdhvamadhaḥ śaṅkhaṃ gaure pūrvatrivikramegadābje śeṣayoḥ pīte vāmane pūrvarūpakep. 103) gadāśaṅkhaṃ tathā vāme śrīdhare vidrumopamesuvarṇābhe hṛṣīkeśe pāṇyoḥ savyāpasavyayoḥgadādhaścakramūrdhvaṃ ca padmanābhe sitaprabhedakṣiṇe cottare haste deve dāmodare'ruṇepradyumnāccāniruddhācca vijñātavyāstrayastrayaḥmārgādikārtikāntaṃ ca proktā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ
