sanskrit: yogamudrāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca gadācakradharaṃ dvayammudrāṃ kuryāddhṛdisthāṃ ca aśeṣāghapraṇāśinīmpātraśāntidharaṃ yāmye vāmake padmasīriṇaukaumodyā hetirājena pāñcajanyāmbujena canārāyaṇādipañcānyatpūrvoktakaraśastrabhṛtebhiryuktaṃ navavyūhaṃ jñātavyaṃ daiśikottamaiḥvāmotsaṅgadhṛtaśrīkamardhacandrāsane sthitamtaddakṣiṇaṃ karaṃ skandhe devadevasya dakṣiṇepadmastho ghūrṇitākṣaśca gātṛnartanakairvṛtaḥadvaitena vidhānena pūjanīyo vipaścitāp. 105) yoganidrāparāvasthaḥ [kh: dharāvasthaḥ] supto'nantatanūparipādalagnā dharādevī jalaśāyī grahāvṛtaḥābhyutthapaṅkajārūḍhaḥ pitāmahasamanvitaḥsā līḍho nandane rāgī sadā cāpeṣubhṛcchubhaḥ [gh: bhṛtsutaḥ]tuṅgaghrāṇo [k, kh: tuṅgaghoṇā] narāṅghirvā pakṣijaṅgho narāṅgakaḥvāmajānugato bhūmau tārkṣyaḥ pakṣasamanvitaḥhalaśaṅkhavaro mālī viśvakseno harergaṇaḥpadmasīradharaṃ vāme śeṣe muśalagodvaham [k, kh: khādyayugodvaham]ardhe'rdhe bhūṣaṇaiḥ svaiḥ svairyuktamūrdhvaṃ kajasthitamakṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca kaumudīṃ kramātpuṃstrīsvarūpakaṃ kuryācchivanārāyaṇātmakambrahmāṇaṃ vratinaṃ kuryājjaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam [kh: bhūṣaṇam]kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca tatskandhe vastraṃ cājinavāsasamsruvaṃ [gh: srucaṃ] kamaṇḍaluṃ vāme sakuśājyaghaṭaṃ tathāgāyatrīṃ caiva sāvitrīmṛṣīṃstatpārśvayostathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: riktavakṣo'kṣikukṣīṃśca sākṣamālākamaṇḍalūnkruddhāmūrdhvasthitāṃ cāru kuryādviṃśatibāhukāmḍamaruṃ śastrikāṃ yāmye haste sa bibhratīṃ sadāghaṇṭādhvajagadādarśamudgarān vāmahastakaiḥkāryā daśabhujā cāpi saiva devī kvacinmateśastrodyatakaraḥ kruddhastad pīvāsambhavaḥ pumānsiṃhena khādyamānaśca pāśabaddho gale bhṛśamcaṇḍikodyataśastreyamaśeṣaripunāśanīādau madhye tathendrādau navatattvākṣaraiḥ kramātp. 108) mūrdhajaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāmādarśaṃ tarjanīṃ dhanuḥśaktimudgaraśūlaṃ ca vajraṃ khaḍgamathāṅkuśamśeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāśca añjanī [mū: añjalī] ḍamaruṃ vinācaṇḍā caṇḍavatī caiva caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikārocanābhāruṇā kṛṣṇā nīlā śuklā ca dhūmrikā [kh: sūkṣmā ca dhūmikā]mahiṣotthaḥ pumāñśastrī tatkacagrahamuṣṭikāḥnavadurgāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya putrārthāyuravāpnuyātbibhratī daṇḍikākuṇḍyāvakṣasūtraṃ varaṃ kramātsaiva rambhāvane siddhāgnihīnā lalitānyathāyāmye phalāñjanīhastā saubhāgyā tatra cordhvikā [mū, a: cordhikā]trinetrā jaṭilā saumyā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāabhayaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ śūlaṃ sthitaṃ vāmakare sadāvināvarā bhayābhyāṃ tu kartavyā savamaṅgalāśayyārūḍhā prasuptā ca yoganidrā samāśritāvaṃśotthakarṇikākarṇā tailābhyaktaśarīriṇīnavatyūrdhva [mū, a, k, kh: vardhanyūrdhva] vajā kṛṣṇā kālarātrī bhayaṅkarī

sanskrit: hemavarṇābjasaṃsthā ca pīnonnatapayodharāsadā yāmyakarāmbhojā vāme śrīḥ śrīphalānvitāgajau bhṛṅgārahastau ca snāpayantau ca [gh: yantyau tu] pārśvataḥpustā [kh: suptā] kṣamālikāhastā vīṇābhṛdvā sarasvatīkumbhendīvarahastā ca dvārasthā janhuputrikāindīvaradalaśyāmā surūpā yamunā tathādvīpicarmadharaṃ kuryādvīṇāhastaṃ ca tumburumanantaraṃ tu mātṛśca brahmāṇyādyāstu sapta cakuṇḍyājyapātriṇīṃ vāme brahmāṇīṃ haṃsasaṃsthitamkapālamālinīṃ śuklāṃ rudrāṇīṃ vṛṣasaṃsthitām [k, kh, g: vṛṣabhasthitām]śikhipṛṣṭhasamārūḍhāṃ kaumārīṃ skandarūpiṇīmśyāmāṃ surūpiṇīṃ kuryādvaiṣṇavīṃ vanamālinīmsuvastrāṃ yauvanodbhinnāṃ nāryābharaṇabhūṣitāmkhaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktāmathavāpi caturbhujāmindrāṇīṃ sarvasiddhyarthaṃ vastrālaṅkārasaṃyutāmvivatāsyāṃ tu daṃṣṭrogrāṃ śave vā kauśike sthitāmkapālaṃ katarīṃ yāmye pāśaṃ śūlaṃ ca vāmakemātṛsthāne'thavaikāṃ vā tadante ca gaṇeśvaraḥgajacarmabhṛdūrdhvābhyāṃ ṣaḍdoḥ syādrudracarcikā [citrapustake mahālakṣmī vidyate rudracarcikaiva samucita iva pāṭhaḥ | 78 citraṃ draṣṭavyam |]tena sā rudracāmuṇḍā [rudracāmuṇḍāyāḥ 79 saṃ0 citraṃ dra0 |] nāṭye [nāṭyeśvaryāḥ 80 saṃ ci0 dra0 |]śvaryatha nṛtyatīnṛpājimahiṣebhāṃśca khādantī cet kare sthitānekāsyā śvetavarṇa ca śvetābharaṇabhūṣitādaśabāhu [kh: śatābāhu] strinetrā ca śastrāsiṃ ḍamaruṃ nṛkamkhaṭvāṅgaṃ ca triśūlaṃ ca siddhacāmuṇḍikāhvayāetadrūpā bhavedanyā pāśāṅkuśayutāruṇā

sanskrit: vetālaśākinīgṛdhrakākolūkaśivākulāādyāṣṭakamidaṃ khyātaṃ śeṣabhedastu vistaraḥdanturākṣemakarī syādbhūmau jānukarāsthitāeṅgā (?) hāsyā mahodaryo rūpiṇyo'psarasaḥ [atraiva kvaciccaṇḍaḥ ityāpi pāṭhaḥ citrapustake] sadāyogeśvaroratha vīraśca ardhacandrāsane sthitaḥbadhdvā vinyasya hṛdaye'thavottānakaradvayampracaṇḍo daṇḍadhārī ca kāryaścaṇḍeśvaro mahānmahodaro vṛhaddeha ekadantastrilocanaḥdivyāmbaradharaḥ kāryo nāgayajñopavītavānṣoḍaśāṅgulakaṃ dairghyācchuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍtriṃśadaṅgulampīnaḥ samunnatoraskaḥ kartavyo gaṇanāyakaḥkaṇṭhaguhayāntaraṃ kāryaṃ samaṃ dvātriṃśadaṅgulammastakaṃ niviḍaṃ vyastaṃ vāma [mū, a: vāta] kumbhasamunnatamrandhraṃ randhrāṅgulau kumbhau tanmadhye sūtramānataḥekaikaṃ hrāsayogena yāvadvedāṅgulasthitiḥp. 115) pañcatālapradairghyaṃ ca [k, kh: pradairghyāṅga] catustālaviveśanamsvadantaṃ [g: sudaṇḍaṃ] dakṣiṇe pāṇau vāmahaste ca laḍḍukamgaṇeśalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ caturhastaṃ tu nānyathā [k, kh: stvato'nyathā; gh: tathānyathā]bhujābhyāmadhikaṃ kuryātṣaḍbhujaṃ pūrvavacca tam [g: dvṛtam]vāmaṃ cābhayadaṃ hastaṃ śubhaṃ cāṣṭabhujānvitampadmādhastāttu kartavyo mahākhu [mū, a, g, gh: mahokṣa] ścārurūpavānṣaḍbhujaścāṣṭabāhuśca prahṛṣṭastāṇḍavākulaḥādyaṃ sitaṃ gṛhe'bhīṣṭaṃ trividhaṃ suramandirebhujairdvādaśabhiryuktaḥ skando mukhyaḥ surūpakaḥśāntyā ca dakṣiṇe haste ṣaḍbhirvāmakare tathā

sanskrit: gauṇaḥ kṣetre'thavā ṣaḍdorekavaktraḥ praśasyateyathākramaṃ sadā ṣaḍbhirdakṣiṇottarapāṇibhiḥbibhrachaktiṃ kare yāmye tāmracūḍaṃ tathetareśikhyārūḍhastu śārvo'yaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhaṣitaḥśilāhemādilohairvā vṛṣaṃ kuryādyathepsitamsādhāraṇeṣu liṅgeṣu prastāvādvihito vṛṣaḥliṅgatryaṃśojhitaḥ kāryastaddvirāyativigrahaḥśubhonmolitadṛglakṣma liṅgamastakamastakaḥdairghyāccaturaśotyaśāscāṅgulaṃ tena kalpanamaṣṭanetrapṛthutvaṃ syāproccaistadvaktradīrghatātantribhāgaṃ tu tārā syājjyotistatpañcamāṃśataḥnāsāṅgulapramāvṛttā [mū: pramodvṛttā; k, kh: bhramādvṛttā] dvinetraṃ śuṣirāntaram [mū: svaśirāntaram]pañcanetraṃ tu vistāraṃ tadūrdhva tu vivardhate [mū: vivarjayet]caturnetrobhayoḥ [mū, a, k, g: netre tayoḥ] pārśve vaktramānaṃ tu sandhitaḥtanmūle saptavistāraṃ karṇamūlasamanvitamaṅgulārdhasamaṃ yāvanmūlaṃ pañcakavartulam [mū: vartanam]karṇamūlāttu nāsārdhaṃ sūtrahāsānnayetsamamśaṅkhamūla dvinetraṃ syādyathāgre netrapādakampārśvapiṇḍī dvinetrārdhaṃ ṣaḍnetrāgrāvaṭuḥ [g: śrāvaduḥ] smṛtaḥdvinetrocchrayatordhvaṃ [mū: ūrdhaṃ] syādvṛttamūrdhvaṃ [k, g: lajūṃ] yathā bhavetsandhirnetrādhikaḥ [mū: sadvinetrārdhika] proktaścaturnetropajaṅghikāgulphārdhaṃ khurikānetraṃ pādasyātparimāṇataḥcaturdaśādi tadvaca trihīne copajaṅghrikāṣaḍnetrāntastathājñeyā tasmātsyātpucchasantatiḥtālatrayaṃ pradīrghaṃ syāttālārdhaṃ keśasaṃhatiḥ

sanskrit: tribhirvinā tathāgre syāddvinetraṃ kambalastvadhaḥtriguṇāstu smṛto'nyatra nābhirnetradvayaṃ bhavetjaṅghā netraṃ smṛta, sandhiḥ ṣaḍnetrā copajaṅghikākhurike'ṅgulimānetu pañcanetratrayaṃ vināpṛṣṭhagatā ca vijñeyā dyaṅgulādhāṅgulaṃ yathātrimukhā trikalāhāsaḥ pṛṣṭhataścopajaṅghikāviśvakarmātpunaścānyaṃ vṛṣaṃ vakṣyāmi lāghavātkṣetraṃ vedāsrakaṃ kṛtvā navabhāgānprakalpayettribhāgairagrato [mū: rurdhvato] jaṅghā bhāgaikaṃ tūrdhvato haretp. 120) hṛtvā [mū: kṛtvā] bhāgadvayaṃ cordhvaṃ kāryaṃ nāsālalāṭakamtadadhoṃśāttathā luptvā karśoṃ kṛtvā tu śṛṅgavatkarṇādhaḥ koṇasūtraṃ tu dantordhvārdhahareddhruvamsārdhabhāgadvayenaiva pṛṣṭhasya parikalpanam [k: parikalpanā]bhāgoṃ'śaṃ gṛhnya cādhoṃśe tyaktvārdha koṇāsūtrataḥsphicaṃ pucchaṃ sakeśaṃ ca vartayenmatimānnaraḥjānurandhraṃ tathā sakthisandhiṃ jaṅgā khuraṃ budhaḥjñātvā lakṣmaṃ prakurvīta vṛṣaṃvṛṣa bharupakamsākṣamālī triśūlī ca nandīśo dvārapālakaḥkūrcavān piṅgakeśaśca muṇḍamālī trilocanaḥkṛṣṇagātro mahākālo dvāre vai vāmataḥ sthitaḥvṛddharūpaḥ śikhī hṛṣṭaḥ kṣāmakukṣiḥ supāṇḍuraḥbhṛṅgirīṭīgaṇāścaiva nṛtyannityaṃ śivāgrataḥdaṇḍī karaṇḍakopetaḥ kūṣmāṇḍaḥpūrvamānataḥkāryāste gajagokarṇā nānāvaktrā mahodarāḥlelihānaḥ susaṃkruddho jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitaḥ

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśa bhujo bhīmo jvaladāyudhapāṇikaḥninghandakṣiṇāhastaiśca pāparogamadhaḥ sthitamghaṇṭākuṭhārakaṃ vāmaiḥ vibhṛddvābhyāṃ triśūlakamghaṇṭāmālākulo devaḥ puṇḍarīkājināmbaraḥturagaiḥ saptabhiryukta ūrdhvaṃ tatrāsthito raviḥkapilo hemabhadraśca bhavaseno hayāḥ kvacitanuṣṭuppaṅktirityuktāśchandāṃsi harayo raveḥsahasrāṃśurmahātejā maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥsanālapatre rājīve bibhratskandhe kare kramātmasībhājanalekhanyau dhārayanhastayordvayoḥbālavyajanadhāriṇyau rājñīchāye [saṃjñāchāye, iti sādhu pāṭho bhavet |] tu pārśvayoḥ [mū, a, g: pārścataḥ]ākṛṣṭakaṇabāṇāca pārśce dakṣiṇake sthitāathavāśvasamārūḍhaḥ kārya ekastu bhāskaraḥmadhye kuṇḍayakṣamālāvān pūrvārdhe[k, kh, gh: mūrdhnyardha]vedikākaraḥanye yamādivanyahyantā[k, kh, g, gh: rakṣāntā]ścaturhastā dviṣaḍdalemudgarasṛṇicakrasrugbhuṃto[mū: srugvanto]'gnyādividiksthitāḥvaruṇaḥ sūryaṃnāmā ca sahasrāṃśustathāparaḥeter'kā dvādaśa jñeyā meṣādi [gh: jhaṣāni]rāśisaṃsthitāḥkapilaḥ pītavarṇaśca śukābho dhavalastathāiḍā suṣumnā viśvārcirbindu saṃjñā pramardinīnīlāmbarā dhanāntaḥ sthā amṛtāhvā ca śaktayaḥsvadevarupavarṇāṃstāḥ kesarāgreṣu vinyasetdakṣiṇo śūladhārī ca vāmahaste kapālabhṛtdhārayannitare haste dvābhyāmabjau karānakaiḥcaturbhiraṣṭabhirvāpi madhye'bje'ṣṭada[so'ṣṭa]lānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 125) vedāṃśapātanātkoṇa marṭāśairatha kambalam [kh: kandharam]tryaṃśapraveśanātkaṇṭhādekaikanirgamaṃ khuramghaṇṭāṃ ca mekhalāṃ caiva kuryāchṛṅgāṇi koṇataḥprālambyāsakta [mū: pālambyāyya] revanta [gh: revantu]śchatradhārādibhiryutaḥnānāratnasuveśāḍhyā [gh: sukhesyāḍhyā]ścaṇḍatejāḥ svabhāvajāḥp. 126) somaṃ saumyaṃ tathā śvetaṃ kuṇḍikājāpyamālinambudhaṃ śyāmaṃ yuvānaṃ ca rūpiṇaṃ cāpapāṇinamyāmyekākṣaṃ sitaṃ śukraṃ kuṇḍikāmantramālikamvyāvṛttāsyaṃ sahāsyaṃ ca piṅgabhrūśmaśrulocanamtriphaṇaṃ [mū, a, k, kh: triphalaṃ] dhūmravarṇābhaṃ naranāgārdharūpiṇam [gh: naraṃ]etāṃstu dvibhujānsarvānbhūṣaṇāmbarasaṃyutānśakaṭaṃ medhameteṣāmadho yānaṃ kramātsadāsitaḥ sahasrabhogo hīśvaraḥ [mū, a: hī śiraḥ] kuvalayānvitaḥkṛṣṇaḥ karkoṭakaḥ kaṇṭhe śulkarekhātrayānvitaḥśaṅkhavarṇo mahāpadmo mastake kṛṣṇaśūladhṛk [k: śūlakam]kuliko raktadehastu candrārdha [g: candrārka] kṛtamastakaḥakṣasūtradharāḥ sarve kuṇḍikāpucchasaṃyutāḥbhṛtyāścaikaphaṇāḥ kāryāstadrūpā maṇivarjitāḥhārakuṇḍalakeyūraiḥ sadābhara[k: sarvābharaṇa]ṇabhūṣitāīdṛśī manasā kāryā śrīkaṇṭhamanasambhavāyogapaṭṭāvṛto'bjasthaḥ kuṇḍikā cākṣasūtrabhṛt [mū, a, k: dhṛk]nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktāvutpalamaṇi bhṛtkarausudṛṣṭā [g: sukṛṣṇā] jalpamānā ca svotsaṅge putradhāriṇīpadmā [gh: parṇā] nandanapadmastha svāṅgādevī [gh: suṅgādevī] prakīrtitābasukokakapidvikṣa [gh: dvikka] vyāghravyāghrāsyakaṃ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rakṣodvitayakumbhīra [kumbhīraḥ nakrābhidhojalavaraḥ | kintvasya citrodāharaṇe śukābhidhaḥ; pakṣiveśeṣo vartate | ślokānusāreṇa nakrābhidho jalacara viśeṣa eva bhavitumarhati |] sarpacakrāsyakaṃ [k, kh: nakrāsyakaṃ] ca bhamaśvinau ca yamo vahniḥ prajendrenduharo'ditiḥp. 129) tvaṣṭā vāyuḥ surendro'gnirmitrendrau yāvatpāmpatiḥ [mū: yātudhāmpatiḥ]viṣṇurvasurajaikādipādahirbudhna [gh: rajaikādyahirbudhna] pūṣakāḥpumān gadī savīṇā ca yoṣitta [k, kh, gh: yoṣicca] nmithunaṃ dhanuḥstrī naustholkāsibhṛtkanyā tulādhāro narastulāmeṣādyāḥ pañca caivānye [gh: evādye] svanāmatulyarūpakāḥhemābhaḥ sakirīṭaśca devarājaḥ surāvṛtaḥchāgasthaḥ [asya sthāne mṛgo vartate citrapustake] sākṣasūtrograḥ saptārciḥ śaktidhārakaḥraktahṛkpāśabhṛtkṛṣṇo mahiṣasthogradūtavānpuṃsthita khaḍgahastaśca nīlābho rākṣasāvṛtaḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyukto varūṇaḥ pītavastrabhṛtraktakṣo [gh: raktāsyo] raktavāsaśca mṛgasthaścaṅkuśī dhvajīdhaneśo varadaḥ kāryo nānābharaṇamaṇḍitaḥīśāno'hīndubhṛccaite lokapālā dvibāhavaḥviśvakarmā sadā gauro jñānamudrākṣasūtrabhṛtālīḍhakaraṇāsaktaṃ mahākāyaṃ subhīṣaṇampītadhvajadharaṃ vāme tarjanīṃ vā hṛdagrataḥsaṃpīḍya rākasān padbhyāṃ muñcannādaṃ[mū, a, kh, g: padbhyāmuccapādaṃ]marutsutamskandhayakṣānvitā nityaṃ kartavyā yoṣidanvitāḥmālābhṛto'thavā hṛṣṭāḥ khasthā vidyādharāḥ sadāpiṅgavarvara[mū: carcara]keśāśva vetālā vikṛtānanāḥ [g: vibṛtānanāḥ]p. 132) kapālamālinaḥ śūladhārīṇaḥ kṣetrapālakāḥkṛśā mahodarāḥ pretā khalva[g: khalu]gallāśca lomaśāḥsvāṅgavarṇadharāḥ sarvā yathoktaṃ brahmayāmale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: piṅgākṣī cākṣayākṣapā [gh: kṣeya] ilā līlā layā tathāhutāśā ca viśālākṣī huṅkārā vaḍavāmukhīsarbajñā taralā tārā ṛgvedā tu hayānanāraktākṣī suprasiddhā tu vidmujjihvā karaṅkiṇīp. 133) candrā candravalī caiva prapañcā pralayāntikāyamanī tapanī caiva vāmanī vikṛtānanāyamajihvā jayantī ca durjayā ca yamāntikācatuḥ ṣaṣṭiriyaṃ devyā mūrtibhedā nigadyatehemābhā bhūṣaṇāḍhyā syādakṣobhyā karisaṃsthitādhanuḥ kapābhṛtsaumye ṝkṣasthā tarjanīyutāpretasthā rāghasī gaurī kārdhakatarikānvitākapālaṃ ca phalaṃ saumye dhatte kubjanṛsaṃsthitāvāme kapālapicchī [k, kh: piṇḍī] bhṛtsarvālaṅkāramaṇḍitākauśeyapāśabhṛdyāmye vāme cāṅkuśakheṭinīkuṭhārāśanibhṛdyāmye saumye pāśāṅkuśānvitāyāmye ḍamaruśūleṣumastahastākṣapā matāraktā bahirsthitā tvīlā krīḍantī dahanaiḥ sahabibhrāṇā paṭṭiśaṃ pāśaṃ vāme mastārdhamambujamkartarīkārdhabhṛdvāme tarjanyākṛṣṭasṛkkikāśūlaṃ ruruyutaṃ dvābhyāṃ dhatte lolā sūsārase (?)laṅkeśorusthitā laṅkā carvantīṃ [mū: varṣantī] piśitaṃ ghanamśoṇā laṅkeśvarī kuṇḍe ūrdhvabālāṃ ca [mū: ūrvālācaraṇe] bibhratībibhrāṇā kolagā raktā lālāsṛglālāsā matākartarīkumbhabhṛdyāme saumye pāśakapālinī [kh: kadhāriṇī]vāme cābhayahastā syādviṣṭarājyaghaṭānvitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kartaryabhayabhṛdyāmye vāme kaṇṭākapālinīmusalaṃ bibhratī yāmye somye ca phalapallavausamatsya [gh: samatse]kārdhabhṛdvāme matsyamanyatra vāsitāhāhāravā sitā krūrā rāsabhāsyā kharāsanā [mū, a, g, gh: kharānanā]vāme masīghaṭīṃ pāśaṃ lekhanīdaṇḍabhṛttataḥvāme samadiraṃ pātraṃ [g: śūlaṃ] bibhratī jambuke sthitāyāmye'syāḥ khiṅkhirīṃ (?) śūlaṃ kharparaṃ lelihānyataḥbibhrāṇobhājina [ibha arjinam iti cchedaḥ |] dvābhyāṃ sarvajñā pretagāsitāśalaḍamaruhastā ca godhāgā taralāsitāśavārdhaṃ bibhratī saumye śūlaṃ mugdaramanyataḥdakṣiṇo jāpyayāmālāṃ ca vāme pusta kamaṇḍalumśūrpamuṇḍakarā yāmye'nyatra śephālikākabhṛtkhadvāṅgaṃ rurukaṃ saumye śūlolke bibhratī tataḥkaśūlāndhakakaṅkālabhṛdadvayo ścamavāsinīvāme karoghadhāpāśaṃ[k, kh, g: dyathānāsaṃ; gh: pavānāsaṃ]ghaṇṭeśūlkadharānyathaḥp. 137) śaṅkhakheṭakahastogrā yāmye svastikakhaḍgabhṛtgadādhvajadharā yāmye vāme pāśakapālabhṛtcakrasthā cakrakaṭṭārīdhārīṇī [kh: cakravākaśca cakrasthā] dakṣiṇe karekumbhapāśadharāśvetā kroḍaputrā karaṅkiṇījalairvṛtā ghanārūḍhā taḍinmaṇḍalamaṇḍitākapālaṃ muṇḍamanyatra śatrughnāḥ sphaṭikatviṣaḥkālakarṇī jagatkhyātā karṇe kālavibhūṣaṇākartaryabhayabhradyāmye śūla [gh: pūra] pāśadharānyataḥkamaṇḍalukuśavyagrā cātrasūtrasruvānvitācandrāvalī ca hemābhā kṛṣṇasāramṛgāsanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajayānā prapañcākhyā gaurī viśvaprapañcikāp. 138) khādantyāmraphalaṃ nityaṃ kapyāsyā gaura varṇinībhindipālakakheṭābhyāṃ prāsāsibhyāṃ ca saṃyutā [gh: saṃyuge]kaṃ phalaṃ kartarīṃ khaḍgaṃ bibhratī saumyayāmyayoḥkharasthā babhruvarṇa syātpiśitāśātidurbalādhvana iḍamaru[gh: dhvajaṃ ḍamaru]kartaryau pāśaṃ picchaṃ ca bibhratīvamanī [g: ramaṇī] puṣpakasthā syādgaurī yakṣagaṇānvitāsvaphaṇā[k, g: suphaṇā]yāna bhāje [k: nubhogā; kh: dhārabhāge] ca nyastahastā bhavediyamkuṭhāraṃ laḍḍukaṃ vāme'kṣamālī panasaṃ tataḥjihvābhṛdvajriṇī pītā caturdorvikṛtānanādvihaṃsavadrathasthā syāttālābhā vāyuvegikāmahākāyā ca gauryaṅka[mū: gauryarka]kartarī bhṛnnṛkādanītūraṃ ḍamaruṃ yāmye'syāḥ śeṣe khaṭvāṅgamastakamvīndrasthā [vīndrapakṣirājaḥ] viśvarūpā syāddhemābhā vanamālinībibhratī yamajihvākhyā karālā mahiṣasdhitāsadaityamuṇḍaśūlogrā [li. pu: sadaityaśūlamuṇḍogrā] jayantī vāmahastayoḥnānābhūtāvṛtā śvetā durgakānanasaṃsthitāśakaṭasthātidhorāsyā kṣīravarṇā yamāntikā [mū, a: yavāntikā]vāme karaṃ [k, kh, g, gh: tūraṃ] ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ śūlaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ [gh: ghaṇṭaṃ] ca bibhratītriśūlayaṣṭi [k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: kaṃ śalayaṣṭi]bhṛdyāmye bhindipālagadāsibhṛtkartarīśūlabhṛtsūrye (saumye) vāme muṇḍakapālabhṛtśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ yāmye'syāḥ kārdhakhaṭvāṅgadhṛk tataḥkartavyāḥ śilpibhirnityaṃ yoginyo'śeṣasiddhidāḥkhaḍgāṅkuśakuṭhāreṣu viśvābhayakṛdarkataḥ [gh: dakṣataḥ]gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāso'hibhūṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pralayāmbudavarṇābho muṇḍakāpālamālinaḥ (kaḥ)caṇḍākhyo mātṛmadhye tu saṃsthitaḥ pītakūrcabhṛt [gh: pīnakūrkhadhṛk]tatṣaḍaṅgāni [g: taṃtsuta] jātyanataiḥ khānvitaṃ ca kramādyajetnādabindvindusaṃyuktaṃ [k, g: bindusaṃyuktaṃ] mātṛnāthānta [kh: nāthāṅga]dīpitamguhyadevānyarūpāṇāṃ sve sve śāstre viniścayaḥpañcadhā pratimāḥ khyātā mānataḥ saptadhā tathātatheśvarātsurā sarve kāryakāraṇabhedataḥiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye rudrādi vyaktaliṅga vartanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭo vidhiḥpañcāsyādi yathāliṅgaṃ bhavetsuvyaktapañcakam [mū, a: lakṣaṇam]pañcavaktramaniṣṭeṣu caturvaktraṃ sukhāvahamekavaktraṃ syādrogaghnaṃ nādhikāmyaṃ calācalamcaturmukhaṃ tu khādhāre [gh: mukhe sukhādhāre; k: tu prasāde] pañcāsyaṃ vā caturmukhamliṅgamūrdhnisthita vaktramaiśānaṃ tvīśamīkṣakam [mū: vīkṣakam]siṃhāsyaṃ [gh: siṃhāghraṃ] śmaśrukeśāḍhyaṃ maindraṃ tatpurūṣānanamdaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ vṛttākṣaṃ jvalatkeśādibhūṣitamkāntālaṅkārakeśādi [k, kh: keśāṃḍhya; g: keśāśca] tilakolakamaṇḍitamtryakṣaṃ pīnaṃ yuvākāraṃ suprasannaṃ suśobhamamsadyaḥ puṃbhyāṃ dvivaktraṃ syātpuruṣeṇaikavaktrakamtatvairliṅgaṃ grahairbhakte hṛtvāmbhoṃśo vidikṣu cadigvibhāgena tadvaktraṃ [mū: tadvaktaṃ] bhūtavedānanaṃ sadātadvaddyāsye dvimātrākhyamekāsye tritrikāṅgulānhṛtvā koṇeṣu randhrāṃśairliṅgaṃ ṣaṭtālaveṣṭitam([cāpacinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭho g. pustake nāsti]dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ca tatrāsyaṃ liṅgaṃ saptāsyaveṣṭitamnavatyaṅgulakaṃ [gh: tryaṅgulakaṃ] vṛttādekāsyaṃ pūrvavaktrakamp. 143) tadadhaḥṣaḍvibhāgena śivavaktrāṇi vartayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cibukoṣṭhau vibhāgena [mū, a, k, kh: ca bhāgena] nāsālalāṭastakamliṅgapārśce dvibhāgena bhāgaṃ tyaktvā tadūrdhvataḥpañtrāsyādyekavaktrāntamayameva vidhiḥ punaḥpañcānanādikaṃ proktaṃ suvyaktamadhudanocyatedvibāhūnyūrdhvadehāni viṣṇavantacaraṇāni capūrvakāye pumāṃsaṃ tu mātuluṅgākṣaśalinam [k, kh: sūtritam]stryākāramuktare guhyaṃ darpaṇotpalasaṃyutamsuvyakta pañcadhāhyevamāsyovatābidhisaṃsthitam [mū: saṃyutam]evaṃ niṣpādya liṅgāni piṇḍikāṃ vartayettataḥiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vyaktāvyaktaliṅgānāṃ daśadhā vartanaṃ nāma saptamo vidhiḥ athoṣṭamamahatyāḥ prātamāyāśca digliṅgādeśca sādhanenavajñāṃ kārayettasmātkadācidubhayorapipiṇḍikā tu samākhyātā na hīnā nādhikā śubhāmekhalā tattribhāgena khātaṃ tattryṃśahīnakammadhye vṛttaṃ samālikhya vartayetkhātamādarātarvāg dairghyatribhāgena mekhalāvartanaṃ bahiḥmukhe tadardhavistāraṃ tantribhāge'mbunirgamaḥkaṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ sadā hyevamanyathā doṣadāyakamṣaṣṭhāṃśaveśanātkaṇṭhaścalānāṃ pañcamena vāavyakte miśrake svāṃśe [mū: bhyāṃśe; g: dyāṃśe] brahmaviṣṇu[kh, gh: viṣṇo]svarūpataḥliṅgasthaulyapramāṇena samāsraṃ digvidiksthitamsamantājjyeṣṭhaliṅgasya yavaiḥ ṣaḍbhirvivardhitamliṅgavannirmalā śuddhā kartavyā piṇḍikā budhaiḥśeṣāṇāṃ liṅgānāmardhārdha hrāsayedyavamkāmānāṃ vasutastasya bhedān brūmaḥ samāsataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pīṭhikāyāḥ samucchrāyaṃ vikārāṃśena bhājayetguṇābhāge tathā kumbhaḥ kumbhapaṭṭi tu bhāgataḥpakṣabhāge [k, kh: pakṣābhāge] jalādhāra ekāṃśe śeṣapaṭṭikābāṇamatānusāreṇa kanyasī [kanīyasītyarthaḥ]tthaṃ payodharāpaṭṭopapaṭṭikā kaṇṭho galapaṭṭaṭdayupapaṭṭikāmekhalā paṭṭikā kintu bhāgakena tadūrdhvataḥucchrāyārdha tu pīṭhyāḥ (ṭhī) syādrudrabhāge dvidhā kṛtetribhiraljaṃ dvipaṭṭau (hi) tu dvābhyāṃ dvābhyā tathāmbujamdvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kramā[mū, a, k: tathā]tpadyaṃ sārdhāśe galanirgamaḥkaṇṭhadvayena [mū: kathadvayena] saṃyuktā ṣaḍbhiḥ padmairvibhūṣitāsamvartākhyā jalādhārā viṣṇubhāgāntamucchritāliṅganāhatriveṣṭena vṛttāvyaktasya piṇḍikātaddīrghatvārdhavistārāttadardhānnālakocchrayauucchraye daśadhābhakte padaṃ kumbhaṃ tathā galamkhuraṃ jaṅyā ca kūrṇauṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ caivopakaṇṭhikām [k, kh: pakarṇikām]ekayugmaikapakṣaikayugmaikagalāṃśakaiḥṣoḍaśāṃśakṛtocchāye jyeṣṭhānāmāsane sadācaraṇapaṭṭikākumbha paṭṭikā galapaṭṭikāaṣṭadigravihastaiśca hīnamadhyottamāstribhiḥpraveśogdamabāhulyācchū bhranālādi [kh: mānādi] pūrvavattattryaṃśātpīṭhavistārastatpādonasamucchrayaḥsaha kumbho galo vṛtto vedāsrā paṭṭikā kramāt([cāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ kh. pustake nāsti] anyatra tvevamevaṃ syātsaṃvṛttātkarṇa[gh: saṃvṛttāhvaṃtu]pīṭakamsuślakṣṇāśliṣṭasandhiśca rupeṇāmbudharādivatkeṣāṃcittu mate vyaktaliṅge tu chatramastake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmālliṅgānugaṃ pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ kartṛjīvaneyadi syāt pīḍyate rogaiḥ kartā rāṣṭraṃ gurūstathā [gh: stadā]ucchrayeṇa triliṅgānāṃ na nyūno nādhiko hareḥmunisārdhādhikaiḥ śambhuṃ kuryādāḍhyaṃ [k: dādyaṃ; gh: dārḍhyaṃ] vasorharimpādonāṣṭāṃśato brahmā kāryaṃ cānāḍhyakaṃ kvacitekaṃ surārcite liṅge brahmā saptāṃśake dhruvamsitādivarṇāvarṇānāṃ [k, g: pītādivarṇa] pīṭhādyā na vivarṇajāḥratnajā vātha lohairvā viśeṣātkīrtaye'dhunāvaiḍūryādyuttame nityaṃ hemajā piṇḍikā varābhāgadrayamathikaṃ vā vinyaset piṇḍikāvaṭaumekhalādivibhāgo'syāḥ pūrvavatsamudāhṛtaḥna nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ mānātśobhanaṃ [mū, a, kh: sbatalaṃ; gh: sutalaṃ] śvabhramiṣyatepīṭhadoṣātkṣayo nāryāḥ kāro kartuṃśca sarvadābhuktimuktyubhayaprāptyai anyaḥ [mū, a, g: prāptau anyaḥ] kāmyasya hetavepadmārdhendugaṇākhyā ca kāmadā śubhamastakedvimekhalā ca vedāsrā bhadrā yogarddhidāyinīṣaḍasrāyuḥ pradā vajrī mekhalātritayānvitāmaṇḍalā pūrṇacandrābhā tvarthadā pañcamekhalācandrāmburuparāmai [k: ke dharā vāme] kāgnidyaṃśaistithi bhājitaiḥvṛttā padmapuṭākārā karṇiko bhayacumbitāaṣṭakoṇā gaṇākhyātā [mū: khyā tu] muktidā [gh: bhuktidā] syāddvimekhalāpūrvoktamekhalāgartanālakādisamanvitāvistarokchrayanālādi sarbaṃ pūrvoṃditaṃ kramātsaṃveṣṭya vartayetpiṇḍīṃ kartuḥ kāmaprasādhikammārūtīṃ dhānadīṃ raudrīṃ vaiṣṇāvīṃ brahmajāṃ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūtramadhye'rdhasūtreṇa matsyān koṇeṣu sarvataḥvedāsraṃ piṇḍikākṣetraṃ kuṇḍānāmapi sarvadāmadhyānmadhyagataṃ sūtraṃ [k, kh: sūtraiḥ] koṇaṃ saṃveṣdya cāparamp. 151) tatsūtradvayasaṃyogātsādhayedvā triparṇikām [mū, a: bodhiparṇikām]saṃbhrāmya madhyataḥ sūtraṃ sādhayedardhacandrikāmrakṣo'gnisaumyakāṣṭhāsu ta trisūtrya[k, kh: trisatryā]trikoṇikāmmadhyādhasūtrasaṃbhrāntaiḥ piṇḍikā vartulā [gh: vartanād] bhavetturyāsravṛttayormadhye yamandvoḥ sūtrapātanambhavetṣaḍasrikāpiṇḍī śeṣarekhāvithopanāt [kh, gh: lekhāvilopanāt]sūtramadhyārdha sabṛttādabjā syāt [g: dabjābhā] pūrvacoditāmadhyasūtrārdha bhāgena [kh, gh: dvibhāgena] koṇāni hrāsayedathakoṇaiḥ [gh: koṇā] sūtraparicchinnaiḥ kuryādaṣṭāsrikāṃ sadāsaṃchidyāsrīṃśca saṃchidya kṛtvā tu daśamāstrikam [k, gh: daśabhāṃśikīm]kartavyā ṣoḍakāṃśaistu [gh: śaivaṃ] piṇḍikā keśavāśrayā [gh: ścaye]pūrvavatyoḍaśaṃśaistu kuryād dvātriṃśadasrikāmāgneyī bodhipatrābhā pintarogāgnidāhakṛttrikoṇā rākṣasājāṃ tu deśo[k: dveṣo; gh: doṣo] cchadakarī sadā [gh: tusā]vāyavyā ca ṣaḍasroktā śatrūccāṭanakārikāraudrī tvaṣṭāsrikā [g: raṣṭāśrikā] jñeyā muktidā sārināśinīdvātriṃśadasrikā vāhnī svargākhyāphaladāyinīardhacandropamā nīlaṃ śeṣaḥ kodaṇḍavadbhavetpiṇḍīmāmastakādīnāṃ karotyevaṃ vidhaṃ phalambhagaliṅgāṅkita sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaramśivaliṅgaṃ paraṃ taccaṃ tayoryogā[gh: tayoryāgāt]nmahatphalamdalāṅghrigartikā kūrmoṃ [mū, gh: kūrma] vedāsrā valiṅgartinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturasraṃ ta[gh: rasrayaṃśataṃ]dgartaṃ syād brahmāṃśa[gh: brahyāṅgaṃ]tu prakalpitamtadpādaśvabhrikā sāvjā grahagartā śilā bhavetkāryā brahmaśilānyārthi[gh: nyo'rtho]bṛttā tryasrā tu[gh: tryasrānta] sādhaneekajaṃ caika varṇaṃ vā śubhametadato'śubhamp. 154) mūlyaṃ samavadhāryādau vaṇijo daiśikottamaḥpaścādijādvipāṣaṇḍāṃ stato mūlyaṃ prakāśayettadārdhenādhvaraṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sthāpyaṃ suvāsare [mū, a, g: surāsure]iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye pīṭhavartanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo vidhiḥvedāsre grahabhakte [k, kh, gh: vedāsraṃ grahabhaktaṃ] syānmadhye śūlaṃ tu randhrataḥtyaktvā [gh: tyājyā] sārdhau dvivistārau ṣaḍbhirdirdhau bhramānmatautadghṛttau dvyardhadīrdhau ca kartavyau ca suśobhanauvedyadhastāttridhā dairghyāddaṇḍaḥ kāryastrivistarasite rekhā bhaveddaṇḍa aiśyāmeva triśūlakammadhye śṛṅgaṃ tu pītaṃ vā harite pakṣaśaṅgakeevaṃ saṃkṣepato vajraṃ khyātamindrasya pūrvataḥlohitaṃ madhyamaṃ śṛṅgaṃ [k, kh: śūlaṃ] vahneḥ śaktistadā diśimūle cāgre ca daṇḍasya kāryo vṛttāgramūlataḥvedādvahiḥsitā rekhā[mū, a: vedhā]kṛṣṇā yāmye yamasya tubṛttāgraṃ pādasaṃveśātkoṇamūlaṃ [kh, gh: kāmamūlaṃ] suśobhanamvalkalam khaṇḍacandrābhaṃ tanmadhyordhvadvisārdhata [mū, a, k, kh: madhye'rdha]tatsame'pyunnataṃ madhye mukhaṃ tanmūlapakṣayoḥmuṣṭiṃ saṃvartayedevaṃ pītaṃ vā sitarūpakammuṣdyucchrayāccaturdhāto dīrghaḥ khaḍgāgrabartulaḥbhṛṅgābhaṃ tryaṃśasantyāgātkhaḍgo nairṛtarākṣaseprasaṅgādgaditaṃ śastramakṣobhya yoginīpriyam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukhapucchārdhamādyante digdeśairyugamadhyataḥbhrāmya dvau dvau dvibhāgābhyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhadvaye budhaḥgranthirūpaṃ yathā samyak tathā tatparilopayettadadhoṃśena [kh: 'ṅgena] vaktraṃ syānnāsākṣirasanānvitamtadadhaḥ pārśvayordyaṃśe karṇasūtraṃ dvayoḥ samamtryaṃśādho hrāsayetpucchaṃ svāṃśaṃ [gh: svāṃśa] tryaṃśena vāṇataḥsito'hiḥ kṛṣṇajihvāsyo raktākṣaśca suśobhanaḥvārūṇyāṃ vārūṇaḥ pāśaḥ kartavyo diśi daiśikaḥvāyukoṇe'mbutaḥ proktaṃ[k, kh: koṇāmbutatproktaṃ]tryaṃśena tu ca darpaṇam [mū: tadarpaṇam]candrārdhātkoṇato dyaṃśaṃ lopayejjalata[mū: dyantataḥ]stataḥadho bhūtena vistārāttiryaksūtrāddvirūrdhvataḥtaddyaṃśena ṝjuṃ kuryād dhvajaṃ vā kuṭilāhivatnairṝtyātpañcaveśena sūtraṃ vinyasya koṇataḥīśānātsaptapūrveṇa saptaveśādbhramātpunaḥśeṣarekhā [mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: śeṣaveśā] vināśena vāyordhvajaśca māruteśiro[ṅ: śito; k, kh: padmaṃ]darpaṇakhaṇḍendurdhvajaḥ pīto'thavā haritādyante sambikā dvābhyāṃ vṛttamekena pārśvayoḥpītā gadāruṇai rekhā madhyarekhā śukaprabhākaṭikāṅghrisamā vṛttā catasro rekhikāstathākuverāstraṃ bhavedevaṃ somakāṣṭhāsthitaṃ sadāsuśvetaṃ raktanemyāḍhyamīśendrāntarasaṃsthitamnābhimadhyāntato'śena [gh: madhyāttu tāṃśena] mekhalā bhramato bhavettadvattatparatoṃ'śena bhramāccakraṃ tu vartulamaṣṭadikṣvārakāstvaṣṭau kkacidvā ṣoḍaśārakāḥcakrādhaḥ prāntatattryaṃ[k, kh: madhyato dyaṃśā]śādvivistārādrasabhāgikam [kh: masūrī cāsatonnatā]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekenoccā pravistārā paṭṭikā caturasrikācakrasyāsanamevaṃ tu raśmayaḥ paritastataḥbhramādabjakalī[kh: karī]prakhyā cakramadhye vyavasthitāaṣṭau saṃkhyāḥ prakartavyāḥ pārśve caivāpare tathākṛpāṇapāśayorantaḥ sudarśanaṃ harerlikhetprākśiraskau [mū, a, g: śirasthau] gadādaṇḍau svabhāgairaṃśasādhanamjñeyaṃ śūlādicakrāntaṃ taddikkāntibalātmakamuktānyastrāṇi bāṇākhyā (dyā) ghaṇṭebhādyatha vakṣyatebhāgārdhena dalaṃ kuryādvṛttāsraṃ bṛttapaṭṭike [k, kh: pakṣapaṭṭike]grīvādvā vistarārdhādvā skandhārdhāṃśavinirgamau (maḥ) [mū: skandhāddyaṃśavinirgamaiḥ]caturbhāgapravistārau (ro) bhāgārdhapakṣayoryutaḥucchrāyārdhaṃ tu vistārā paṭṭikātritayānvitāpadmaskandhāddvibhāgena kartavyā lakṣaṇānvitāsusvarā [gh: susvanā] kāṃsyajā śreṣṭhā svadevāyudhamaratakā [mū: vādyadharāntarā]gajāśvo'śvataroṣṭrāṃśca tadārohāṃstu tryaṃśataḥbhaveyuḥ paśavo'pyanye mṛgagardabhagaṇḍakāḥjalonā vyāghrakapyuṣṭrā lakṣādārjanakastathā (?)ṣaḍūnād [gh: ṣaḍūnā grāha] grāhagodhā syānnakramatsyāvadhau [mū: matsyāvarau; g: matsyāvakai] sadāiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vāhanāyudhavartanaṃ nāma navamo vidhiḥdvitruṭibhyāṃ lavaḥ prokto niṣeṣo dvilavātmakaḥtriṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kālaṃ vidyātkṣaṇaṃ triṃśatkalāṃ budhaḥtābhyāṃ nāḍyatha nāḍībhyāṃ kṣīṇābhyāṃ [kh: hīnābhyāṃ] ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥtairaṣṭabhirahorātraṃ pakṣastairdaśapañcabhiḥtābhyāṃ saṃvatsaraḥ proktastaiḥ śataiḥ puruṣāyuṣaḥmumukṣoḥ sthāpanaṃ śastaṃ yateḥ kāmārthino bruve [mū, a, g: dhruvam]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hemante jñānadaṃ liṅgaṃ śiśire sarvabhūtidamyatīnāṃ sarvakāleṣu liṅgasyāropaṇaṃ matamdakṣiṇetvayane[mū, a, g: dakṣiṇāśāyane]'pūjyaṃ trivarṣordhvaṃ bhayāvahamkṣayāya bṛddhaye syācca yāmye saumye'pare ravauṣaṭṣaṇmāsottarāṃstryabdānmayamatātphalaṃ kramātabhicāro bhavettatra sthāpite dakṣiṇe'yanekumārāḥ saṃprapīḍyante kanyānāśaśca jāyatekartuḥ kṣayaḥ sadāśoko gṛhe bhavati dāruṇaḥśubhārthī na pravarteta devyā mantrādiśāstrataḥ [k, kh: matādi]tasmātsthānaṃ guruṃ [mū: sthānagurū] prāpya rakṣaye [kh: rakṣārthaṃ]dābhicārikamsthāpanaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ śiśirādāvṛtutrayep. 164) sacandratārakāyoge [mū: vyacandratārakāyoge; k: candratārakayoge tu] sulagnakaraṇānvitateadvaite caiva kṛsṇe'pi mantramūrti prabhedataḥpāñcarātrārharet miśrā [mū: pañcārātrīharermiśrā] pañcāśadvarṣasaṃsthitiḥśātābdorvbaṃ tu sā tiṣṭhedvāṇaliṅgaṃ svayambhubat [mū: liṅgāśrayaṃ bhavet]bahvarthatvānipātānāṃ saṃskārādau pratiṣṭhitiḥ [gh: pratiḥ sthitaḥ]saṃskṛtā dravyasanmantrasaṃskṛtiryā suragya capratimāṃ pañcabhedaistu pratiṣṭhā pañcadhoditā [kh, gh: coditā]dvitīyāyumati [gh: maviḥ] dadyāttṛtīyā putrasaṃpadaḥdaśamī bhūmilābhaṃ [k, kh: bhūmivṛdviṃ] ca saubhāgyaṃ ca trayodaśīekartuśaṅkarairnandā bhadrā pakṣarṣibhānubhiḥbāṇadiktithibhiḥ pūrṇā hīnatulyāhitāḥ kramātvṛhaspatirdvipañcāyurbudyo jayadhanāni cakarka [gh: karki] vṛṣatulācāpastrīsiṃhagrāhayugmakeṣaḍaṣṭacaturoyāmāccatū rāśikrameṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punarvasvanurādhā ca citrā jyeṣṭhā mahībhujiaśvinī revatī śūdre svātīphalgunikādvayamete pravīṇa[mū, a, gh: pravaṇi]lokānāṃ (?) catvāryevāntyaje tathāhastā siddhipradā liṅge āyurdāṣāḍhayugmakamcitrātvarthasukhaṃ [kh: tvarthaṃ sukha] nityaṃ jyeṣṭhā rogavināśakṛtyugmabhādrapradā vṛddhiṃ bahumitrāṇi cāśvinīphalgunīdvitayaṃ vṛddhiṃ bharaṇī ripubhedadā [k, kh, gh: ripubhedam]mṛga śāntiprado nityaṃ dhanyā śatabhiṣāntyajeśasto jīvo navarddhīṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadāsaptartutriśādisthaḥ śaśāṅko baladastathāṣaṭtristhānagataḥ śastā[mū, a, k, g, ṅ: śreṣṭhā]mandāṅgārakaketavaḥeṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunauṃ pūrṇā tvārddhikī grahabhūtayoḥdvitīyā saṃpadākhyā tu caturthī kṣemasaṃjñitā [gh: saṃjñikā]navamī cātimitrā syādetāḥ pañca balapradāḥvṛddhiḥ siddhirdhravaḥ sādhyo varīyāñchi[mū, a, g: ñchubha]vaśulkakaucava ca bālavaṃ cava kaulavaṃ taitilaṃ tathānāgaṃ kiṃstughnamarthāya viṣṭihīnaṃ tu pakṣayoḥvṛṣakumbhau tu bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥpādonāḥ ṣaṭ tulākanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca tucaraṃ dhanustulāmeṣāḥ prāgyugmaṃ mīnakanyakesthiraḥ śubhagrahairdṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥ śubhāśritaḥrājya saukhya dhanaṃ [kh, gh: balaṃ] putrān yaśā dharmādikaṃ bahuguruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhipradāyakāḥato'nye'niṣṭakāryārthe [mū, a, g, gh: ato'niṣṭakakarmārthe] yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥsulagne ca mahābhogo viṣuve cepsitaṃ phalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṝddhirārogyamaiśvaryaṃ devasthāpanato bhavetdurṝkṣe durgrahe [gh: kugrahe] viṣṭau nakṣatre caiva saṅgraheeteṣu sthāpitā devāḥ kṣayadurbhikṣarogadābhaveddoṣakaraṃ tasmātprā [gh: drīka]vasthāpitaṃ varapradamiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye ṛtvādidinaparīkṣaṇaṃ nāma daśamo vidhiḥtriṃśaddhastādibhiścānyo daśahānyā kvacinmatetriguṇairjyeṣṭha ityevaṃ [gh: jyeṣṭamityevaṃ] kārayedanyathāpi vāaṣṭāviṃśatiparyantaṃ vidadhyānmaṇḍapānnavasuveśo ghargharā dakṣo maṇḍapā nāmato [gh: nāmmatā] nava [mū: daśa]prāsādasyāgradeśe ca nāsannena ca dūrataḥjānumātroddhṛte śalye prāgīśenduplave kṛtevedāsrān vartulān vāpi avakrān yājñikān dṛḍhāntaccūḍāśalyabandhena yojayed dvārakadvayamṣaḍbhistu paṭalaiśchannaṃ ghanādi maṇḍapatrayamaṣṭabhirmarkaṭairyuktaṃ dvārakaiśca tribhiryutamaṣṭabhiśchadanaiśchannaṃ suveśāditrayaṃ bhavetupajaṃghāṣṭakī caiṣāṃ vistarākīdṛśamunnatāmtena mānena kaṇṭhaḥ syānmaṇḍapāntaramucyatejayākhyo daśahastaśca vidhātavyo ghanākṛtiḥsuveśasadṛśāḥ kintu stambhaviṃśativarttitāḥ [kh, g, gh: vardhitā]lohakaṇṭakasambaddhakapibhirjinasayutāḥśatārdhahasto vipulaḥ pañcone vibhramo [kh: vipuro] bhavetsaṃyojyāḥ karṇagāṃstambhānityevaṃ maṇḍapatryamkartavyā maṇḍayāḥ sarve madhye pīṭhasamanvitāḥsāmānyātsarvapīṭhāni kvacidanyamate'nyathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kūrmaṃ pṛṣṭhonnataṃ madhye dvādaśāṃśasamucchritamaiṣṭakaṃ sarvasidhyartha dvaciduktaṃ matāntarepañcahāraṃ viśālākṣaṃ saptahāraṃ sutārakamsiddhānte bālukāpūrṇa pīṭhaśayyānvitaṃ [gh: savyānvitaṃ] śubhamvastrairnānāvidhaiśchannaṃ maṇḍapaṃ stammasaṃyutamlambapuṣpasrajaṃ kuryātsaghaṇṭācāmarāmvarampītaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ ghūmraṃ śveta śukaprabhamnavaitāndhavalā [mū: ñchachalān]ñchāntau raudre kṛṣṇānprayojayetsaptahastāḥ patākāstu viṃśatyaṅgulavistarāḥdaśahastāḥ patākānāṃ pañcamāṃśa [mū: pañcahasta] praveśitāḥsaptabhirdaśabhiḥ kāryā viṃśā yāścakarairdhvajāḥdvacidaṣṭakarāyāmā vistāreṇa dvihastakāḥvastrairdṛḍhairnabairnityaṃ devakāryeṣu pūjitāḥtāmrā lauhāśca raupyāśca haimāḥ prāgāditoraṇāḥ [mū, a, kh, g: prasādatoraṇāḥ]pūrvādidikṣu vinyasyāstoraṇā bhūtaye kramātvaikaṅkataśamībilvakhādirāḥ śatrunāśanāḥ [kh: nāśakāḥ; gh: vāsye]aśvatthaścāpi mādhūka plakṣo bilvāṣṭamaḥ kvacitprāgīśavahnikoṇiṣu pūrvāsyaṃ tritayaṃ bhavetsaumye saumyananaṃ kāryaṃ yāmye yāmyānanaṃ matamnyagroghodumbarāśvatthalpakṣavṛkṣodbhavāḥ śubhāḥcaturasrāstvathāṣṭāsrā vṛttā vā cakranirbraṇāḥjaṅghāyāśca lalāṭasya caikahastapraveṣṭanam [kh: hastaṃ praveṣṭitam]ghaṇṭācāmarasadvastra puṣpasnagrāndha dhūpanaiḥjaṅghādau devatā nyastvā (sya) bhūmau hastau praropayetśṛṅge dvādaśarāśisthāḥ sve sve rūdrārkacakriṇaḥ

sanskrit: pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca ete'ṣṭau vasavaḥ smṛtāḥtraitāyuge tvanattākhyaḥ kalau svāmī sadāśivaḥmīnādīnāṃ ca rāśīnāṃ tritayaṃ tritayaṃ kramātīśvarāvyaṃ ca rudraṃ śaṅkaraṃ śambhujñakamviṣṇvarkayoḥ prathiṣṭhāne viṣṇvindradīnprakalpayetpūrvāditoraṇā dhyakṣaścatvāromī'prakīrtitāḥbahirevamalaṅkṛtya tataścābhyantare punaḥsuratnau [mū, a, kh: saratnau] ṣaghigarbhāśca saṃpūrṇā gandhavāriṇāḥdīpākṣataphalairyuktā dvāḥ pālāṣṭakamantritāḥ [kh: ṣṭasamanvitāḥ]rūdrovīra [k: vīta] iti jñeyā aṣṭau kalaśadevatāḥpañcamaḥ śaṅku[k, g: śambhu]karṇākhyaḥ sarvanetrastathāparaḥekaikabhūtakoṭībhirāvṛtā dhvajadevatāḥdāraḥ sitāsitaśceti vijñeyā dvārapālakāḥrambhāṣṭakasamāyukta kṣetrapālāṣṭakanvitamkālaḥ karālikaikāṅghrirbhīmo'ṣṭau kṣetrapālakāḥbaddhadvāratraye tasmin bāhayetpaścimānanampraveśayenna [mū: ttu] tatraiva kuryādyāgasya rakṣaṇam [kh: maṇḍapam]prāsādasya pramāmena sapīṭhaṃ dvicchadānvitam [k: dvikarānvitam]catuśchadaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ vīraṃ vimalamānataḥkoṇe dhvajavitānāḍyaṃ kadalīcūtamaṇḍitammaṇḍapārdhapratāṇena caturyāṃśasamucchritām [kh, gh: svacaturthāṃśamucchritam]kurvīta vātha sāmānyaṃ maṇḍape vedikādvayamkuryāttantadhyataḥ pīṭhaṃ bhadrākhyaṃ kṣīravṛkṣajamvistāradviguṇaṃ dairghyaṃ kanyasānāṃ sadaiva tupīṭhamānamiti proktaṃ kuṭīmānamato bruve

sanskrit: pracchannā dvicchadā kāryā kuṭikā parirakṣitāiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye maṇḍapavidhānaṃ nāmaikādaśo vidhiḥsahasre tvatha hotavye kuryātkuṇḍaṃ karātmakamsoṣṭhaṃ samekhalaṃ tacca yathā [kh: tathā] yonivibhūṣitammekhalāpṛthutocchrāyā kuṇḍākārā tu mekhalāprokte cātha tato'nyeṣāṃ vṛddhirdvyaṅgulikākramātṣaḍbāṇambutripa [k, g: dvitri] kṣaistu vistārādaṅgulaiḥ kramāthastamātre vidhiḥ śeṣe dyavaṅgulāṅgulavardhanātpuro vedāṅgulaṃ tatra pakṣasūtradvayaṃ punaḥavyaktasthāpane kuṇḍaṃ vṛttaṃ sarvāsu dikṣu calakṣaṇadigbhavam]evaṃ svadikṣu dīkṣāyāṃ bhuktimuttyarthasādhanedigvidikṣu prayoktavye bhogamokṣaphalāptayenāśane]evaṃ yathecchayā kuryātkuṇḍānaṣṭau svavittataḥtroṇi pūrvāpareśāne kuṇḍakaṃ vāyudiksthitam [gh: svadiksthitam]madhyamajyeṣṭhayoretatsaptasaptāṅgulādhikamviṣṭarān kuṇḍapārśve tu ṣaṭtriśaddarbhajāṃstathāṣoḍaśāṅguladairdhyaṃ tu ṣaḍekanavadarbhajamdvāvetau bhuktimuktyarthau viprādigṛhato'thavāvāgīśvaryārcanaṃ kuryādvījaprakṣepaṇādikamprokṣaṇārcanahomaśca ghṛtaśuddhyādipūrvavatdevīṃ visarjya dikṣvāsyānvidikṣvaṅgāni homayetsuvauṣaṭ śāntike kuryādvaṣaḍāpyāyane hitammātrābhirbhedito[mū: śchedito]hyeko varṇo dvādaśadhā sthitaḥ

sanskrit: tasminkāle pradānaṃ ca gurave deyamādarātpu0] dvādaśo vidhiḥpūrṇakumbhādimāṅgalye nimitte pūrvacocite [codite bhū]maṅgalārthaṃ prayoktavyāḥ śobhārthaṃ ca tathā striyaḥna cāyaṃ niyamo hyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ parigraheutsave maṅgalārthe tu samyagvedasvanaḥ smṛtaḥsarvārambheṣu tatpūjyaṃ na vedastatra kāraṇamjyotirjñānārthatattvajño daivajño jāyate yataḥjñānaṃ saṃpūjyate nityaṃ na jātistatra kāraṇamnipuṇaṃ supraṇītaṃ ca pratyayānekadarśakamp. 9) sra'vastragandhadhūpādyairdaivajñaṃ saṃprapūjayetghaṭikāśaṅkuyogena pratiṣṭhālagnamādiśetsarvopāyānvitaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadamyannasādhyaṃ tu vedeṃṣu tatsusādhyaṃ śivāgamenacaitatkāraṇaṃ [gh: caitaiḥ-] vedaiḥ pratiṣṭhāyāḥ śivāgamedevyāmatātsamākṛṣya likhitaṃ leśato mayāśodhayitvā tato liṅgaṃ rathe tvāropya yatnataḥākarṣayecca nāgāśvairmahiṣairvā bṛṣai rathamavatāryāgataṃ liṅgaṃ syandanasthaṃ prayatnataḥaṣṭāṅgasaṃskṛtaṃ cārghaṃ dattvā liṅgaṃ praveśayethemapātrādigairetairarghaṃ dadyā dathāṣṭabhiḥpādaśaucaṃ tata kṛtvā pāduke sthāpayetpunaḥkuṅkumāgurukarpūrairlimpeta samacandanaiḥmukuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva hārakeyūrakaṅkaṇaugṛhasthānāṃ vidhau samyagvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet

sanskrit: pradhānaśilpinaṃ tadvagdandhapuṣpaistathetarānbhavatpādaprasādānme kṛtsnaṃ yāgaphalaṃ bhavetpādalagno vadetkartā kuru [gh: kuyuḥ] (rve) karmatvadājñayāprakṣālya pāṇipādaṃ ca triḥ pibedambu vītritamsaṃhitābhistribhiḥ pūrvamāsyamevamupaspṛśetaṅgūṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu cakṣuḥśrotre punaḥ punaḥsarvābhistu śiraḥ paścādvāhū cāgreṇa saṃspṛśetyāgālayaṃ praviśyātha khaḍgabījaiḥ surecitaiḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryānmūrtyādisakalīkṛtamdvādaśāṅgulamutsiktaṃ sitoṣṇīṣavidhārakaḥbhavedyajñe sadācāryaḥ śrīkaṇṭharūpadhārakaḥityevaṃ nirvikalpena cetasā cintayetsadātenārdhavāriṇā prokṣya sarvaṃ puṣpaphalādikamvarmaṇā saṅgahetpaścāccāmarairvātha picchakaiḥ [gh: piñjakaiḥ]gandhāmbuphalaratnāḍhyamoṣadhīvastrasaṃyutam [gh: maṇḍitam]aiśyāṃ diśyastrasaṃyuktaṃ sthāpayedambaroparivinyasya [gh: nyastvā] kalaśāṃstatra tāṃśca dakṣiṇato'rcayetvitānaṃ mañcamāṃśena [gh: māsyena] prāguktairdhvajatoraṇānsaṃsthitamindrendviśāgradarbhāśva stṛṇīyādakṣatāṃ śucīnarghaṃ datvā tu vaktreṇa dhūpaṃ vai madhyagena tuavyaktādīni liṅgāni prāgindvīśaśirāṃsi caviṣamasūtrakaiḥūrdhvādhoṃśaparityāgātpunarvṛttiṃ dvidhāṃśataḥantarluptvā sahasrāṇi bhavatyantaritaiḥ sadā

sanskrit: tasmātsyādviṣṇusamparkaḥ pakṣasūtre'va [kh: sūtre ca] lambanechatrābhaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍe tu bālendvābhe yavopamamyaśo rājyaṃ dhanaṃ putraṃ saubhāgyaṃ jīvitaṃ kramātetadvāṇamataṃ proktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sārvaliṅgikamsantyāgādardhātpādordhvalambanampraṇālasyārdhavistārātpīṭhāvaṭakalendu vārekhāpṛthutvaṃ sāṅghrī tu dve likṣe mūrdhaje tathāvṛddhirekhā tathā sthānaṃ marmakaṃ cādivarjitamsūkṣmāṇāmapi liṅgānāṃ trirāśikṛtalakṣaṇamdigīśānāṃtu liṅgānāṃ svakāmaphalasādhaneśūlaṃ vajraṃ ca śaktiṃ ca tikṣṇāgraṃ kambukaṃ tathāliṅghavadvartayedrekhāṃ hemasūcyā tvanantaramdvimāṣayā tato'nyasya kanyasasyaikamāṣayāsnigdhā samā ca gambhīrā ṛjvī sarvārthadā bhavetśastramāmantrya śastreṇa vilikheddakṣiṇena tusarvameva śirasthatvamīśānasya hi lakṣaṇamp. 20) saumyābhayā pradātrī ca vīrā hṛṣṭā prabodhikākrūrā kruddhā karālā ca bhīṣaṇā vikṛtādbhutānetratribhāgamadhye tu tārakākhyaṃ prakīrtitamnordhvaṃ nādho natiryagvā na nyunādhikavibhramāsnānādhivāsanam]etasyārthau [gh: etasyārtho] nipātānāmanekārthatayā mataḥnareṇārghaṃ [navenārvaṃ] pradadyācca pādyaṃ cājātakena tupañcamena srajaṃ dadyāddhūpaṃ vai dakṣiṇena tuśrīvāsasaralābhyāṃ ca khaṇḍadhūpaiśca dhūpayet

sanskrit: naivedyāni tṛtīyena anuktaṃ hṛdayena tumūrdhni nidrāghaṭaḥ sthāpyo rudrajaptaḥ supūjitaḥcaturdvāreṣu ceśāne tatkṣīreṇa caruṃ śrapetgurūmūrtidharaiḥkartāsahitaḥ kuśasaṃstaredvitīye'hni kṛtasnānaḥ karyā patnyanvito vratīkṛtamaṅgalanirghoṣairdevasnānādikaṃ caretsphuṭamācāryarūpeṇa mantraśattyā [g: mantreṇa sa] carācaramanugrahāya lokānāṃ gurutvaṃ syācchivecchayātadayutaiñca putrāhva [kh: patrāṅka] staistāvadbhiñca sādhakaḥvādyakarma; kh: vāstukarma] tāttatañcābhyukṣaṇaṃ liṅge arghapūṣpākidhūpanaiḥsavyāpasavyasūtreṇa saṃspṛśeyuḥ kuśena vāvidhinā snapanaṃ [g: apayanti] pañcādācareddaiśikaḥ svayampañcagavyena daghnā vā madhunā pañcavalkalaiḥsnāpayedguhyamantreṇa rudrairvā hṛdayena vāudvartya snāpayetpañcātsvacchena gandhavāriṇātathā kāñcanatoyena gośṛṅgasalilena casitavastreṇa deveśaṃ parimṛjya [mū, a: parityajya] sugandhināsvaiḥ svairmantrairharādīnāṃ miśrāṇamapi sarvadāmṛtkaṣāyauṣadhībhiśca dhāgryā tīrthadhunījalaiḥmahāsnānena diksnānaiḥ snāpyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kramātkṣīraṃ gostāmravarṇāyā īśena bhāgapañcakamkapilāyā ghṛtaṃ gośca aghoreṇāgnibhāgikamkṛṣṇayā gomayaṃ khasthamajena sarvadā [mū: sampadā] śuciśivenaikattvamāloḍya pañcabhirvātha kāpilam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ebhistu paṃcabhiryuktaiḥ snānamarcādiśodhanamīśānavaktraghorāhvaguhyājātākhyamantritaiḥ [gh: -kaiḥ]vṛṣaśṛṅgasamutkhātāḥ pavakāśrayasambhavāḥajena kṣālanātpṛthvīkramatastu kalāvatākavoṣṇaistu tṛtīyena snānaṃ ṭaṅkakṣatāpahamnidigdhikā balāmūlaiḥ snānaṃ guhyena doṣahṛtdhātryā snānānmahītyakte [gh: vyakte] sadyojātena śuddhyatisamudvartya mahādevaṃ tīrthotthaiḥ snāpayejjalaiḥpuṣkaraṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ ca varūṇaṃ tathājāhnavī yamunā kauśī sarayū śoṇanarmadāsaptagodāvarītyetāḥ puṇyanadyo mahājalaiḥkṣārakṣīradadhisnehekṣurasodasurodakāḥsphāṭikaṃ padyarāgaṃ ca rājāvartaḥsuvidrumametadratnodakaiḥ snānaṃ mahābhūtikaraṃ paramkarpūrāgurukastūrīkāśmarīcandanādikaiḥsnāpayedgandhatoyena ajātenābhimantritampuṇḍarīkābjamālūranīlaraktotpalārkajam [gh: -kam]sahakārāśvamāraṃ ca punnāgabakulāni capāṭalādroṇanepālī [k, kh: remālī] kuśakiṃśukasiṃhikāḥmṛdukundābjapatrī [k, kh: mucukundā-] ca vṛṣarṣibukapuṣpakambilāmramocanāraṅga panasaṃ nālikerakamvadarībījapūraṃ ca kava [k, gh: kara] mardaṃ satindukamphalasnānamidaṃ pupyaṃ karturicchāphalapradamtilagodhumasugdādi yavadhānyapriyaṅgubhiḥpañcabrahmodbhavairmantrairmahāsnānaṃ śubhapradam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saśālmalena cāgneyaṃ hṛnmantrai snānamuttamansāśokena tu rakṣojaṃ śikhamantrānvitaṃ varamcūtāsyena tu vāyavyaṃ snānaṃ varmasamanvitamsabhasmabilvapatrāsyasnānamaiśaṃ śiro'nvitanbrahmapatravatā brāhmaṃ sakuśena samanvitamvarastrīmaṅgalodgītaiḥ snāpayedvṛṣabhadhvajamarghaṃ dattvā tu vaktreṇa vastreṇākarṣayejjalamsnānādi svaisvakairmantraiñcaturmṛtsnāspvihādhikāḥnāne pūrvoktamṛtsnāñca śastā dvādaśaviṣṇubhiḥcalārcāsu prayatnena sthāvare dvīguṇaṃ kramātdattvā tu śilpināmarcābhimantrya tato'rcayetcitrādilepya [k: -lekhya] pustānāṃ darpaṇasnānamiṣyateśabdātsparśācca rūpācca rasādgandhācca vai kramātviśodhya khādibhūtāni tato mūrtiṃ tu kārayetpañcabrahma tato'ṅgāni kalāḥ sarvāḥ śivasya canaivedyaṃ pūrvavaddadyādrocanāṃ mūrdhamantritāmchatramīśānadevena cāmaraṃ naramantrataḥ [gh: mantritam]bālukā vikiretpīṭhe tṛṇakeśādivarjitāḥprāgagrāṃstṛṇuyāddarbhānajātenottarāgrakāndharmādicaraṇāñchambhośtathādharmādigātrakānvidyeśvaradalaṃ tatra maṇḍala [kh: maṇḍapaṃ] trayakarṇikamsunimittaiḥ śubhairvādyairmaṅgalaiḥ stutivācakaiḥagre bhṛṅgāradhārāśca mucchadbhirgurubhiśtathātalpe prākśirasaṃ nidrākumbhaṃ tacchīrṣake nyasetthāṇuśca nīlakaṇṭhaśca mahādevaḥ śivastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśāno dhanado bhīmastryambakaḥ pārvatīpatiḥdīpairgandhaiśca puṣpaiśca dhūpaiścaiva yathākramamnmaṇḍalakānmodakāndadhiparpaṭaṃ [mū: paryaṭaṃ] ghṛtapūraṃ ca khaṇḍavartisitaudanamśubham (?)yadgṛhetataḥ śīrṣonnate puṇye geḍḍuke [k: gaṇḍuke] ca suśobhaneabhyajya madhusarpibhyāṃ dadyātsiddhārthakānbahūndukūlai raktavastrairvā devaṃ saṃchādya rakṣayetdvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca nṛpādīnāṃ yathākramamsamayī putrakābhāve sarvābhāve svaṃyaṃ guruḥvidyeśān muktikāmān bhūktyarthaṃ ca gaṇeśvarānmūrtiśattyanvitāścaistvetā mūrtyadhidevatā ṣajetmūrtayastu samākhyātā mūrtiśānavacmi sāṃpratamīśāno devadevaśca [mū: stu] bhīmo mūrtyadhidevatāḥdhātrī vibhvī ca vikhyātāḥ samāsānmūrtiśaktayaḥśikhaṇḍakaḥbhṛṅgīśaśca vṛṣaścaiva saṇmukhāntā gaṇeśvarāḥkapālī bhīṣaṇaśceva saṃhāro bhairaveśvarāḥcatvāro'jātakādyākhyā viṣṇarudrau tatheśvaraḥkuṇḍadevatāḥāhṛtya sarvasambhāramācāryo mantravigrahaḥdikṣu vidikṣu saṃsthāpya mūrtimānsujitendriyānprāgādyanukrameṇaiva mantrametānpravācayethomapātraṃ tathā hyarghaṃ daśanyūnaṃ nṛpakramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājyapūrṇaṃ tathā pātramaikaikasya pradāpayetgandhapuṣpopahārāṃśva sruksruvau lakṣaṇānvitausitāmbaradharāḥ sarve sitacandanacarcitāḥtāniṣṭvā svarṇavastrādyaistatastāṃstu samādiśetkhādakaṃ paścime caiva khuri [gh: khari] kāstraṃ tathottareśāstrasadbhāvakarmajñāḥ kuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvakamevaṃ tu mūrtipāḥ sarve kṛtvā sthaṇḍilatarpaṇamsthāpakaśca śirodeśe pūrvasambhārasaṃbhṛtaḥekacitto jitakrodhaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥjanite tarpite vahnau dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥtiryagūrdhvāgamotthairvā prāguktavidhimantrataḥdhātuḥ śabdaniṣedhārthaṃ syānmatriguptabhāṣaṇenyāsane homakārye tu upāṃścādi ca daiśikaḥsavighno jāyate yāgastasmānmūrtidharānyajet [gh: nyaset]p. 35) krūraśabdaniṣedhārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ sadaiva tusvaśāstralakṣaṇopetānbrāhmaṇānsusamāhitāncaturdikṣubahiḥ paścādācāryastānniveśayet [sanni-]paścime vājasaneyāṃśchandogānuttareṇa tusamādiśya tato viprānnadyuktāndvā pradarśanātvṛṣākapiṃ ca maitraṃ ca bahvṛcaḥ paścime japetbhāruṇḍāni ca sāmāni vāmadevaṃ tathaiva carudraṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca ślokādhyāyaṃ ca śukriyamsūktaṃ tathaiva camatāntaraviṣayakamiti]stotramantravidaścānye japeyu[kh, gh: paṭheyu]rdakṣiṇe sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kh, gh: piṇḍairvā svakalānvitaiḥ]jvaladagnisamākāraṃ visphurantaṃ samantataḥsarvaṃ śuddhyati tenaiva jagasthāvarajaṅgamamavicī rauravaścaiva mahāraurava eva canitalāhvaṃ varāhvaṃ ca ābhāsākhyaṃ ca saptamamharaḥurvitattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ jalādidviguṇaṃ [kh: digguṇaṃ] kramātsparśaḥśabdaśca pañcaiva tanmātrāṇi yathākramampumān rāgaśca vidyā ca niyatiśca kulāntakaḥ [mū: kalāntakaḥ]śaktiścebhyaḥ parastācca śivākhyaḥ paramo'vyayaḥpañcabhūtaṃ ca tanmātraṃ buddhiḥ karmendriyaṇi cacaturviṃśatitattvāni prakṛtirvāmakarṇagāḥsamākhyātā niyatirhṛdaye sthitāpañcaviṃśacca tattvāni piṇḍīkāyāṃ sthitāni tumantrabhūtaṃ śivaṃ tatra vinyasetsiddhimuktayenyasya tu bhāvayedvyāptiṃ śivarūpaṃ ca yatparamīśvarādiśivāntaṃ ca tritayaṃ [kh: tritatvaṃ] homayetkvacitśivakumbhāmbunā tadvattadūrdhve ca harestanumvarṇarudrādividyeśāṃllokeśān gaṇanāyakānnāpi dagdhaṃ ca śaivairmantraiḥ prasādhitampūrṇāhutiṃ śivenāto yāgasya paripūrtayetasminkāle gurau dānaṃ dadyādvittānusārataḥ [gh: nurūpataḥ]dakṣiṇārdhena [gh: ṇendreṇa] hastena punarhomaṃ pradāpayetprāyaścitte tathā vighne mahāstraṃ homayettataḥrātrau mahotsavaḥ kāryaḥ śaṅkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nayettāṃ śarvarīṃ sarvāṃ yatistotraravaiḥ śubhaiḥsuśobhitaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā vastradhvajavitānakaiḥannādyaiḥ pūritaṃ sarvai rathamāropayecchivamrathaṃ sthāpya valiṃ dadyād guhyakebhyo muhurmuhuḥprasādāgre ca saṃsthāpya liṅgasyārthaṃ pradāpayetprāguktalakṣaṇaṃ tatra paścātkūrmaśilāṃ nyasetiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye'dhivāsanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo vidhiḥtadgarbhaṃ sūtrayetpaścānmadhyasthāna yathāpnuyāttadekāṃśapramāṇena madhye kūrmaśilāsthitiḥmadhyasthaṃ hanti kartāraṃ brahmavedhā nasaṃśayaḥpratyakṣaṃ mantrasānnidhyamācandrārkaṃ prapūjya ca [kh, gh: te]sarvasatva [kh: sandhi] śubhaṃ kuryādīśadiksaṃsthitaḥ śivaḥdhvajānāṃ ? rākṣasāśāyāṃ vāyavyāṃ nṛtyagītināmaiśānīmāśritaṃ saukhyaṃ yajamānaḥ kulaiḥ sahamadhyātpracālitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhaveddoṣāvahaṃ yataḥ [pahaṃ]aindryāṃ tu mriyate rājā kṣatriyāṇāṃ vyathā bhavettapasvināmathaiśānyāṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ rāṣṭravibhramaḥyathā praveśayelliṅgaṃ tatphalaṃ yattaducyateśāntiśreyaskaraṃ liṅgaṃ kartṛsthāpakaśilpināmtribhāgasya praveśe tu modante sarvadehinaḥprajā cārdhapraveśe tu vardhante sacatuṣpadāḥkartā ca bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ prāpnuvanti mahatsukhamcālite tu mahadduḥkhaṃ khaṃ sphuṭite dravyasaṃkṣayaḥsaśabde rāṣṭrabhaṅgaḥ syātpraṇate vyādhisambhavaḥmūrtipaiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā ekaikasya tu sambhavesthāpyamānaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ sthitaṃ vā madhyataḥ śubhamjyeṣṭhādīnāṃ tu veśmānāṃ dehalīsamasūtrataḥrasakūrmānvitā yojyā tadūrdhve cāparāśilāiṣṭvā rājaśilāṃ tatra śaktimantreṇa vinyasetśivājñayā tvayā devi sthātavyamihasarvadācāsure]vilipya candanenādau dhūpayitvā śilātalamsvadigīśena mantreṇa hṛdā vā praṇavena vāgavyapāyasasaṃmiśragugguludrava [gh: dravya] lepitāḥmate mate'nyathā jñātvā svekchayā vā nyasedguruḥindranīlaṃca sunīlaṃ pūrvādikramato nyasetvaidūryasyāpyalābhe tu nīlaṃ vā padmarāgakampuṣpakaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca vaidūryaṃ prāgdiśāditaḥmatāntarānnirupyaitāni vinyase [gh: sannyase] dindrādīśāntagocarātkāśīvamatha sindūraṃ mākṣikaṃ gairikaṃ nyasetsaurāṣṭrī māthikālābhe gairikasya tu rocanāmpūrvādikaṃ kvacitnīvārāścāpi śyāmākānpūrṇadyāṃśca niveśayet[mū: tato] nyasetstṛṇadhānyaviśeṣaḥ]uśīraṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ ca sahāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ kvacitbījāni cauṣadhīraṣṭau kumbhayitvā nyasenkramātdravyādhike mahādoṣo guñjāmādhaiḥ karakramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyasedvajraṃ tathā [gh: tadā] hema tālaṃ tavān sahāṃ kramāthemābhāve nyasettāraṃ gairirka tālakaṃ vinānyasetsarvaṃ gurusvekaṃ rasendraṃ vāpyasambhaveeṣāmekatamaṃ madhye nyasenbrahmaśilāvaṭehaimīṃ vā rupyajī pṛthvī meruṃ saurarṇajaṃ sadāpadmamaṣṭāyasaṃ nyasya haimaṃ tārajameva vārajataṃ ca yavāṃścaiva kūrmeṇa saha vinyasettatra saṃsthāpite liṅge yajamānaḥ pravardhatetasyāṃ vyavasthite rudre prajā nityaṃ pramodateśrīkāmastu nyasenmadhye deva [kh: deśa] vṛddhyarthameva vāgośṛṅgamṛttikāṃ caiva vṛṣeṇa saha vinyasetdravyāṇāmapyalābhe tu teṣāmekatamaṃ nyasetevaṃ dravyāṇi sarvāṇi vividhaṃ [mū: niviḍaṃ] sanniveśya caśilāsamāni randhrāṇi kṛtvā netraṃ tathoparisamācamya kṛtanyāso juhuyādasinā śatamvāstospatiṃ tato hutvā pīṭhaṃ śvabhraṃ nirūpayetniḥ sandhiḥ suḍṛḍhaṃ tacca vidadhīta prayatnataḥtataḥ suyantritaṃ daṇḍe badhnīyādvālatantunāmūrtipaiḥ śilpibhiḥ sārdhamanulagnaiḥ śive tadādvāradeśāgate liṅge ardhaṃ datvā praveśayetdvārabandhānvite dhāmni nabhaseva tadūrdhvataḥdigvyomasparśanātkuryāttaddiśyuktāṃ ca dakṣiṇāmśaṅkhaṃ dhenu/ gurordadyādindrādispṛṣṭidoṣahṛtvinyasettūryaśabdena nimitte viṣuve sthitepiṇḍikāyāṃ nyaselliṅgamaṅguṣṭhena spṛśedguruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivomāmantrayogena sandhānaṃ bhūtikāṅkṣiṇāmmūrtyādyaṅkāvasānaṃ tu punarevaṃ tu vinyasettataḥrudrādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sthāpanaṃ tathvataḥ [k: ca tataḥ] kramātātmavidyāḥ śivaṃ caiva bhāvayedanupūrvataḥvyavasthitāḥvidyātattve sthitā hyete sādhikāre vidurbudhāḥtritattvavyāptirākhyātā panthānaḥ [g: adhvānaḥ] ṣaḍvidhāstvihakramāttriṃśatpañcādhikaṃ tattvaṃ sanmārgaṃ pīṭhamaiśvarambhujaistu daśabhiryuktaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam [kh, gh: dhāriṇam]gaṇairdevaistathā siddhaiḥ stūyamānaiḥ samāyutamsadyolātena saṃcintya vāmadevena vinyasetbodhakriyāniviṣṭaṃ tu jñeyaṃ jñānāśritaṃ smaretdhvanimadhyagatā tārā tārāmadhyagateḥ śaśīravimadhyagataḥ śāntaḥ śāntamadhyagataḥ śivaḥtadā digdevatāhomaḥ kāryā śāntiśca doṣahṛtanyathā tu bhavedghoraṃ kartṛrāṣṭravirūpakamgajaṃ chāgaṃ lulāyaṃ ca dāsīṃ matsyaṃ mṛgāvikampakṣasūtraṃ tato dadyādṛjvarthaṃ lambasūtrakamcalile śabdite bhrānte praṇate svasthite kramātkṣīralohamalaiḥ [mū: le---tmalaiḥ] śubhaiḥtataḥ śāntighaṭāmmobhiḥ snānaṃ mūrtidharāḥ svakamtoyakṣīradadhikṣaudraghṛtatoyāntarātmakaiḥmugdā [k, kh: muṅgā] dyaṅgulamātrasya calasya sthāpane hitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastamātre sthire liṅge gaḍḍūkaṃ prasthasammitamabhyaṅgasnāpanaṃ ca syānmahāsnānaṃ ca śaṅkarepiṇāmsurādayo'pi ye cānye [kh: cāsya] samānadeśagāstathāsthānabhāga [gh: bhoga] sthitāṃ teṣāmadhaścopari madhyataḥkalāvṛtamtadadhaḥ punaḥsarvamantrādisaṃyukto lokānugrahakāmyayāsūryācandramasauyāvadyāvattiṣṭhati medinīevamuktvā śivājñāṃ tu mantramūrtau maheśvarerūdrendubindunādākhyaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ śivaṃ nyasettena sānnaidhyamāyānti vaktrāṅgāni punarnyasetaghoraṃ hṛdayaṃ dhyātvā vinyaseddhṛdayaṃ tataḥśikhā īśānadevena śikhābhūtaṃ vicintayetsadyojāpaṃ nyasedastraṃ haste śūlādikaṃ punaḥmudrā śaktīśvarī yā tu pāraṃparyakramāgatāśivājñayāadvaite'ghoramantreṇa svahṛdayena vā bhavettābhireva spṛśelliṅgaṃ piṇḍikā sahitaṃ guruḥmukhakramāt]saṃyogaḥ śivagauryoryaḥ pratiṣṭhā sābhidhīyate [gh: pragīyate]sthāpanejyājapadhyānaiḥ śivādvai labhate sadādurgāyāmīśvarī bhānāvādityo mādhavo haraujapetpāśupataṃ divyaṃ sarvasaṃpūrti [gh: saṃpūrṇa] kārakambhūṣaṇādīn gurordatvā kartādyāccarukaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rāṣṭre subhikṣamārogyaṃ kuryāccaurādi [kh: caurāri] nāśanansthāpakasya sadā vṛddhirye ca tatropajīvinaḥ [kh, gh: yoginaḥ]śilpinaḥ karmakartāraḥ sarve yānti śivālayambhuktimuktipradaṃ jñeyamanyathā tu viparyayaḥtataścaṇḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ sthāpayedvidhinā guruḥrocanayākṣirogaghnaḥ phalijyāṃ [mū: kalinyā] ca priyaṅkaraḥnāgapuṣpaṃ subhikṣāya saptāhaṃ ca phalaṃ kramātcandanāgurukapūrakuṅkumādyaiśca lepanamajena [k, kh: añjanaṃ] rocanāṃ caiva darpaṇaṃ puruṣeṇa tukaṭakaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca paṭṭabandhaṃ ca yadbhavetkvacittenaiva guhyairvā sarvāṇyetāni dāyayetpraṇamya daṇḍavadbhamau śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇamsukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi ajñānājjñānataḥ kṛtamtasminkāle pradātavyā dakṣiṇā śivayogineputrakāyārdhato deyā samayibhyaśca pādikāyathāśakti dvijātibhyo dadyāddānaṃ yathāvidhitauryikāngāyakānnartṛnnādyena tu toṣayet [kh, gh: tarpayet]ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā saptarātramathāpi vāpumādibhyo divāśuddhiṃ vidyādi tacchatāvṛtam[mū: sthirā]yugabhāgāścaturdikṣu luptvaikaikaṃ tu koṇataḥsthāpyāni teṣu liṅgāni tatsaṅgayābhirvidhānataḥhīnānāṃ tu vidhiśvāyaṃ jyeṣṭhānāṃ sthitipūrvakamtatrānayenmahāliṅgaṃ yantrayogena buddhimānmadhye cāṣṭārasaṃyuktaṃ dṛḍhakāṣṭhena maṇḍitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅgādīni dṛḍhairvadhvā carmajaidṛḍhatantubhiḥkharametatsamākhyātaṃ yantramutthāpanāya camusalyantāduraḥ [kh: puraḥ] kāṣṭhavedheṣu viniyojayetsyātpaṭṭaśakaṭaṃ tvevaṃ bṛhalliṅgādikarṣaṇedhavamālūrabilvādyairanyairvā dṛḍhadārūbhiḥstholitaṃ] dṛḍhaiḥhṛḍhamsaumyāṣṭakaṃ vibhidyārghairdigvidigyojitaistataḥbālukāpūritaṃ kṛtvā jalādhāraṃ nyasettataḥpūjāṃ homaṃ ca jāpyaṃ ca kuryādbalyādi pūrvavatcāndraṃ vibhinnapīṭhaṃ tu sauryaṃ cābhinnapīṭhakamrasairvajrauṣadhībhiśca pṛthakpīṭhaṃ tu yojayetitthaṃ sthiraṃ calaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ yāgapūrvakamūrdhvāsīnā ca suptā ca yānasthā cāntarikṣagāhomaṃ ca rathayātradi svamantraiḥ pīṭhapūrvakamkramāttribhiḥrakṣoṃ'śe sthāpanaṃ neṣṭaṃ dhanāyurdhānyanāśanātkuḍyena saha saṃyuktā yajamānaṃ vināśayetsadardhamucchṛyaṃ tasyā navagarbhābjasaṃyutāmūrdhvārcā tejasā yojyā āsīnā varuṇena tuvāyunā sthāpayetprāgvaid dvaite'dvaite nirodhanamkṣmādipumāvadhau brahmā kādimāyāntake'cyutaḥnvyādiparāvadhi]bhūtavetālaśākinyo grahanakṣatrarāśayaḥurvītattve sthitāḥ śodhyā [kh: sādhyā] jarāyujodbhijāṇḍajāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradyumno vahvitattvasthāstvaniruddhaḥ samīraṇedhīrviṣṇuḥ kasarī garso vāsudevaḥ pumānmataḥrāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca buddhaḥ kalkī dharāditaḥmādhavo vahnitattve tu govindo marutātmakaḥbuddhistrivikramo jñeyo garvo ca vāmanaḥ sadāpadmanābhaḥ sadāśaktirdāmodaraḥ sadeśvaraḥ [kh: maheśvaraḥ]avyaktaḥ puruṣaḥ śaktiḥ parorkā dvādaśa kramātsahasrāṃśuśca dhātā ca tapanaḥ savitā tathāetattattve [kh: etettattva] sthitā rudrā mārgādikārtikāntagāḥmahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥtathoktā navadurgāśca ambikādigaṇāśca yeyoginyo vividhākārāstathānye pūrvacoditāḥparivārānvitāḥ śodhyā māyā [gh: mayā] tattvāvadhau matāvidyāṅgāni ca vidyeśāḥ saṃsthāpyāścātmatattvataḥpratitattvaṃ surāṇāṃ tu sthāpanāṅgani lakṣayetbodhane] kramātdaityādīnāmathānyeṣāṃ dvādaśāṅgāni ropaṇesarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi jñānavāṃstārako guruḥtārayitvā nayetkartṛniṣṭadevasya yatpuram [k, kh: satpuram]pratiṣṭhāṃ na ca devānāṃ tasmātsyādadhbavidguruḥdviśaktigarbhagānāṃ tu sthāpanāyākhilaṃ guroḥdvaitādvaitaṃ tathā miśramajñānācca viparyayaḥkāryā sā pūrvavatkṛtsnā avyaktake'pyayaṃ vidhiḥveśanaṃ caikavaktre tu ardhaṃ sarvaṃ trivaktrakecatuḥ sahāsamastaṃ vā pañcānane kvacinmatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: duṣprayuktaṃ punastattu śatruvadbhayakṛdbhavetanyathā karmavaiguṇyādubhayoraśubhapradamliṅgaṃ vā śilpibhirnyastaṃ punaḥ saṃskāramarhatilikhitapustakeṣu nāsti] ṣoḍaśo vidhiḥgurūrmūrtidharān sarvāngandhādikanakāmbaraiḥkṛtvā prāgvadguruḥ sarvaṃ liptapīṭhe puraṃ nyasetsitājāṣṭadalopetaṃ madhye karṇikayānvitamkarṇikāṃ kesarānsandhiṃ dalāgrānmadhvataḥ kramātsitalohitapītāni kesarāṇi kramājjinaiḥrmaṅgalaistūryanisvanaiḥtato vijñāpayedīśaṃ caṇḍeśeṣṭyai gurūstadāyajedgandhādibhirhomastatkuṇḍe syācchataṃ śatamsukhāṃśakai]pañcabhirbrahmābhiḥ sāṅgaiścaṇḍādīn juhuyāttataḥcaṇḍeśvaraṃ vyavasthāpva aiśānyāṃ jagatībahiḥcaṇḍopapadasaṃyuktaiḥ prāgvaccaṇḍeśvaraṃ yajettryakṣaṃ candrajaṭājūṭaṃ dīptāsyaṃ phaṇikaṅkaṇammahoragopavītaṃ ca prapannārtivināśanamādhāraśaktipadme tu samayādiniyāmakampradānaṃ dīkṣitasyāpi śivājñayā nivāritamjñānato'jñānato vāpi nyūnādhikaṃ kṣamasva menirmālyavartanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattaṃ hi śivājñayādhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ tyaktvā vastrārthabhūṣaṇamkhuraśṛṅgasamanvitamnirmālyasya patet kṣipraṃ dvaitaliṅge vidhistvayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tejaścaṇḍasya yāgaśca sarvaḥ syātpūrvavadvidhiḥtannirmālyaṃ kṣipedapsu garbhe cāgnau visarjanam [gh: vivarjanam]p. 68) rāṣṭropadravasiddhyarthaṃ tatsthāpyaṃ guhyadeśataḥphaladāyakamsvārthamantrasthitistena caṇḍeśo na sthireṣvapiyajedabje homadānādipūrvavatgaṇavargāmbikānāṃ ca nanirmālyaṃ śive yathā )purī sāgaradaityādyā ṛṣidigdevatāgrahāḥdvaitādvaitānī tānyatra sāmānyani ca siddhayemārtaṇḍaścetyathādvaite nirmālyaṃ caṇḍavarjitamsveṣṭaṃ na darśayelloke advaite vidhikalpitamdivyatoyādikaṃ teṣāṃ snāne'rghe tarpaṇe hitamnaivedyaṃ bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca dāpayetsiddhirlabheta no citraṃ liṅgasannihitaṃ yadā [gh: sadā]jayadrathādayo'pyanya ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥiti lakṣaṇasamuccaye caṇḍeśvarasthāpanaṃ nāma saptadaśo vidhiḥnayanonmīlanādyeṣāṃ pūrvavatsakalaṃ bhavetcāhavarjanātsnānādi mānasaṃ kāryaṃ tathā ratnaśilādikamnimrabukusumaiḥ pūjā yayā citraṃ na naśyatiratnādini niveśya] carnyaseddiśāṃ tadva] dudumbareśule'pyavaṃ yajantyaṅgaṃ yuktā daṇḍe ca dīpanī ?ekadvitrikare pūjyaḥ śivavadbhagavānguruḥaghoraṃ paścimāsyaṃ vā hotavyaṃ japasaṃṅkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: veṣṭitaṃ vastrayugmena yogamīṭhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ varamtatsānnidhyaṃ tvaghoreṇa deyaścārgho nareṇa tupaṭāvṛtakarastiṣṭhecchivavat sa guruḥ [mū: svaguruḥ] svayamnānāprakāravāsobhiriṣṭvā dadyācca dakṣiṇāmviṣayādhipatirgrāmaṃ kṣetraṃ grāmādhipastathādāsān dāsīḥ subhakṣyāṃśca śayanaṃ cāmbaraṃ varamgṛhopaskaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktipūrvaṃ nivedayetnivedayettathātmānaṃ tato vijñāpayedgurumadya me saphalaṃ janma yatsaṃsāramahārṇavāttatastu sthāpako hṛsṭo yajamānena pūjitaḥdīkṣasthāpanayāgānte parvaṇyabhyāgate tathāasaṃpūjya guruṃ mohānmūrtipānatha jāpinaḥnirdravye hanti kartāraṃ mantrahīne tu daiśikamdhenuhīne tathaivāyuḥ prajā vai puṣpahīnakeputraṃ yāge ca nirvastre pramadā dhūpahīnakeniṣpatāke prajā hanti balihīne tathā kulampratiṣṭhārthaṃ prakalpyādau dravyaṃ yacchuci śāśvatamtryaṃśena sthāpanaṃ tatra caturthāṃśaṃ punastridhātṛtīyaṃ bhojanādyarthaṃ kartā dharmāya kalpayetyāgakāleṣu datvā ca arthe nāpratipādanamyāgasyopaskaraḥ pūto gurorgrāhyaḥ sa maṇḍapaḥguruyāgavidhiḥ proktaḥ siddhaliṅgavidhiḥ sthitaḥlokānugrahahetvarthaṃ svayaṃ bhāvātsvayaṃbhuvaḥsahasraphalamanyasmāddadyātsthāpanapūjanātkanyātīrthe ca nepāle mahendre cāmareśvare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saritpravāhasaṃsthānaṃ bāṇaliṅgasamākṛtiḥyātrāvantyatha bhogyānī [gh: gāni] mantravanti sphuranti catathānyaiḥ sthāpitānyatra ṛṣidevaiḥ suroragaiḥ [kh: gaṇaiḥ]sphuṭitādini vaktrā (krā) ṇi na duṣṭānyarthasiddhayesnātairupoṣitairbhaktaiḥ śivayāgakṛtai [gh: yāge kṛte] rbhṛśamsvecchayāgaccha bāṇeśa yatra sthānaṃ [gh: sthāne] mayepsitamjuhuyāddakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ vyāhṛtiṃ vā śivasya tunityodayāni liṅgāni śuddhāśuddhodayāni cacalaṃ sthiraṃ vibhūtyarthaṃ sthāpyaṃ citsannidhānataḥmantrasādhanayogeṣu sādhakaiḥ su [kh, gh: saṃ] pratiṣṭhitetatra nyāso hī yo liṅge tena tatsannidhānavattathāpi tatra sānnidhyaṃ kartavyaṃ daiśikaiḥ sadātatastu daiśikān pañca bhojayetsiddhikāmyayādvaite'tra vidhinā [g: mantra binā] kṛtvādvaite mantraṃ praropayetprāsādagarbhamānataḥsecyaḥ saṃpā [gh: sapā] tatoyena nyasedratnādikaṃ tataḥvṛṣabhadhvajamantreṇa mūrtyaṅgāni paraṃ tathārājā ca vijayī tatra yatra samyag [mū: śasya] vṛṣasthitaḥddharmastenocyate budhaiḥmuhūrte maṅgale sthāpya dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute [mū: saṃyutam]tārkṣyo'pyevaṃ svamantreṇa vāhanānyaparāṇyapiyajedgurvādikaṃ kartā sthāṇḍilaṃ ca tato guruḥbhāgasparśaṃ ca śuddhiṃ ca vidadhītākhilaṃ kramāttanmadhyānmadhyamunmucya kiñciduttarato nyasettilābrīhiśca [mū: homaṃ ca] rogaghnaṃ rocanāṃ ca sahāṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varavastrodare badhdvā rakṣaṇārthamudumbaresaptasaptāhutistatra tattve tattve tu [kh: tri] homayetvyāpinaṃ cāvināsaṃ ca tṛptāhvaṃ juhuyātkramātsvanāmabhiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya pūrṇaṃ datvā diśāṃ balimkartā tu dvārivaktre syāddigvyome [k: digghāme] ca bhavecchubhamgurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ datvā indrādīnāṃ baliṃ tathāvastrabaddhairyutaṃ kṛtvā sudine tattvasaṃsthitaḥdhāmagarbheṃśukāghrāte nyaseddhṛtpadmavad ghaṭamsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmraṃ vā bhūtyapekṣayācūtāśokavaṭāśvatthadalabhūṣitavaktrakam [kh: cakrakam]sthānamavāpatum]gṛṇhīyātprāṇaśaktyaiva śivājñāṃ saṃprabodhayetutkīlya [mū: unmīlya] hu/phaḍāvasthaṃ sphurannārātanūpamamoṃ kalāyai [g: tuṅgalāyai] namaskṛtya tathaiva ca kalābhṛtedaśanāḍī daśaprāṇāḥ karaṇāni tadīśvarāniḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathā bhavetalambuṣā kuhuścaiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtāprāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva cavākpāṇipādaśiśnāni sapāyūni kriyāgaṇāḥagnīndropendraturyāsyavibhrāntāḥ patayaḥ kramātsva [mū: su] sādhyasādhakatvena prerakatvena mantrayoḥtadaṅgāni tataḥ sarvaṃ nirundhyādrodhamudrayākumbhe sadāśivaṃ nyasya śaktiṃ ca grahacūlakesthitiḥdhūpapuṣpasthito gandho raso naivedyatastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śabdastauryādikastatra śukāghrā nāsikā sadācaṇḍadravyasamo vacca [gh: gavyāgamo] upasthaḥ pīṭhanālakaḥniścayaḥ syādahaṅkāro buddhistadvyavasāyakekāraṇaṃ puruṣo hṛtstho rāgastatrādiśaktigaḥpreraṇe [k, kh: pūraṇe] ca kalā tatra kālasaṅkhyā vayasthitāśivāyatanavijñānaviveko vidyayeśvaraḥsāmarthye dhāraṇāśaktirbahiradhyātmike'dhvanipiṇḍikā jagatīkhyātā prāsādo liṅgamiṣyatetrīn devāṃśca kramānnyasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarānsthirākhyaṃ bhavasaṃjñaṃ ca dāravaṃ juhuyātpunaḥnāmaikonaviṃśo vidhiḥsthāpayedvidhinā samyak dhvajalkṛptimato bruvecūlyaṃ (laṃ) kumbhaṃ dhvajaṃ cātra lakṣaṇāni vadettathāśailotthaṃ śailaje dhāmni devehyevā [gh: hyaṃ vā] kvacinmatettribhāgonādīśasyānāhavistaraumanyathā] liṅgavadyathāgrahacūlaṃ [k, g: cūḍa] tu śailaṃ vā veṣṭitaṃ kalaśena vācaturasrāṣṭakaṃ vṛttaṃ trisamaṃ liṅgadairghyavatliṅgavaccākhilaṃ kuryādbāhye vā ghaṭaveṣṭitambāṇākhye saptāṃśād dvyaṃśato'ṇḍakātṛtvarka bhājitaṃ kṛtvā kalaśaṃ vartayedbudhaḥbhāgaikena ca kumbho'sya kumbhapaṭṭī tu pādataḥanyakoṇādyugāṃśasthe yāmyādho vṛttamābhramāttataścordhvaikabhāgena grīvā dvibhāgavistarātadūrdhvo'rdhāṃśataḥ kālaḥpadmaṃ dvivistarocchrayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sacūlyādūrdhvataḥ padmo ghaṭāsyaṃ cāmrapallaviratnanyāsādi homaśca mantranyāsādi pūrvavatsthāpayenmantra [mū, a: mata] bhedataḥdvyaṃśaṃ tryaṃśaṃ samastaṃ ca jyeṣṭhādikramataḥ kvacitprakṣipya kalaśāḥ kāryāḥ kvacidīśādi yatnataḥviṣṇudhāmni ca cakreṇa anyeṣāṃ svāyughairapivāmā jyeṣṭhāhvayā raudrī svaśaktitrayakalpitāmantrataḥkarīraṣaṣṭhabhāgena cakraṃ syātsama [kh: sa ca] vartulamcūliketaradevānāṃ sthāpanīyāḥ pramāṇataḥindīvaradalābhā sā svabījaiścūlikā sadāgṛhyate sakalā nityaṃ dānahomādibhiḥ sahatathā dharmaphalārthāya dhāmavṛkṣadhvajena tunānāgamānusāreṇa leśatastaṃ vadāmyataḥdhāmno dviguṇadairghyaḥ syātsārdhārdhāttatsamo dhvajaḥsarvārthaśāntaye śuklaḥ kāmārthe dikpatiprabhaḥsvadevarūpakaiścitraḥ svaśaktyā śobhitaḥ kvacitśirbhkau]śāntihome kṛte saukhyaṃ dakṣiṇāsyena [mū: dyena] nānyathāaiśāne vā pradeśe ca mārute vānyathāpareutta [mū: ukta] mādidhvajādhāraṃ mastakārdhena vā kvacitbhuvaneśānpunastatra vighnanāśāya siddhayesamyāgdhyātvā [kh: jñātvā] tu tānsarvāṃstatastvāropayedguruḥaghoramatha śaivaṃ vā yadvā pāśupataṃ mahatgandhādi brahmamuṇḍena dadyādvidyādhipena vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyāyetsūryasahasrābhaṃ pralayāmbudanisvanamtryakṣaṃ taḍillātajihvaṃ dīptabhrūśśrumūrdhajamdhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kuryādupacāraṃ ca daiśikaḥdhvajāgre tu gururlagna iṣṭamantraṃ japaṃstadā [mū: japettadā]yajamānastato lagno bhāryāputrakulaiḥ sahayathā vidhūyate vātairdhvajaḥ prāsādamastakerāṣṭre śāntirjayī rājā sukhinyaḥ syuḥ prajāstathājīrṇoddhāre kṛte karturdhvajānte maulikaṃ phalamviṃśovidhiāśrayantīha satvāni bhūtavetālarākṣasāḥkurvanti doṣasaṅghyātaṃ yatra rāṣṭreṣu te [g: pure] sthitāḥdurbhikṣaṃ dāruṇaṃ rogaṃ prajānāśaṃ daridratāmpīḍā gobrāhmaṇādīnāṃ rājño duḥkhaṃ kuśīlatāmśatruvyasanapīḍā ca cintā ca mahatī bhavettasmāduddharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhinā mantrapūrvakammunmādaye] ddhruvamgobrāhmaṇaprajānāṃ ca svarāṣṭrasya ca vṛddhayesunakṣatre dine yoge sadvāre kartṛśobhanepracchannaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ramyaṃ jaladvāraika [kh: dhāraika] toraṇampūrvavadvedikāṃ ramyāṃ śivakumbhāstrarakṣitāmbālukāpūrite pīṭhe sthaṇḍile pūjayeddharamśivaliṅgadharānpañca bhojayed ghṛtapāyasaidakṣiṇāṃ vittato dadyād brūyuḥ śaṃ rāṣṭrabhūpayoḥkuṇḍe tu vartulemūrtibhṛdbhyastato dānaṃ bhūtadigdevatābalim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: labdhānujño [kh: natvānujño] mahādevātkuryālliṅgādikoddhṛtimyadatra saṃsthitaṃ satvaṃ tyaktvā cānyatra yātu tat [k: yāntvataḥ]tato'bhiṣicya liṅgādyamastrajaptena [mū: mantraṇajaptena] vāriṇāutthāpane prabadhnīyādityuktaṃ śambhunā kvacitvṛṣayoḥ kakude (di) baddhvā varmaṇā bālatantunāīśāśādīḥ kramātsarvāḥ khādakena guruḥ khanetpāśasīrayugaṃ [kh: sārayuta] kuryādbalavantau tathā vṛṣaudhvajadūṣitam]sthūlaṃ vā durniviṣṭaṃ ca yacca pīḍākaraṃ bhuvieṣāṃ kuryāccikitsāṃ ca vyāghitasyeva bheṣajamkriyamāṇe na doṣo'sti mantravarjitayā [tatā] yataḥpakvamṛcchailaratnotthaṃ kṣipedvāmena nityakelohaṃ sarvaṃ viniṣpāṭya punastatraiva vinyasetkṣipetaduṣṭaṃ vidhinoddhṛtya sthāpayedyāgapūrvakambrahmaśilādikaṃ sarvaṃ sthāpayetpūrvavatkramātliṅgādi cāparaṃ sthāpyamadhike vā phalaṃ bahutāvatkalpasahasrāṇi tatkartā tatpure vasetdviguṇaṃ cāśmajānāṃ ca sīsakānāṃ tato'dhikamdviguṇaṃ ratnajānāṃ tu ratnādhikye'dhikaṃ phalamghoreṇa vā mahāstreṇa dviguṇaṃ dhāmacālanetvaritaṃ mriyate jantū rauravaṃ ca mṛto vrajetdārupaṭṭāvṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tu ghaṭayedgṛhamsiddhe dhāmnyaṅgasaṃyogaṃ kuryādākṛṣya khaḍgataḥacchidrapūrṇatā yena syādaghoraśatena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅgādi sthāpitaṃ [sthāpakaṃ] yacca tatkṣamasva mamopariasmākaṃ śilpināṃ cāpi suprīto bhava he bhava [gh: tava]taṃ khaḍgaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ dhenuṃ dadyātsopaskarau vṛṣauekahastaṃ samārabhya aṣṭahastāvadhikramātlokapālāyudhopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sārvadaivikamyaccatuṣkoṇagāḥ śaṅkhāḥ śrīvatsākhyaṃ herestu tatathānyannavadurgādi navanābhaṃ taducyatetathāpadmamānaṃ [mū: mālaṃ] bhaveddvāramekena prativāraṇāputrāyurdhanavṛddhidam [kh: vardhanam]gairikeṅgudasindūrai raktamiṣṭa [kh: siktha] kayāthavāśitaiḥsitābhyāmasitāṃśena aikyaṃ syāddhūmra [gh: dhūma] varṇakamna hīnā nādhikāvakrā kāryā rekhā suśobhanāvakrāyāmarthanāśaḥ syād vyastasthe varṇake ripuḥaśeṣaguṇadaṃ tasmātsthaṇḷiṃ vālukāmayamtayoḥ sthānāni puṇyāni kathayāmi mahītalesandohe nimnagākūle siddhakṣetreṣu [gh: sthāneṣu] sarvataḥmālyavāñśṛṅginīlau ca ṛkṣaśceme'drināyakāḥśrīśailaścaiva vindhyaśca mahendraśca kulācalāḥvirajaścairuḍaḥ [mū: rutaḥ] puṇḍra ścopakṣetrāṇyamūni camāyāpuryatha jālākhyamete sandohasaṃjñakāḥpañcanadyatha sindhuśca sarasvatyaṣṭanimnagāantarvedī pratiṣṭhānaṃ yājñiko deśa iṣyatekaravīro mahākālaḥ saugandhyupavanaṃ [kh: paraṇaṃ] vanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāṇasvayaṃbhuliṅgānāṃ padmakhaṇḍataḍāgayoḥsiddhadevālayo grāma nagaraṃ kheṭakaṃ purampuṇyasthānamathānyacca siddhasthānānyamūni cagṛhṇīyādbhūmimādau tu śāsanena krayeṇa vāādau kurmādyateḥ sthānamīśādīnāṃ tato yataḥmaṭhamāśritya ye liṅgamarcayanti kubuddhayaḥyadīcchennarakaṃ gantuṃ putrapautrādibhiḥ sahamahīripurmānaṃ sukhaṃ ca syānmadhyamā sarvataḥ plavābhaṅgaḥ pīto'rtha ijyā [mū: iṣṭa] syātpūrvādervasudhāplavātsajñakaḥ]nadīpraveśitā [kh: ṣṭitā] śastā pūrvādi paścime'pi vāvaṭaḥ prācyāṃ yamāśāyāṃ yajñāṅgo bodhirabdiśijayantīdāḍimīśyāmāpunnāgāriṣṭapādapābahudarbhavatī viprā kṣatriyā ca śarākulāphalapuṣpavatīsnigdhā snigdhagulmoṣadhīdrumāḥekavarṇā ghanā tulyā yamāmbudiśi connatācandanāgurukāśmīracandrābjotpalacampakāḥśālībhamadadadhyājyadugdhānyetatsugandhinīgrīṣmakāle ca yā śītā uṣmaṇā śiśire'nviyāśubhātmanā]miṣo vṛṣā]sā mahī]āṣāḍhā kṛttikā jyeṣṭhā tathā śatabhiṣā ca bhamsvajāti brāhmaṇī vāpi yathālābhaṃ ca gṛhyate [mū: pūjyate]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktāṅgāraśilāyuktā [k: randhrā-] kṛmikīṭavatī ca yāseṣṭakācitikeśāsthibhasmavalmīkaśarkarā [k, kh: jarjarā]bahvāpadbahuvarṇā ca vajrāgnihyaricauradā [mū, ṅ: ṣairadā]yoṣidduścāriṇī tatra rujo rājabhayaṃ bhavetkākakaṅgoṣṭraśabdā vā sarvaiṣāmasuravāvahāsaśilpikā [kh: samalpikā]nyūnā samādhikā jñeyā hīnamadhyottamā kṣitiḥbhuvaḥdvijādīnāṃ sitādyāśca jvalitāvartayo niśinirvāpyaḥ [mū: nirvāntyaḥ] prajvalantyaśca svajātisukhaduḥkhadātīśaśambarai]sapta pañca trirātre syāddhīnādi [k, kh: dviśādi] rohaṇātridhāvaiśyāya ca ṣaḍaṃśāsrā śūdrāya hyāyatā śubhāṣaṭkoṇikā ca yāmṛtyurvyādhistathā pāpaṃ kramāddadyātpalaṃ mahīśakaṭā dvipa [gh: dvija] pṛṣṭhābhā diṅmūḍhā ca karoti vaiśokaṃ ca sarvanāśaṃ ca sarvalokakṣayaṃ kramātyavapipīlikāmadhyā dundubhīpaṭahodarīnānādoṣakarā hyetāḥ sarveṣāmeva varjitāḥprāgvidhānena sā grāhyā yadi nopahatā bhavetyā sevitā sadā pṛthvī koṣṇā [k: koṣo] sṛgvajradūṣitāapi grāhyā [k: grāhya] guṇāḍhyā sā gṛhadhāmnoḥ suśodhitāpakvaśasyena saṃskṛtya ghaṭayeddhāma [kh: vāsa] veśmanītataḥ prasādhayetkāṣṭhāṃ gṛhādīnāṃ taducyatemīnayogena kauberīṃ dhruvayogena cānayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyasettanmadhyataḥ śaṅkuṃ khādiraṃ dvādaśocchrayamtacchāyāyāḥ praveśena paścimāṃ diśamaṅkayetmīnayogyāṃ tathā yāmyāṃ saumyāśāṃ ca prasādhayetvedāsraṃ ca catuḥsūtraṃ pātatastatra siddhyatiśāntā yaśovatī kāntā viśālā [kh: vilāsā] prāṇavāhinīuttarāsyāṃ daśānyā ca ekāśītyaṅghrikārikājayā jvālā viśokā ca smṛtaitā sūtrapātataḥśakramarkaṃ tathā satyaṃ bhṛśaṃ vyomaṃ ca pūrvataḥkṛtāntamatha gāndharvaṃ bhṛṅgaṃ mṛgaṃ ca dakṣiṇevaruṇaṃ daityaśoṣau ca yakṣmāṇaṃ paścime sadānavāntapadago brahmā pūjyo'nye dvipadaṅghrikāḥtathādhaścāpavatsākhyaḥ kendrāntare tu ṣaṭpadesāvitrī tadadho dvyaṅghre vivasvān ṣaṭpade tvadhaḥvaruṇabrahmaṇormadhye mitrākhyaṃ ṣaṭpade yajetṣaḍsthaṃ] saumye dharādharamjambhapāpapilīpicchān yaje [k, g: nyase] dīśādibāhyataḥśātmake]daśakoṣṭhasthitā dikṣu tvanye ceśādikoṇagāḥpāpasaṃjñānilau devā sārdhasārdhāṅghrisaṃsthitāḥdevavāstuvidhau sarvaṃ vakṣye śalyoddhṛti kramāt[mū, ṅ: rūpavat]sadigviṃśatkaro dairghyātsaptaviṃśativistṛtaḥrudradviguṇitaṃ nāhātpṛthujyotirvinā tribhiḥkuḍyasūtrasamā vīthī vīthībhedādanekadhāpārśvayorvinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vīthyardhenopavīthyāḍhya [mū: thyādya] mekadvitripurānvitamekaṃ yāmyaṃ ca saumyāsyaṃ dve cetpaścātpuromukhamsiddhārthamambuyāmye ca indrāpye [kh: indrākhya] yamasūryakamāpyendau gṛhacūlyākhyaṃ kācāhvaṃ yāmyasaumyayoḥdaṇḍākhye rājato daṇḍo vātākhye kalahaḥ sadākh: tadbahiḥ kṛtaḥ]yāmye hīne bhaveccūlī [mū: cchūlā] triśālaṃ vittahṛtparamindrādikramato vacmi [mū: vahni] dhvajādyaṣṭau gṛhāṇyahamyāmye rasakriyāśayyā varma [varcaḥ] śastrāṇi rakṣasisaumye dhanaṃ paśūn kuryādīśe dīkṣāsurālayamdviguṇaṃ hastasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvāṣṭāṃśairhṛtaṃ tathātapaḥ pakṣāgnivedeṣu rasādyambarato bhavettasmācca [mū, gh: tatsyācca] navame bhāge śubhakṛnnilayo mataḥprāgāpye cenduyāmye vā haṭṭa [k: haste] evaṃ gṛhāvalīīśādiditikāntāni phalānyeṣāṃ yathākramamṣvaṣṭakaṃ dhruvam]śilpitvaṃ tanayaḥ syācca yāmyadvāraphalāṣṭakammānaśca dvārataḥ proktamuttarasyāṃ diśi kramātcārvībhistabhmamālābhiḥ kapāṭaiḥ sārgalairyutamhomena [ṅ: doṣa ca] tarpayetsarvān maṇḍape purato guruḥveśmasaṃsthāpane kāle guruṃ santoṣya bhaktitaḥgṛhopaskaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ dattvā śayyāsanādikamsveṣṭadevālayaṃ kuryāttallakṣaṇamathocyatejagatyekaṃ pṛthurvāpi [kh: pṛthgvāpi] kecitprāhuḥ surālayamteṣāṃ madhye bhavedekaḥ karturicchāvaśena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcahasto'thavā kāryaḥ ṣaṭcaturaṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥviṣamaistu na [mū: mastena] mādhyāni māghyadoṣo mahānbhavetāya [kh: āpa] doṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ dāpayettatra buddhimāntryaṅgulaṃ pariṇāhena jinasaṅkhyāṅgulāyatamhastadārusamāsena vyākhyātaṃ vāstusādhanamsahasraṃ dhanuṣāṃ krośo gavyūtirdviguṇaṃ smṛtamekaṃ daśaśataṃ jñeyaṃ sahasramayutaṃ punaḥvṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ vai padmasaṃjñakamparārdhaṃ sarva [kh, gh: meva] mākhyātaṃ daśavṛddhyuttarottarampurasya sarvato dikṣu sabāhyābhyantareṣu cakuryādabhimukhāvaitau grāmasna nagarasya caśatadvayeprākpratīcyāgato madhye vaṃśo dakṣiṇasomataḥpaścimasaṃmukhānottarābhimukhāḥ śastāḥ kadāciddakṣiṇāmukhāḥtadādau kīrtyate sthityai kurtuḥ kīrtiśubhecchayāhanūmadbhūtavetālamātṛkālāstu dakṣiṇesamudrā varuṇo nadyo viśvāmitro'psaro [k, g, gh: śmaro] jalesaumye skando viśākhaśca sthāpyā yakṣā grahāstathāpurādyabhimukhā devāḥ śubhāḥ svasthānasaṃsthitākṛte devaṃ likhetsaumyaṃ tatkuḍrye purasammukhamsvadevatāḥ]kaṭukaṇṭakinastiktāḥ piśācākhyādipādapāḥprāsādasya samīpasthāḥ sarvadoṣāvahā nṛṇamaśakta [gh: asak] cchedane teṣāṃ ropayetkṣīriṇo'ntare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāraṅganārikelau ca panasāśca sacampakāḥsaralonandikāvartatālāgastyatimuktakāḥebhirantaritāḥ krūrā bhūruhāḥ syuḥ sukhapradāḥśivasya niyamo nāsti prāsādakaraṇaṃ pratimumukṣoryatra tatreśo dadyānmuktiṃ tu helayāpātālakhecarīsiddhiḥ śatrudāhaśca śāntayaḥgrāmādīśendravahnisthāḥ paścimāsyāḥ surāḥ śubhāḥadhikaṃ vā samaṃ hinaṃ pūrvāyāmādibādhakamubhayodviguṇocchrāyā kuryāttyaktvāgrataḥ kṣitaubhinnanābhau vidhiścāyaṃ na doṣo'bhinnanābhikeevaṃ bāṇamatājjñātvā harisūryādi ropayetsvayambhūte sahasraikaṃ mahadbhiḥ śatapañcakamtatrotpannaṃ hi nirmālyaṃ mṛte jantau vimocanampraviśya bhūmiṃ tāṃ dhīmānudagīśānagocaredhānyakambuphalairyuktaṃ candonena sucarcitamnyasettatra ghaṭaṃ divyaṃ tūryamaṅgalanisvanaiḥparaśuṃ muṣṭilāṃ sūtraṃ kīlakāṃśca taduttarepunnāgaśastavṛkṣotthāḥ kīlakāḥ ekajātayaḥśaṅkuṃ niveśayettasminnāja [kh: nnaja] gatyāḥ krameṇa tusuvastrairveṣṭitāḥ sarve sudhūpenaiva dhūpitāḥadhomūlordhvagāgrāśca ṛjurūpāḥ suśobhanādakṣiṇena samutthāpya vāmahastena muṣṭinātāḍayaṃśca japenmantraṃ prāṅnimittāni lakṣayetasmin gṛhe tu tiṣṭhantu āyurbalakarāḥ sadātataḥ pradhānakārūkastāḍayecca viśedyathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00065 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praviśecceddrutaṃ sarvaṃ kartustatrāśubhaṃ tadāśanaiḥ śanairadho gacchetkāryasiddhiṃ vinirdiśetbhayamarthakṣatīrogaḥ sukhaṃ mānaṃ kramādbhavetāyuḥ putrārthavṛddhiḥ syāccyute hastādbhayaṃ mahatsūtraṃ niveśayacchaṅkau yathā tanna vimuñcatitasmātsugranthitaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇena tu veṣṭayetāgneyyāṃ tanmukho bhūtvā mantramuccārayedimamgṛhṇantu mantritāḥ]baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarve gṛhṇantu mantritāḥbaliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇantu sumanotsukāḥdhruvādi dīpitā mantrāḥ kumbhayitvā nivedayettarpitāstuṣṭamanaso bhavanti karmasiddhidāḥśaṅkavaḥnādhikaṃ sukhadaṃ karturdoṣā ete sadādhikepravāstastaskarādbhītiḥ prāgādyādhikasūtrataḥraupyeṇa vā nirarthānāmartha [kh: māṣa] vṛddhayai dvijātitaḥtṛṇairvā [mū: tūṇairvā] likhite vāstau doṣā ete bhavanti cakramātajinena bhavedvyādhistasmāddhemnā likhetsadālakṣaṇanirṇaye trayoviṃśo vidhiḥlipte susaṃskṛte sthāne tanyamāne [g: tatpramāṇe] ca sūtrakea: lakṣaṇam]mahāmarmāsthiśalyena bhayaṃ karturmahadbhavettasmādākarṣayecchalyaṃ tadbhavaṃ tatpramāṇataḥkhareṇa kharajaṃ nābhyāmuccāṭaḥ syātprabhorbhayam

sanskrit: ajāvibhyāṃ gavāsthi syāttayorvāsthi suniścitamaśvena māhiṣaṃ vidyā [mū, gh: vindyā] dgajenoṣṭrodbhavaṃ tathāvyāghrāsthi śūkareṇa syāttena daṣṭe [k, kh: daṃṣṭre] riporbhayampāṇḍuroga sapāṇḍukaiḥ]bhasmāṅgāreṇa dāhaḥ syātpravāsaḥ pāṃśunā drutamsūtre santānya [kh, gh: tāḍya] māne tu vyomno viṣṭhāprapātataḥvṛṣabheṇa nidhānaṃ ca gomūtrādrajataṃ viduḥsukhāvahamsadāhānidamśāntadiggajarjācca kartuścādho nidhiḥ sthitaḥśāntāstu phaladāśeṣā drekkāṇoccagrahodayātkravyānmṛgavihaṅgānāṃ kīrtanātsyāttadasthi camūṣikeṇākhujo mūrdhā saputradhananāśakṛtśaṅkhācchaṅkhāsthi kāmārthaṃ kuryādviṣāṇajaṃ viduḥaiṇenākṣigadānmṛtyurāyasāllohajaṃ sadākeśeṣṭakāśmanāṃ śabdāddarśanāttadbhavaṃ matamtadvṛtam]nṛśalyāt strīcalatvaṃ syādbrahmahatyā na saṃśayaḥtanmadhye dvādaśeṣṭāni śeṣāṇyaniṣṭakṛnti caśilpino yajamānasya tvanyeṣāṃ tanniyogināmyannāma yasya śabdaśca [k, kh: śalyaśca] śṛṇuyāttattadātmakamniḥ śalyā tu tadā bhūmiḥ kathitavyā ca daiśikaiḥtasmāttaduddharecchalyaṃ tacca tasmiṃstaducyateputrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ tena bandhubhiḥ syādviyogitā

sanskrit: netrakaṇḍūyanānmuktā śrādā tadaṅgamānataḥtābhyāṃ hastadvayena syāddāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ kramātvidrumaṃ hema tāraṃ vā karṇakaṇḍūyane bhavetgrīvāyāṃ sparśane graivaṃ śṛṅkhalā vātha lohajātathāaṅgaspharśādbhavedāṅgaṃ tanmānādbahurogadamkakṣābhyāṃ kṛṣṇalohaṃ tu tanmānādduḥkhadaṃ bhṛśamdakṣiṇe ca kare pṛṣṭhe kapālaṃ vātha mṛnmayamvāmahaste ca saṃspṛṣṭe khaṭvāpādastadaṅgataḥpārśvakaṇḍūyane vidyānnarārdhena tu pāṃśulīmudare paśuśalyaṃ syātkaṭimātre'tiśokadampṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhajaṃ śalyaṃ śaukaraṃ vātha kūrparamkaṭiṣpṛṣṭenāyaḥ kaṇṭho dvikarādho'rthanāśadaḥśepha [k: meha] sparśāvrilohotthaṃ karādhaḥ pramadāpahamstrīduḥśīlorujācchalyāddāruśalyāddhanāpahamjaṅghāsparśāttadasthi syādadhaścaikādaśāṅgulātgulphābhyāmaścapādaḥ syādadhastvaṣṭādaśāṅgulātpādasparśādgajāsthi syātkaṇṭhaśālmalameva cakh: bahi] citritātryaṅgulībhirhayāsthi syādgomṛtiḥ sārdhatālataḥcarma pādatalādrukmaṃ bhavedaṣṭāṅgulaiḥ sadāgātrāṇāṃ sparśanādvidyānnānāśalyāni buddhimānbahvaṅgasparśanānnityaṃ śalyāni vividhāni caśālyānivikṛtaḥ kartuścatvāriṃśacca sapta cakhanyamāne bhuvo garte labhyante vāstuno yadi
